3×3 的块和是邻居一格以内的格子加起来；5×5 是两格以内。平移可以一次挪好几: A 3×3 block sum adds the cells up to one away; a 5×5 one, up to two away. Shift can move several cells at once.
3×3 的最大值可以先横后竖分两步算，和可分离的模糊一样。角点检测、Hough: The 3×3 maximum can be taken across then down in two steps, like a separable blur. Corner detection, finding lines with Hough and object detection all end with it.

<b>Grad-CAM</b> 只跑一次：用分数对最后一层卷积特征图的梯度，给每: Grad-CAM runs the model once: the gradient of the score with respect to the last convolutional feature maps gives each channel a weight, the maps are added with those weights, and a ReLU keeps only what supports the class. <b>Harris 角点检测</b>统计每个像素周围一小块里两个方向的梯度，排成: The Harris corner detector gathers the gradients in both directions over a small patch round each pixel into a 2×2 matrix and scores it with R = det − k·trace²: when the change is large in both directions R is large and positive, a corner; a straight edge is large in only one direction, so R is negative; on flat ground R is close to 0.
<b>RANSAC</b> 换了个思路：随机抽出模型最少需要的几个点（直线是 2: RANSAC takes another approach: draw at random the fewest points a model needs (2 for a line), work out the model, count how many points lie close enough to it (within δ), repeat for many rounds, and keep the one with the most support.
<b>k 均值</b>不用标签就把数据分成 k 堆：先定 k 个中心，每个点归到: k-means splits data into k heaps without labels: choose k centres, give every point to its nearest centre, move each centre to the average of its heap, and repeat until nothing changes.
<b>从明暗恢复形状</b>（shape from shading）必须靠额外的: Shape from shading has to rely on extra assumptions: an even colour, a known lamp, a smooth surface. People quietly make the same assumptions when they look at a photo.
<b>位置编码</b>给每个图块加上一个代表位置的量：z̃ᵢ = zᵢ + pᵢ: A positional encoding adds a quantity standing for position to each patch: z̃ᵢ = zᵢ + pᵢ, like a house number on every patch, so that order can enter the computation. ViT adds the positions to every patch before the first layer.
<b>卷积神经网络</b>（CNN）把这些部件串起来：卷积找局部的笔画和纹理，R: A convolutional neural network (CNN) strings these pieces together: convolutions find local strokes and textures, ReLU separates “there” from “not there”, pooling shrinks the image and tolerates shifts, and finally a dense layer and a sigmoid turn the features into a score. A task that answers “what is this?” is called classification.
<b>学习率</b>太小要走很多步，太大会在山谷两边来回冲、越冲越远。山谷又窄又: Too small a learning rate takes many steps; too large and you bounce from one side of the valley to the other, further each time. In a long, narrow valley the gradient keeps pointing at the walls, so the path zig-zags. A network has millions of knobs, and the principle is exactly the same.
<b>对比学习</b>把同一张图的两个视图（正对）拉近，把同一批里的其他视图（负: Contrastive learning pulls the two views of the same image (a positive pair) together and pushes the other views in the batch (negative pairs) apart; the InfoNCE loss is written this way. SimCLR is a well-known example.
<b>扩散模型</b>先学会反方向：把一张图一步步加噪，x_t = √ᾱ·x₀: A diffusion model first learns the other direction: noise is added step by step, x_t = √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε, and as ᾱ falls from 1 to 0 the picture sinks into the noise. Two rounds of noise equal one with the ᾱ multiplied, so training can jump straight to any step.
<b>最大反池化</b>把池化时留下的最大值放回它原来的那一格，其余是 0，细节: Max unpooling puts each maximum kept by pooling back in the cell it came from, with the rest 0, so details are not smeared over a whole block.
<b>最大池化</b>把图切成 2×2 的小块，每块只留最大值，尺寸减半。它只问: Max pooling cuts the image into 2×2 blocks and keeps only the largest value of each, halving the size. It asks only “what is the strongest value in this block”, not where in the block it is.
<b>梯度</b>是一个箭头 (gx, gy)：gx 是往右每走一格亮度变多少，: The gradient is an arrow (gx, gy): gx is how much the brightness changes for each step to the right, and gy the same going down. Think of the image as a landscape, and the arrow always points straight up the steepest slope, the way the brightness rises fastest.
<b>残差连接</b>把每一块的输入直接加到它的输出上：y = F(x) + x: A residual connection adds each block’s input straight to its output: y = F(x) + x. Every block starts out “passing its input straight through” and only has to learn the difference F(x), and the gradient reaches every layer directly along the shortcut. This is how ResNet stacks networks to more than a hundred layers.
<b>滑窗</b>检测拿一个模板在图上逐位置打分，再过门槛、做非极大值抑制。大小: Sliding-window detection scores a template at every position of the picture, then thresholds and applies non-maximum suppression. Things of other sizes are found with the same detector on shrunken copies (an image pyramid), and the results are enlarged back and merged.
<b>生成对抗网络</b>（GAN）让两个模型对练：生成器画假样本，鉴定员（判别: A generative adversarial network (GAN) sets two models against each other: the generator draws fake samples and the judge (the discriminator) tells real from fake. The better the judge gets, the more convincing the generator has to be.
<b>编码器—解码器</b>先缩小再放大：缩小时几格合起来看，噪声互相抵消，看得: An encoder–decoder shrinks, then enlarges: shrinking looks at several cells together, so noise cancels and large structure shows; but when enlarged back, anything finer than a block is already gone.
<b>补 0</b> 等于在图外画了一圈黑框：在亮背景上做平均，边上会多出一圈暗: Padding with 0 amounts to drawing a black frame round the image: averaging on a bright background leaves a dark ring round the border, and differentiating creates a false edge there. Replicate edge treats each missing value as the nearest pixel on the edge, so no border appears out of nowhere.
<b>跳连</b>把编码器里原尺寸的结果直接接到解码器：粗的一路挡噪声，细的一路: A skip connection wires the encoder's full-size result straight to the decoder: the coarse path keeps out noise, the fine path keeps detail. U-Net connects every level like this, and cell and medical image segmentation depend on it.
<b>边缘</b>是亮度在很短距离内突然变化的地方：物体和背景的分界、文字的笔画: An edge is where the brightness changes suddenly over a short distance: where an object meets the background, the strokes of letters. The simplest way to measure it is the difference between neighbouring pixels: 0 on flat ground, largest at a step.
<b>遮挡实验</b>拿一块挡板在图上逐格移动，记下每个位置挡住后分数掉了多少，: The occlusion experiment slides a patch over the picture cell by cell, notes how far the score drops with each place covered, and draws that as a heat map. It needs nothing from inside the model and works for a CNN or a ViT, at the price of running the model again for every position. The patch is usually grey (the dataset's average colour), and about the size of the object's parts.
<b>高通</b>只留下细节：高通 = 原图 − 低通，在频域里就是把掩膜 H: A high-pass filter keeps only the detail: high-pass = image − low-pass, which in the frequency domain means replacing the mask H with 1 − H.
<b>齐次坐标</b>把点 (x, y) 写成三个数 (x, y, 1)，把直线: Homogeneous coordinates write the point (x, y) as three numbers (x, y, 1) and the line ax + by + c = 0 as (a, b, c). A point lies on a line exactly when their dot product is 0.

Sobel x 量左右方向的变化，Sobel y 量上下方向的变化。: Sobel x measures change from left to right and Sobel y from top to bottom.
Softmax 将各分数转换成非负、总和为 1 的权重。它适用于不同数量的类别；: Softmax turns scores into nonnegative weights that sum to 1 for any number of classes. The weights can be used as class probabilities, but their reliability still needs calibration and evaluation.
Softmax 将多个分数转换成总和为 1 的权重。分数之间的差决定权重的比例；: Softmax turns scores into weights that sum to 1. Differences between scores determine the ratios of the weights; equal scores receive equal weights. The same method works for three or more scores.
V 换成掩膜，注意力加权平均出来的就是落在车上的权重之和。真的 ViT 有十几层: With the mask as V, the weighted average attention gives is the total weight on the car. A real ViT has a dozen layers of several heads each, so the attention of every layer is multiplied through (attention rollout), or only the heads that matter for the class are read; one head alone is easy to be fooled by.
VAE 就是这样训练的；Stable Diffusion 里负责压缩和还原图像的: That is how a VAE is trained, and the part of Stable Diffusion that compresses and restores images relies on it during training too.
ViT 不是每格一个权重：它把照片切成图块，最前面多放一个类别 token，分类: A ViT has no weight per cell: it cuts the photo into patches and puts an extra class token in front, and only that token's output is read to classify. The class token asks every patch with its own query and shares out its attention by the answers.
c = 0 时，从左边那一带抽一个斑点；c = 1 时，从右边那一带抽。: When c = 0, draw a blob from the region on the left; when c = 1, from the region on the right.
c 定中线，也就是平均亮度；A 定起伏的高度，也就是明暗差；k 定一行里有几个周: c sets the middle line, the average brightness; A sets the height of the swing, the contrast; k sets how many cycles fit in the row, the density of the stripes; and φ sets which way the stripes are shifted. As a formula: c + A·cos(2π·k·x/32 + φ).
c 把整道波上下平移：整行一起变亮或变暗，明暗差不变。: c moves the whole wave up or down: the row gets lighter or darker all at once, and the contrast stays the same.
cos 和 sin 各量到一部分：a = A·cos φ，b = A·sin φ: cos and sin each measure a part: a = A·cos φ and b = A·sin φ. √(a² + b²) is exactly A, however far the wave is shifted.
cos 探针量的是和它对齐的那部分。错开四分之一个周期，还剩多少对齐？: The cos probe measures the part lined up with it. Shifted by a quarter of a cycle, how much is still lined up?
exp 处理一条从 0 到 1 的斜坡: exp on a ramp from 0 to 1
k 是这一行里走了几个完整的周期：k = 5 就是五道亮条。k 越大，条纹越密。: k is how many whole cycles the row goes through: k = 5 makes five bright stripes. The bigger k, the denser the stripes.
mAP 是每类 AP 的平均：少见的类和常见的类一样重要，检测器不能只把常见的类: mAP is the average of the per-class APs: a rare class counts as much as a common one, so a detector cannot just do well on the common classes. Almost every detection result reported in papers is this number.
max(a, b) = b + ReLU(a − b)：a 大就补上多出的那一截: max(a, b) = b + ReLU(a − b): if a is bigger, add the amount it is bigger by; if b is bigger, add nothing.
w 和 b 各用一个<part-ref to=\"part:lrnConst\": Use one <part-ref to="part:lrnConst"></part-ref> for w and another for b.
|gx| 是 gx 和 −gx 里较大的那个。每个方向是两个条件同时成立：哪个分: |gx| is the larger of gx and −gx. Each direction needs two conditions at once: which part is larger, and its sign.
δ 由三种比例共用。色带是与直线距离小于 δ 的范围；虚线是真实直线，圆圈标出抽: δ is shared by all three ratios. The band covers everything closer than δ to the line; the dashed line is the true line, and the circled points are the two drawn
σ 决定钟有多宽：σ 越大，图越糊。平滑叠平滑会越来越像高斯，方块模糊连做三次几: σ sets how wide the bell is: the larger σ, the blurrier the image. Smoothing on top of smoothing looks more and more like a Gaussian, and three box blurs in a row are almost one; that is one reason Gaussians are everywhere in vision.
φ 把整道波左右挪动：条纹换了位置，疏密和明暗都不变。挪满 2π 又回到原样。: φ slides the whole wave sideways: the stripes move, while their density and contrast stay the same. A shift of 2π brings it back to where it was.
ᾱ 从 1 慢慢减到 0，图一点点没进噪声里。两个系数的平方加起来是 1，所以不: As ᾱ falls slowly from 1 to 0, the picture sinks little by little into the noise. The squares of the two coefficients add up to 1, so whatever the step, the total "energy" of the picture stays about the same. This formula lets training jump straight to any step without adding noise step by step.
√ᾱ 和 √(1 − ᾱ) 都是一个数，乘到整张图上。: √ᾱ and √(1 − ᾱ) are each a single number, multiplied onto the whole picture.
● 第 1 个视图 ○ 第 2 个视图 — 连线连接同一张图的两个视图: ● First view  ○ Second view  — A line joins the two views of the same image
「不到」和<part-ref to=\"threshold\"></part-r: "Less than" is the exact opposite of the "above" that <part-ref to="threshold"></part-ref> answers.
「像素」把亮度画成灰度，有负数的图以中灰为 0。「地形」把亮度当高度：模糊把山削: “Pixels” draws brightness as grey; an image with negative values puts 0 at mid-grey. “Terrain” treats brightness as height: blurring rounds off the hills and edges are cliffs. “Slope” draws contour lines and arrows pointing where the image brightens fastest. “Profile” draws the brightness along one row as a curve; drag on the picture to change row. <part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref> shows how strong the wave at each frequency is, with frequency (0, 0) at the centre.
「光谱」是从紫（400 nm）到红（700 nm）的 10 个波段各有多少光。相: The "Spectrum" is how much light there is in each of 10 bands from violet (400 nm) to red (700 nm). The camera has three kinds of sensor, each with a sensitivity curve. Each sensor reads the spectrum times its sensitivity curve, averaged. Connect the three readings to the R, G and B output ports.
「前 k 名里对的个数」是一个累加：每一格加上它左边所有格。平移多了一个「格数」: "The number right in the top k" is a running total: every cell plus all the cells to its left. Shift now has a "Steps" setting: add the one 1 cell to the left, then the one 2 cells to the left…
「布 A」「布 B」是两块布在每个波段反射多少光，「灯」是灯的光谱。照到布上再反: "Cloth A" and "Cloth B" are how much light two cloths reflect in each band, and "Lamp" is the lamp's spectrum. The light that reaches the camera off a cloth = lamp × cloth. Output what the camera reads for cloth A minus cloth B under this lamp: three differences, R, G and B.
「狗咬人」和「人咬狗」用的是同样的字，意思却相反，差别全在顺序。图也一样：左边亮: "Dog bites man" and "man bites dog" use the same words but mean opposite things; the difference is all in the order. Images are the same: bright on the left and dark on the right is a different image from the reverse.
「现场」比「空场」多了一个东西。只在它所在的格子输出 1，其余输出 0。: The "Scene" has one thing more than the "Empty scene". Output 1 only in the cells it covers, and 0 everywhere else.
「神经网络」的名字来自大脑：神经细胞收到许多信号，合起来够强就兴奋。计算机里的神: The name "neural network" comes from the brain: a nerve cell receives many signals and fires when together they are strong enough. A neuron in a computer is a simplified version, a computing unit that does one small thing.
「等于周围最大值」的格子才是峰顶：这叫非极大值抑制（NMS）。一块 3×3 的最: Only a cell equal to the largest around it is a top: this is called non-maximum suppression (NMS). The maximum over a 3×3 block splits into across then down, just like a separable blur.
一个 3×3 只看得到身边一圈。如果第二层看的是第一层的结果，它其实看到了多大？: A 3×3 sees only the ring of pixels right around it. If a second layer looks at the first layer's result, how much does it really see?
一个 3×3 的核，X 的格子给正，别的格子给负：哪里最像 X，哪里就最大。: A 3×3 kernel with positive weights on the X cells and negative elsewhere: wherever looks most like an X gives the most.
一个<b>神经元</b>先算加权和 w1·x1 + w2·x2 + b，再用 S: A neuron first computes a weighted sum w1·x1 + w2·x2 + b, then uses a sigmoid to squash the result between 0 and 1, read as “how sure”. w1·x1 + w2·x2 + b = 0 is a straight line in the plane, so one neuron is one dividing line; the larger the weights, the more decisive the judgement.
一个亮点是离散冲激。它的输出是滤波器的冲激响应，可以用来找回权重。卷积把核按原方: A single bright pixel is a discrete impulse. Its output is the filter’s impulse response and lets you recover the weights. Convolution places the kernel around the impulse in its original orientation. This part performs cross-correlation, so its output is the kernel rotated 180° around the impulse. The dot reveals the orientation, and the square and letter test the same weights.
一个亮点，期望是被摊成 3×3 的一小块: A bright dot: the expected output spreads it into a small 3×3 block
一个元件的输出，可以接到另一个元件的输入上：前一个算完，后一个接着算。: The output of one part can be wired into the input of another: when the first is done, the next carries on.
一个办法：先随便定一条亮度分界，按它把像素分成两类，看看两类各自的平均，再挪分界: One way: draw a boundary in brightness anywhere, split the pixels into two classes by it, look at each class's average, then move the boundary.
一个办法：把一张图做成两个变形版本，挪一点、调亮暗、加点噪声。两个版本一定来自同: One way: make two altered versions of an image, shifted a little, brighter or darker, with some noise added. The two versions are certain to come from the same image, and that fact alone can serve as the answer. Many image models are first trained like this on huge numbers of unlabelled images.
一个卷积核要同时覆盖所有输入通道：3 个通道的 3×3 核有 3×3×3 = 2: A convolution kernel has to cover all the input channels at once: a 3×3 kernel over 3 channels has 3×3×3 = 27 weights, and the three sets of products add up to one output. The weights for different channels can have opposite signs, so whatever brightens in every channel cancels out and only the colour contrast is left.
一个卷积通道只能看出一种笔画，三类至少要几种？每一类的分，可以由每个通道的特征各: One convolution channel can pick out only one kind of stroke; how many do three classes need at least? Each class's score can take a share from every channel's feature. Once built, train for a while and watch the two error lines.
一个原像素要分给周围哪些格子、各分多少？: Which surrounding cells does one original pixel go to, and how much to each?
一个只看路的分类器：权重全在路上: A classifier that looks at the road: all its weight is on the road
一个常数除以一整张图，常数用在每一格上。: A constant divided by a whole picture applies to every cell.
一个平移元件只挪一格。它的输出可以接到另一个元件的输入。: One shift part moves the image by one pixel. Its output can feed another part's input.
一个数只能让斑点沿一条线走。这些斑点在往几个方向变？: One number can only move the blob along a line. In how many directions do these blobs vary?
一个数和一整行运算时，这个数用在每一格上。: When a single number meets a whole row, it applies to every cell.
一个斑点 → 两个数：它在左右、上下的位置: One blob → two numbers: where it is left–right and up–down
一个核横跨 R、G、B：3×3×3 个可学习权重: One kernel spans R, G and B: 3×3×3 learnable weights
一个注意力只按一种「像」去找。两张图里的孪生关系一样吗？: One attention looks for one kind of likeness. Do the twins pair up the same way in both pictures?
一个注意力按一种「像」去找：Q 和 K 从哪张图来，它就按那张图比。: One attention looks for one kind of likeness: whichever picture Q and K come from, that is the picture it compares by.
一个点光知道「在哪」还不够，还要记下它周围长什么样，才认得出。SIFT 的办法是: Knowing where a point is is not enough to recognise it; you also need to record what its surroundings look like. SIFT does it by counting which way the edges around it face.
一个点在线上，当且仅当 q·l′ = qᵀF p = 0：这就是对极约束。它不告: A point lies on the line exactly when q·l′ = qᵀF p = 0: this is the epipolar constraint. It does not say which point is the match, only rules out impossible ones, so it is often used to throw out wrong matches.
一个物体附近好几个位置都过了门槛，就会框出好几个重叠的框。非极大值抑制只留下周围: When several positions round one object pass the threshold, you get several overlapping boxes. Non-maximum suppression keeps only the strongest round about: it is almost always a detector's last step.
一个由训练决定的数。和一张图相加、相乘时，它用在每一格上: A number that training sets. Added to or multiplied with a picture, it applies to every cell
一个输出像素能「看到」的输入范围，叫<b>感受野</b>。一层 3×3 只看到: The patch of input that one output pixel can “see” is its receptive field. One 3×3 layer sees 3×3, but the second layer looks at the first layer’s output, so in effect it sees 5×5; stack L layers of 3×3 and the receptive field is (2L+1)×(2L+1).
一个通道只能回答一个问题。「红」和「亮」各要看哪些通道？: One channel can only answer one question. Which channels does "red" need, and which does "bright"?
一个阈值只能看一边。两种缺陷的差值，一正一负。: A threshold only looks one way. The two kinds of defect differ in opposite directions.
一个频率要用两个探针去量：cos 量对齐的部分，sin 量错开四分之一周期的部分: One frequency takes two probes: cos measures the part lined up with it, sin the part a quarter of a cycle off, and √(a² + b²) puts them together into the amplitude, however far the wave is shifted.
一共十轮，对八轮过关，越往后给的时间越短，也可以关掉计时先练。要想的问题：不逐格: There are ten rounds, and eight right answers pass. Later rounds give you less time, and you can switch the timer off to practise first. Something to think about: without working it out cell by cell, just glancing at the numbers in a kernel, how do you recognise it?
一关的前置关卡都通过后，它才会打开；通过的打勾，没打开的带锁。「继续」直接带你去: A level opens once the levels before it are passed; passed levels are ticked and closed ones show a padlock. “Continue” takes you straight to the first level you have not passed yet. Turn on “Unlock all” to play any level in any order; progress is still recorded.
一刀切的增益（某个频率以下全留、以上全去）变回空间，是一个两侧带负瓣的核，边缘两: A hard cut-off gain (keep everything below some frequency, remove everything above) turns back into a kernel with negative lobes on both sides, so rings of light and dark ripple out beside edges: this is ringing. A Gaussian-shaped gain turns back into a Gaussian, with no negative lobes and so no ringing.
一只狗占好几个像素，附近好几个位置都像狗。检测器常常给同一只狗画出好几个框。: A dog covers several pixels, and several nearby positions all look like a dog. A detector often draws several boxes for one dog.
一台相机拍照时总会抖一下。给你几对照片：清楚的原图和这台相机拍出的样子。训练一个: A camera always shakes a little as it takes a photo. Here are a few pairs: the sharp original and how this camera captures it. Train a learnable kernel to learn the shake. The last few "new photos" take no part in training and are only used to check that the learned kernel works on new photos too.
一对对角上本是同一个图案，其中一个被擦掉了几格。把它补回来，其余不变；最多 3: Two opposite corners hold the same pattern, but a few pixels of one copy have been erased. Restore them and leave everything else unchanged; at most 3 nodes.
一层卷积的窗口每次挪两格，输出边长只有输入的一半。窗口里的 3×3 权重不知道，: A convolution layer whose window moves two pixels at a time, so the output is half the input's width. The 3×3 weights in the window are unknown and have to be trained. Some test pictures are 16×16 and some 12×12: the same circuit must be right for both.
一张 24×24 的货架照片，有噪点。只在每个 X 记号的正中间输出 1。: A 24×24 photo of a shelf, with grain. Output 1 only at the very centre of each X mark.
一张印着字母的旧照片，满是噪点（ᾱ = 0.9）。这次不知道噪声是什么：训练一个: An old photo of a letter, full of grain (ᾱ = 0.9). This time the noise is unknown: train a part to guess the noise from the photo, restore the photo, then mark the strokes of the letter.
一张响应图上有几个鼓包。只在峰顶输出 1：这一格比 3×3 邻居都不小，而且大于: A response map has a few bumps. Output 1 only at the tops: a cell no smaller than any of its 3×3 neighbours, and above 0.3.
一张图的大块明暗取自 A（低频），细节取自 B（高频），就是<b>混合图像</b: Take an image’s broad light and dark from A (its low frequencies) and its detail from B (its high frequencies), and you have a hybrid image. Up close the detail stands out and you see B; from a distance, or with narrowed eyes, the detail can no longer be made out and only A is left.
一张有噪点、有点糊的货架照片，大小箱子都有。每个 X 只标一处：小 X 一个点，: A grainy, slightly blurred photo of a shelf, with large and small boxes. Mark each X once: a point for a small X, a 2×2 block for a large one.
一张热图要人去看。要是有一千个模型、一万张照片，就得有一个数来回答「它认的是车还: A heat map needs a person to look at it. With a thousand models and ten thousand photos, one number has to answer "does it see the car or the road?"
一张照片只给出一个亮度，它同时取决于漆色和朝向，分不开。换一盏灯再拍一张，漆色在: One photo gives one brightness, which depends on both the paint and the facing, and the two cannot be told apart. Take another photo under another lamp: the paint is the same in both, so comparing them cancels it, and what is left depends only on the facing. This is photometric stereo: with a few known lamps, the facing of a surface is solved from its shading.
一张照片里暗，可能是漆深，也可能是朝向。三张照片里，什么是一样的？: Dark in one photo may mean dark paint or a turned-away surface. What is the same in all three photos?
一张稀疏的亮点图先做 2×2 最大池化，再放大回 16×16，每个亮点要回到原来: A picture of sparse bright dots goes through 2×2 max pooling, then back up to 16×16, and every dot must return to where it was.
一批切片来自不同的显微镜、不同的染色，有的整体暗，有的整体亮。: A batch of slides comes from different microscopes and stains: some dark overall, some bright.
一批显微镜切片，每张的亮度和对比度都不一样，细胞挨在一起。标出细胞，细胞之间的缝: A batch of microscope slides, each with its own brightness and contrast, with cells touching. Mark the cells, and keep the gaps between them.
一排两个，缝在别处: Two in a row, gap elsewhere
一放大，每个点就糊成一整块。: Enlarge it and every dot smears into a whole block.
一整条光谱，被三种感光元件压成三个数，这就是相机（和人眼）看到的颜色。: A whole spectrum, squeezed by three kinds of sensor into three numbers: that is the colour a camera (and an eye) sees.
一条直线怎么摆都分不开异或。两个神经元先各画一条线，把每个点变成两个新的数，输出: However you place one straight line, it cannot separate exclusive-or. Let two neurons each draw a line first, turning every point into two new numbers, and in these new coordinates the output neuron needs just one line: that is a hidden layer. One more thing: if several neurons start out identical, every training step changes them identically and they can never learn different things. That is why a network's weights start from different random numbers.
一格一格看，噪点会骗过门槛。几格一起看呢？: Looked at cell by cell, the grain fools the threshold. What about several cells at once?
一格被换成 0.5 以后，它出的分变了多少？: Once a cell is replaced by 0.5, how much does what it adds change?
一次平均太“方”。多来几次会怎样？: One average is too "square". What happens if you do it a few more times?
一步看到全图: Seeing the whole image in one step
一点模糊换来安静的图，后面的步骤才不会被颗粒骗。图边要复制边缘，不然纸贴着边时会: A little blur buys a quiet image, so the later steps are not fooled by grain. The border must replicate the edge, or paper touching it gains a dark frame.
一片里真正的位置是它的峰顶：比四周都高的那一格。: The true position in a patch is its top: the cell higher than everything around it.
一种感光元件对一条光谱的读数：光谱乘上它的灵敏度曲线，再求平均: What one kind of sensor reads from a spectrum: the spectrum times its sensitivity curve, averaged
一类的平均 = 这一类像素的亮度之和 ÷ 这一类的像素数。<part-ref t: A class's average = the sum of its pixels' brightness ÷ the number of its pixels. <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> divides by the number of all the pixels, which cancels when one average is divided by another.
一组噪声 ε → 老师用它画出的斑点: A set of noise ε → the blob the teacher drew with it
一组测试：挪了位置、带噪点的 O: One test set: an O that has moved and has noise
一组规则的条纹，在频谱里只占一对点；照片本身的内容散在各处。把那对点挖掉，条纹就: A regular stripe pattern takes up just one pair of dots in the spectrum, while the photo's own content is spread all over. Dig out that pair and the stripes are gone, with the photo hardly touched. "Descreen" in photo editors, and removing moiré from scans, work this way.
一组规则的条纹，在频谱里是什么样子？照片本身的内容又在频谱的哪里？: What does a regular set of stripes look like in a spectrum? And where in the spectrum is the photo's own content?
一轮两点都是内点的概率是 p²，k 轮全落空的概率是 (1 − p²)ᵏ。要成功: The chance that both points of a round are inliers is p², and the chance that all k rounds miss is (1 − p²)ᵏ. To reach a success rate P you need k ≥ log(1 − P) / log(1 − pⁿ): with p = 0.5, n = 2 and P = 0.99 that is 17 rounds, and with only 30% inliers it takes 49. The number of rounds is set by the inlier ratio and δ by the noise; neither can stand in for the other.
一道 32 个点的波：cos 或 sin(2π·k·x/32)，在 −1 和 1: A wave of 32 points: cos or sin(2π·k·x/32), swinging between −1 and 1
一道 k = 5 的波。减少采样点数，直到从点上再也看不出原来的波。能看对的最少: A k = 5 wave. Reduce the number of samples until the points no longer show the original wave. What is the fewest that still reads it correctly?
一道<b>波</b>是明暗规律起伏的条纹。一行上的波只要四个数：平均亮度 c、振: A wave is a stripe pattern whose brightness rises and falls regularly. A wave along a row takes just four numbers: the average brightness c, the amplitude A (how far light and dark differ), the frequency k (how many cycles across the whole width) and the phase φ (how far the whole wave is slid along).
一道波就是明暗规律起伏的条纹，像斑马线，像百叶窗透进来的光。一行里出现几次「暗—: A wave is stripes of light and dark that rise and fall regularly, like a zebra crossing or light through a blind. The number of times "dark—light—dark" appears along a row is the number of cycles; the more cycles, the denser the stripes and the higher the frequency.
一道波由四个数决定：c、A、k、φ。每一步只开放一个旋钮，把你的波调到和目标重合: A wave is set by four numbers: c, A, k and φ. Each step opens one knob: lay your wave on the target. In the last step all four are open.
三张候选里有一张和要找的是同一张照片，只是挪了一点、调了颜色或加了噪声。是它的那: One of the three candidates is the same photo as the one to find, only shifted a little, recoloured or noisy. Output 1 on its line and 0 on the others.
三张照片按固定的系数相减，得到反射率乘上法线的三个分量 ρ·(nx, ny, n: Subtracting the three photos with fixed weights gives the reflectance times each component of the normal: ρ·(nx, ny, nz). A normal has length 1, so the length of this vector is the reflectance ρ and its direction is the normal. Three lamps, three equations, three unknowns (with ρ there are four numbers, and "length 1" supplies the last one).
三点平均、方块模糊、差分，都是把挪了位置的几份原图乘上系数再加起来。换一组挪法和: The three-point average, the box blur and the differences all add up a few shifted copies of the picture, each multiplied by a number. A different set of shifts and numbers gives a different effect.
三组测试：有噪声的方块、一根细柱、一个更近的噪声方块。同一个窗口要三组都算对：和: Three test sets: a noisy square, a thin pillar, and a closer noisy square. A single window must get all three right: within 1 of the true disparity, with only a few wrong pixels.
三选一时，网络先给每一类打一个分。可分数可正可负，加起来也不是 1，不能直接当成: Choosing one of three, the network first gives each class a score. But scores can be positive or negative and do not add up to 1, so they cannot be read as "how sure" directly.
上一段已有 A、B 和 A+B。增加 Gx×Gy 和 3×3 平均得到 C；分别: The previous circuit already has A, B and A+B. Multiply Gx and Gy and average over 3×3 for C; calculate AB−C² and 0.05×(A+B)², subtract, then multiply by 100. The 0.05 controls the penalty for edges; 100 only scales the response.
上两关各求出了一部分。坡度只和朝向有关。: The last two levels each worked out part of it. The slope depends only on the facing.
不是每关都要搭电路。<b>机关台</b>是一张可以动手的图：拖动、拧旋钮、推推杆: Not every level is a circuit. A bench is a figure you can work with your hands: drag things, turn knobs, push sliders, and the figure changes at once, showing live whether the goals are met.
不用告诉它什么是前景，k 均值自己把像素分成两堆。可它只看亮度：亮度一样的两样东: Without being told what the foreground is, k-means splits the pixels into two heaps by itself. But it looks only at brightness: two things of the same brightness, it cannot tell apart.
不知道灯暗了多少，能不能在图里找一把跟着灯光一起变长变短的尺子？: You don't know how much the light dimmed. Can you find a ruler inside the image that grows and shrinks with the light?
不要只比较两只苹果的 R；分别看看每只苹果的 R 与自己的 G、B 有什么关系，: Do not compare only the apples' R values. Compare each apple's R with its own G and B, then change the light and try again.
不过核有两种读法。<b>互相关</b>把核直接盖在图上，对应位置相乘再相加；<b: But there are two ways to read a kernel. Cross-correlation lays the kernel straight over the image, multiplying matching positions and adding; convolution first rotates the kernel by 180°. A bright dot put through a convolution comes out as the kernel the right way up; through a cross-correlation, as the kernel turned by 180°.
东西在哪、有多大: Where things are, and how big
两个元件的权重都靠训练：按下训练，机器自己一点点调。编码器可以选压成 1、2 或: Both parts get their weights from training: press Train and the machine adjusts them bit by bit on its own. You can choose whether the encoder squeezes to 1, 2 or 3 numbers. Compression and denoising both start from this step.
两个单位长度的方向，夹角的 cos 等于它们的分量两两相乘再相加。: For two directions of unit length, the cos of the angle between them is their components multiplied pairwise and added.
两个可训练的数：分布有多散: Two trainable numbers: how spread out the distribution is
两个可训练的数：分布的中心: Two trainable numbers: the centre of the distribution
两个数 → 一个斑点：z₁ 管左右，z₂ 管上下: Two numbers → one blob: z₁ moves it left–right, z₂ up–down
两个数记住一张图: Two numbers to remember an image
两个方向的坡度合成一个长度，边缘强度就和边的方向无关了：横边、竖边、斜边一样亮。: Combining the slopes in two directions into one length makes edge strength independent of edge direction: horizontal, vertical and diagonal edges are equally bright. The direction itself is atan2(gy, gx); the arrow always points where the brightness rises fastest, and on an edge it is perpendicular to the edge. Draw the input in the "Slope" view: the arrows are drawn at every pixel.
两个旋钮一起下山。山谷又窄又长时，学习率大了会在两侧来回冲，小了又走得很慢。: Both knobs walk downhill together. When the valley is long and narrow, a large learning rate bounces from side to side, and a small one crawls.
两个旋钮时，误差是一片地形，梯度是一个箭头，指向上坡最陡的方向。这片山谷又窄又长: With two knobs the error is a landscape, and the gradient is an arrow pointing up the steepest slope. This valley is long and narrow, so the gradient keeps pointing at the valley walls and the path zig-zags. w × input + b has a name: a dense layer (here with a single input).
两个框画成掩膜（框里是 1）。输出它们的交并比 IoU = 交集的面积 ÷ 并集: Two boxes drawn as masks (1 inside the box). Output their intersection over union, IoU = area of the intersection ÷ area of the union.
两个点的<part-ref to=\"cross\"></part-ref>是过: The <part-ref to="cross"></part-ref> of two points is the line through them, and of two lines the point where they meet, (X, Y, W), standing for (X/W, Y/W); parallel lines have W = 0 and meet at infinity.
两个输入：「标准件」是合格零件的照片，「实物」是传送带上这一件，位置已经对齐。零: Two inputs: the "Reference" is a photo of a good part, and the "Part" is the one on the belt, already lined up. The part itself has light and dark areas.
两千多年前，《墨经》就记下过：暗室的墙上开个小孔，屋外的景物会在对面墙上成一个倒: More than two thousand years ago, the Mohist Canon recorded that if you open a small hole in the wall of a dark room, the scene outside forms an upside-down image on the opposite wall. This is the pinhole camera; the dark room with the hole is called a camera obscura, the earliest form of the camera.
两只眼睛怎样看出远近: How do two eyes judge distance?
两只苹果的颜色不同，在同一盏白灯下。调节光照强度，比较各自的 R、G、B 图与数: Two differently coloured apples sit under the same neutral white lamp. Adjust the light intensity, compare their R, G and B images and values, and find the red apple.
两台相机摆正时，对应点总在同一行，只需沿着这一行找：右图挪几格时和左图最像。这叫: When the two cameras are lined up, corresponding points are always on the same row, so the search only runs along that row: which shift of the right image matches the left one best. This is stereo matching. Random-dot images show that people can see depth without recognising any object.
两台相机的相对位置可以事先标定，记成一个 3×3 的<b>基础矩阵</b> F。: The cameras’ relative position can be calibrated in advance and recorded as a 3×3 fundamental matrix F. The epipolar line of a left-image point p is l′ = F·p, written a·u′ + b·v′ + c = 0; where the point lands on that line depends on how far away it is.
两块布在日光下读数一样，换一盏灯就不一样了：它们的光谱不同，只是差别正好落在三种: The two cloths read the same in daylight and differently under another lamp: their spectra differ, but only where none of the three sensors can see. This is metamerism. It is why colours that match under the shop's lights can clash in the sun. Sensing is linear, so "subtract, then read" is the same as "read each, then subtract".
两张图各有一个图案被擦掉几格，它的孪生图案在同一张图的别处。两个输出分别是补好的: Each of two pictures has one pattern with a few pixels erased; its twin is elsewhere in the same picture. The two outputs are the two pictures mended.
两张图逐像素相乘：a × b: Multiplies two pictures pixel by pixel: a × b
两张图逐像素相减：a − b: Subtracts two pictures pixel by pixel: a − b
两张图逐像素相加、相减、相乘或相除。可将左侧或右侧设为常数，另一侧接线输入: Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides two pictures pixel by pixel. Either side can be set to a constant; the other receives a wire
两张图逐像素相加：a + b: Adds two pictures pixel by pixel: a + b
两张图逐格取较大的那个: Takes the larger of two pictures, cell by cell
两张图逐格按比例混合，得到的是两个淡斑点。<level-ref to=\"8-1: Mixing the two pictures cell by cell gives two faint blobs. What about <level-ref to="8-1"></level-ref>'s two numbers?
两张图逐格比较，每格输出较大的那个：max(a, b)。: Compare two pictures cell by cell and output the larger value in each: max(a, b).
两张图里各有一些好认的点，还要把它们配成对：左图的这个点，是右图的哪一个？最直接: Each image has some points that are easy to recognise, and they still have to be paired up: which point in the right image is this point from the left image? The most direct way is to compare how they look: take a small patch around it and search the right image for the most similar patch.
两张照片常常不是同时拍的，光线变了，同一处在右图里整体亮一截。: Two photos are often not taken at the same moment: the light changes, and the same place is brighter all over in the right one.
两格的和挪两格再加一次，就是四格的和；再补一格就是五格。已经算过的部分和，挪一挪: The sum of two cells, shifted two along and added again, is the sum of four; one more cell makes five. A partial sum already worked out can be shifted and reused, and shifting costs nothing. This doubling idea will come up again: the bigger the reach, the more it saves.
两次叉积就找到了交点，不用解方程。三个数 (X, Y, W) 表示点 (X/W,: Two cross products find the meeting point with no equations to solve. Three numbers (X, Y, W) stand for the point (X/W, Y/W); when the lines are parallel W = 0 and they meet at infinity, which homogeneous coordinates can still write down.
两盏灯照亮同一块表面，各自贡献的亮度会怎样合在一起？背对补光的地方呢？: Two lamps light the same surface: how do the brightnesses they each give combine? And where the surface faces away from the fill light?
两组特征有多像，可以用余弦相似度来量：长度为 1 的两组特征，对应相乘再加起来。: How alike two sets of features are can be measured by cosine similarity: for two sets of features of length 1, multiply them pair by pair and add up.
两边轮流训练。你能定每回合鉴定员练几步、生成器练几步，以及生成器每步走多远。: The two sides train in turns. You decide how many steps the judge trains each round, how many the generator trains, and how far the generator moves with each step.
中心化、取对数的幅度谱：中心是平均亮度，越往外变化越快: The centred, log-scaled magnitude spectrum: the centre is the average brightness, and further out means faster change
中间最窄的那层叫<b>瓶颈</b>。它至少要有图像真正变化的那么多个数：一族图只: The narrowest layer in the middle is the bottleneck. It needs at least as many numbers as the ways the images really vary: a family of images that varies only left–right and up–down needs at least two numbers, since one number can only move along a single line.
为什么是「1 减去输入」？亮度都在 0 到 1 之间。只把每格乘 −1，暗的 0: Why "1 minus the input"? Brightness always lies between 0 and 1. Multiply each cell by −1 alone and a dark 0.3 becomes −0.3 while a bright 0.9 becomes −0.9: light and dark are swapped, but every number has dropped below 0, darker than black. Add 1 to every cell and the whole picture is lifted back into 0 … 1: −0.3 + 1 = 0.7 and −0.9 + 1 = 0.1. So "multiply by −1, then add 1" is 1 − input: what was brighter is now darker.
主灯不变，再从左边低处加一盏补光，方向 (−0.8, 0, 0.6)，强度是主灯: Keep the main lamp and add a fill light low on the left, from direction (−0.8, 0, 0.6), at half the main lamp's strength. Draw what the surface looks like under both lamps.
之前的 3×3 平均、高斯，是在图上让每个像素和邻居混一混。这一关从频率那边下手: The 3×3 average and the Gaussian worked on the picture, mixing each pixel with its neighbours. This level works from the frequency side, and the result is a blur too. Something to think about: how are the two approaches related?
乘积整体偏在 0 的上面还是下面？什么时候正负刚好抵消？: Does the product sit above or below 0 overall? When do plus and minus cancel exactly?
九个格子挨个加要 8 次加法。3×3 的方块，能不能拆成几步更小的平均？: Adding up nine cells one by one takes 8 additions. Can the 3×3 block be split into a few smaller averages?
二值掩膜和原图同样大，每格的 0 或 1 记录类别。它保留前景的形状和位置；亮度: A binary mask has the same size as the image, and each 0 or 1 records a class. It retains the foreground shape and location. If foreground and background intensities overlap, one threshold will mislabel pixels.
二维图像的频谱也是一张图：每一格 (kx, ky) 代表一道波，越亮说明图里这道: The spectrum of a 2-D image is itself an image: each cell (kx, ky) stands for one wave, and the brighter it is, the stronger that wave is in the picture. The very centre is frequency (0, 0), the average brightness, called the DC component.
于是二维搜索变成了一维，省下大量比较。所有极线都汇向同一点，叫极点。: So a 2-D search becomes 1-D, saving a great many comparisons. All the epipolar lines meet at one point, the epipole.
交集是两张掩膜逐格相乘。并集 = 两个面积相加，再减去重复算的那部分。<part: The intersection is the two masks multiplied cell by cell. The union = the two areas added, minus the part counted twice. Areas measured with <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> are all off by the same factor.
Metal sheets on the line are painted unevenly, some patches darker than others. Each sheet is photographed under three lamps: from the right (0.6, 0, 0.8), from below (0, 0.6, 0.8) and from the front (0, 0, 1). Mark where the surface leans to the right: where the normal's x component is more than 0.15 times its z component.
产线上的金属板刷了漆，要检查有没有磕出的凹坑和划痕。坑和划痕改变的是表面的朝向，: Painted metal sheets on a line must be checked for dents and scratches. These change which way the surface faces, but the paint is uneven, so the shading in a single photo cannot tell paint from dent. The last three levels of this chapter build this inspection machine.
亮于 0.5 的每个点给经过它的所有直线 x·cosθ + y·sinθ = ρ: Every point brighter than 0.5 votes for each line x·cosθ + y·sinθ = ρ through it: across is θ (16 cells, 0° … 180°), down is ρ (2 pixels a cell)
亮块是第 2 块，暗块是第 3 块：亮在前，期望全是 1: The bright patch is number 2 and the dark one number 3: bright comes first, so expect all 1s
亮底图直接做 3×3 平均: A plain 3×3 average of an image on a bright background
亮度变了也配得上: Matching through a change of light
亮度要超过多少，它才输出 1？: How bright must a cell be before it outputs 1?
亮条贴左边: Bright bar on the left edge
亮点、投票、找峰：Hough 把「找一条线」变成「在累加器里找峰」，挡掉了零散的: Points, votes, peaks: Hough turns "find a line" into "find a peak in the accumulator", which ignores scattered specks and still finds a line broken into pieces. The first lane-keeping systems worked exactly like this.
亮点会变成核的样子。可你的元件是怎样读核的？把你填的核喂一个亮点，看看出来的是什: A bright dot turns into the shape of the kernel. But how does your part read its kernel? Feed a bright dot to the kernel you entered and see what comes out.
亮点被处理成什么样，就是这种处理的「印章」：每个输入像素都盖一个，挪到对应位置、: Whatever a bright dot is turned into is the "stamp" of the processing: every input pixel presses one, moved to its place, multiplied by its weight and added up. Arrange the weights in a small 3×3 grid and you have a kernel.
从 N(μ, σ²) 里抽一个 z，交给解码器画出来。抽样用输入里的噪声 ε。: Draw a z from N(μ, σ²) and hand it to the decoder. Use the noise ε from the input to draw it.
从「输入」元件右边的圆点按住，拖到「输出」元件左边的圆点。: Press on the dot on the right of the "Input" part and drag it to the dot on the left of the "Output" part.
从几对例子里学到的核，换成没见过的照片照样对：这才是学会了，而不是背下了。训练面: A kernel learned from a few example pairs works just as well on photos it has never seen: that is learning, not memorising. In the training panel, the training error is measured on the samples it learns from, and the new-sample error on samples it was never shown. From now on, a model is judged by the second.
从同一张干净图出发，改变时间步 t，比较原图和噪声各占多少。先看懂扩散怎样破坏图: Start from one clean image and vary timestep t to compare how much original signal and noise remain. Understand how diffusion corrupts the image before using predicted noise to recover it.
从图片到类别，网络先提取局部特征，再把特征汇总成类别分数。AlexNet 把卷积: From image to class, a network first extracts local features and then combines them into class scores. AlexNet combined convolution, activation, pooling and classification layers and trained on many images; this level is a much smaller classification example.
Drag from a point on the cover to the same point in the photo to make a pair of corresponding points. The cover is pasted back onto the photo; you pass when the mean error is under 1.5 pixels.
从正态分布里随机抽 z 交给解码器，就能画出没见过的图，这就是生成。随机不是乱来: Draw z at random from a normal distribution and hand it to the decoder, and you can draw pictures never seen before: this is generation. Random does not mean arbitrary: the numbers mostly fall near the centre μ, more spread out the larger σ is. In a VAE (variational autoencoder), the encoder outputs this μ and σ.
从给定的起始分界出发做三步 k 均值，再按最后的分界把每个像素分成两类：亮的一类: Starting from the given boundary, take three k-means steps, then split every pixel into two classes by the final boundary: output 1 for the bright class.
从这一章起，相加、相减、相乘合成一个元件<part-ref to=\"part:: From this chapter on, add, subtract and multiply are one part, <part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>: choose +, −, × or ÷ on the part. ÷ is new: a ÷ b divides each cell of a by the same cell of b. There is also a new part, the <part-ref to="part:merge"></part-ref>: it has three inputs and adds the pictures wired into them cell by cell; an empty input is skipped.
仓库的机器人要盘点货架：找出所有贴了 X 的箱子。照片有噪点。: A warehouse robot has to take stock of a shelf: find every box marked X. The photo is grainy.
以图块 a 为查询，a 和 b 各自作为键和值。分别计算 a 与 a、a 与 b: Use patch a as the query, with a and b each acting as a key and a value. Compute scores for a with a and a with b: score = 4 × average(a × corresponding patch). Apply Softmax to the two scores: weight = e^score ÷ the sum of both e^score. Output the weighted sum of patches a and b.
任何一条亮度曲线都能拆成一组正弦波：每个频率一个振幅，再加一个相位。这组振幅，就: Any brightness curve can be taken apart into a set of sine waves: one amplitude for each frequency, plus a phase. That set of amplitudes is the curve’s <part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>.
任何只含加、减和乘常数的组合都是线性的，正负号必然对称。「负数变 0、正数不变」: Any combination of adding, subtracting and multiplying by constants is linear, so the signs are bound to be symmetric. "Negatives become 0, positives stay" is called ReLU. Only with a nonlinearity in between can a network express "I want both". This is why neural networks need activation functions.
任务说明下面有「提示」按钮，卡住时再点开。提示说得比较直接，先自己试一试收获更大: Below the task there is a “Hint” button for when you are stuck. Hints are fairly direct, so it pays to try on your own first.
传感器把世界变成一格格数字，可你还看不懂它们。: Your sensor turns the world into a grid of numbers, but you cannot read them yet.
传送带上的零件有三种：X、O 和 +，位置、深浅都不一样，有的带噪点。输出三个概: The parts on the belt come in three kinds, X, O and +, at different places and strengths, some with noise. Output three probabilities: above 0.55 for the right class, below 0.45 for the other two. The "new parts" at the end of the list take no part in training and are only checked.
伸出一根手指放在眼前，轮流闭上左眼和右眼：手指和远处的墙，哪个跳得更厉害？同一样: Hold a finger up in front of your eyes and close your left and right eye in turn: which jumps more, your finger or the far wall? The distance by which the same thing is offset between your two eyes is called disparity.
低频留下、高频压掉。一刀切的增益会在边旁边留下一圈圈波纹，看误差图。: Keep the low frequencies, press down the high ones. A gain that cuts off sharply leaves rings beside the edges: look at the error map.
你先用 3×3 平均减弱噪声，再用横向差分量亮度变化，最后用阈值留下强响应。接下: You used a 3×3 average to reduce noise, a horizontal difference to measure intensity change, and a threshold to keep strong responses. The Sobel filters you unlock also combine differentiation and smoothing. Sobel x takes a horizontal difference with weighted vertical smoothing, while Sobel y swaps the two directions.
你只有低通。原图里去掉低频，还剩下什么？: You only have a low-pass. Take the low frequencies out of an image: what is left?
你已经能从结果反推核：全正且和为 1 是平滑，越集中越接近原图；和为 0 的核只: You can now work back from a result to its kernel. All positive and summing to 1 is smoothing, and the more concentrated, the closer to the original. A kernel that sums to 0 responds only to change: a derivative. A large centre with negative neighbours is sharpening. A single 1 is a shift, moving the opposite way from where the 1 sits.
你拼出的就是「复制边缘」：图外缺的值，用离它最近的边上像素代替，不会凭空造出一道: What you built is "Replicate edge": a missing value outside the image is replaced by the nearest pixel on the edge, so no black border appears out of nowhere.
你没有设计这个核，它是从例子里学出来的。手工设计的特征，就这样被学到的特征取代了: You didn't design this kernel; it was learned from examples. This is how learned features replace hand-designed ones.
你用差分找过台阶：暗→亮是正，亮→暗是负，符号还能告诉你边朝哪边。可很多时候只关: You found steps with a difference: dark→bright is positive, bright→dark negative, and the sign even tells you which way the edge faces. But often all that matters is "is there an edge here", whatever its direction.
你看到的每一张图，都只是一格一格的数字。把鼠标停在任意一格上，看看它是多少。: Every image you see is just a grid of numbers, cell by cell. Hover over any cell to see its value.
你能自己造一道 k = 3 的波。怎样把它和输入放在一起算，才能让 k = 3: You can make a k = 3 wave yourself. How can you combine it with the input so the k = 3 part stays and the other frequencies cancel out? But what if the hidden wave is shifted?
你训练的 3×3 核学会了「和邻居差得多的是噪声」，还原以后笔画就清楚了。扩散模: The 3×3 kernel you trained learnt that "what differs a lot from its neighbours is noise", and after restoring, the strokes are clear. A diffusion model's denoising network is far bigger: starting from pure noise it guesses the noise and removes a little, step after step, until a picture never seen before appears. Every step does what this level does.
你需要「往左挪一格」的图、「往右挪一格」的图和原图。: You need the image shifted one pixel left, the image shifted one pixel right, and the original.
修图软件的滤镜、相机里的锐化，背后常常就是一个核。这一关反过来：别人用一个核处理: Behind photo-editor filters and in-camera sharpening there is often just a kernel. This level turns that around: someone has processed a few images with a kernel, and from only the inputs and outputs you must find that kernel.
修正量按锚框的大小来算，大框小框用同一套数；宽高用 e 的指数，修正是正是负都不: The corrections are scaled by the anchor's size, so big and small boxes use the same numbers; width and height go through e to the power, so whatever the sign of a correction, the box never gets a negative width. Faster R-CNN and YOLO both regress boxes like this.
做出和目标一样的柔和模糊（σ ≈ 1.4 的高斯）。手里只有 3×3 平均。: Make the same soft blur as the target (a Gaussian with σ ≈ 1.4). All you have is the 3×3 average.
像不像用距离 d 来量：两块逐格相减、平方、加起来再开方，d 越小越像。每个点在: Similarity is measured by a distance d: subtract the two patches pixel by pixel, square, add up, then take the square root. The smaller d is, the more alike they are. For each point, the closest match in the right image is first place, at distance d₁; the next is second place, at distance d₂.
像的大小只看比例：x = −f·X/Z，X 是物体的高度，Z 是物体到孔的距离，: The size of the image depends only on a ratio: x = −f·X/Z, where X is the object’s height, Z its distance from the hole and f the distance from the hole to the screen; the minus sign means the image is upside down. The further away something is, the smaller its image: this is perspective projection.
像素空间里的中间是两张图叠在一起；潜空间里的中间才是「一个斑点在中间」。训练好的: Halfway in pixel space is two pictures laid over each other; halfway in latent space is "one blob in between". A trained encoder puts pictures into a smooth space, and walking a straight line there decodes into a natural transition: making a face older or changing a hairstyle works like this.
像高只看比例：x = −f·X/Z，屏幕离孔越远、物体离孔越近，像越大，而且总是: Image height depends only on a ratio: x = −f·X/Z. The farther the screen is from the hole and the nearer the object, the bigger the image, and it is always upside down. The bigger the hole, the bigger the spot D·(Z+f)/Z that light from one point spreads into on the screen, so the image gets brighter and blurrier; moving the screen closer also makes it brighter.
元件上的结果随时更新，但过没过要按「运行测试」才算。测试全部通过，这一关就完成了: The results on the parts update all the time, but whether they pass only counts once you press “Run tests”. When every test passes, the level is complete; if not, the first failing test is selected for you. After any change to the circuit, the tests need running again.
元件可以一个接一个地串起来：前一个的输出就是后一个的输入。几个简单的元件串在一起: Parts can be chained one after another: the output of one is the input of the next. A few simple parts in a row can do what no single part can. That is a circuit.
先做一张只在半径 6 以外为 1 的图，用它把频谱的内圈遮住。: First make a picture that is 1 only beyond radius 6, and use it to mask out the inner part of the spectrum.
先做出补 0 的平移：它只错在最左一列。能不能单独拿到「原图的最左一列，其余全是: First build the zero-padded shift: it is wrong only in the leftmost column. Can you get "the original's leftmost column, with 0 everywhere else" on its own?
先分别用 exp 处理两个分数，再求和。两个权重使用同一个分母。: Apply exp to each score, then add the results. The two weights share the same denominator.
先只调频率 1，看误差还剩哪些起伏，再一道道补上去。: Set frequency 1 first, see which wiggles are left over, then add waves one at a time.
先得到闯入者的掩膜。外圈的格子和里面的格子，邻居有什么不同？: Get the intruder's mask first. How do the neighbours of a cell on the ring differ from those of a cell further in?
先把图压成几个数，再由这几个数画回原图。用最少的数做到。: Squeeze the image into a few numbers, then draw the original back from those numbers. Do it with as few numbers as you can.
先把小图放大到块那么大；块里哪一格和放大后的值一样大？: First enlarge the small picture to block size; which cell of the block equals the enlarged value?
先把所有数乘 −1，再整体加上一个数。: First multiply every number by −1, then add one number to all of them.
先按 a1 加一次噪，再对结果按 a2 加一次噪。输出加了两次以后的图。: Add noise once with a1, then add noise to the result again with a2. Output the picture after both.
先挪、再放大，就把 [0.25, 0.75] 拉满了 [0, 1]。修图软件的「: Shift first, then scale, and [0.25, 0.75] fills all of [0, 1]. The "levels" and "contrast" tools in photo editors do exactly this. The order matters: scale first, and the amount you shift by has to change with it.
先横后竖还不够省。数一数电路里有几次加法；平移不花计算量。: Splitting into across and down is not cheap enough. Count the additions in your circuit; shifting costs nothing.
先横后竖，九次乘加变成六次。核能拆成一行乘一列时就能这样省，这叫可分离滤波；核越: Horizontal first, then vertical: nine multiply-adds become six. You can save like this whenever a kernel splits into a row times a column. This is separable filtering; the bigger the kernel, the more you save.
先比较两只苹果各自的 R、G、B 图。滑动光照强度，观察三张图和数值怎么变化；灯: First compare each apple's R, G and B images. Slide the light intensity and watch the three images and values change. The lamp is neutral white; only its strength changes. Then select the red apple.
先比较两条线差在哪：是整体高低、起伏大小、起伏的次数，还是起伏的位置？: Compare the two lines first: do they differ in overall height, in the size of the swing, in how many swings there are, or in where the swings sit?
先用 Sobel 和 3×3 平均观察附近的变化。直边也会有较强的变化，因此还要: First use Sobel and a 3×3 average to observe local change. Straight edges also change strongly, so distinguishing corners requires considering how the two directions change together.
先用法线的 z 分量表示正面光的照射程度，再想想表面只反回其中一部分光。: Use the normal’s z component for frontal illumination, then consider that the surface returns only a fraction of that light.
先看亮点那一组：一个亮点变成了几个点？各在哪里，各有多亮？: Look at the bright dot first: how many dots did one dot turn into? Where is each, and how bright?
先看只有两个类别的情况：把两个分数转换成两个非负、总和为 1 的权重，以便比较各: Start with two classes: turn their scores into two nonnegative weights that sum to 1, so their relative support can be compared. Here we use the Softmax rule.
先算出每一格周围 3×3 里最大的是多少。<part-ref to=\"max\: First work out the largest value in the 3×3 around each cell. <part-ref to="max"></part-ref> compares only two pictures at a time, so compare across first, then down.
先补零放大、再用一个核走一遍，就是步幅为 2 的转置卷积：核决定空出来的格子从哪: Zero-upsample first, then run a kernel over it: that is a transposed convolution with stride 2, and the kernel decides which neighbours, in what proportion, fill the empty cells. The decoder of a segmentation network uses it to enlarge small feature maps layer by layer back to the size of the picture.
先让最暗的那一格落到 0，再想要乘多少，最亮的才会落到 1。: First bring the darkest cell down to 0, then work out what to multiply by so the brightest lands on 1.
先让每个窗口减去自己的平均亮度，整体变亮就不影响距离了；再除以自己的标准差，连对: Subtract each window's own mean brightness first, and an overall brightening no longer affects the distance; divide by its own standard deviation as well, and even a contrast change does not matter. This is the idea behind normalised cross-correlation (NCC), and SIFT descriptors are normalised in a similar way.
先让每格和右边、下边的邻居比一比，留下最大的，再隔点取样：每个 2×2 块只留下: First let each pixel compare itself with its neighbours to the right and below and keep the largest, then downsample: each 2×2 block keeps only its strongest value, and a point moving within its block does not change the answer. This is max pooling. The price is losing the exact position inside the block.
先训练两层卷积，观察每一层如何扩大看到的范围。接着尝试训练六层网络，看看怎样让信: First train two convolution layers and observe how each expands the area seen. Then try training a six-layer network and see how to help signals travel through it.
先试一个神经元，在纸上画画这些点：一条直线分得开吗？神经元的输出，也可以交给另一: Try one neuron first, and sketch the points on paper: can a straight line separate them? A neuron's output can be fed to another neuron. If several neurons start with exactly the same weights, can training ever make them differ?
先逐格相乘，再对整块图取平均，分别得到两个分数。Softmax 的第三输入可留空: Multiply pixel by pixel and average over each patch to obtain two scores. Leave Softmax’s third input empty; multiply its output weights by the corresponding patches and add.
光是相加的：两盏灯照出的亮度，等于各自照出的亮度之和。背对补光的那一面得不到补光: Light adds up: the brightness under two lamps is the sum of what each gives on its own. The side facing away from the fill light gets none of it, and brightness cannot be negative, so it is cut off at 0. A key light plus a fill light in a studio, or many lights in a game, are added up lamp by lamp just like this.
光照不均时，单看亮不亮会误判。先比一比两张图哪里不一样。: With uneven lighting, judging by brightness alone goes wrong. First compare where the two images differ.
具体地说，每个图块有查询 q、键 k 和值 v：打分是 q·k/√d，softm: In detail, each patch has a query q, a key k and a value v: the score is q·k/√d, softmax turns the scores into weights that add up to 1, and the v of every patch are averaged with those weights. ViT, from 2020, handles images this way.
凹坑检测台用的就是光度立体：几盏灯轮流打光，解出每一点的朝向，坑和划痕在朝向图里: This dent detector is photometric stereo at work: a few lamps light the part in turn, the facing at every point is solved, and dents and scratches stand out in the map of facings, whatever the paint does. Document scanning on phones and steel-sheet inspection in factories use the same approach.
分两类、各求中心、再分：这是 k 均值的一步。重复几步，分界就停在两堆像素之间。: Split into two, find each centre, split again: that is one step of k-means. Repeat a few steps and the boundary settles between the two heaps of pixels.
分别对两个分数取指数，再将每个结果除以两者之和。先亲手搭出这个计算，之后就可以使: Take the exponential of each score, then divide each result by their sum. Build this calculation first; afterwards the Softmax part becomes available.
分别计算图像左右和上下方向的梯度，将它们各自平方，用 3×3 平均统计附近的变化: Calculate horizontal and vertical gradients, square each, average each over 3×3, and add them. Compare the results at straight edges and corners.
分割给图上每个像素一个标签。这里做二值分割：亮细胞是前景，暗底是背景。接线之前，: Segmentation assigns a label to every pixel. Here we do binary segmentation: bright cells are foreground and the dark field is background. Before wiring, find the column between the two bright regions that should be background.
分割要给每个像素一个答案，网络缩小以后还得放大回来。<b>转置卷积</b>先补零: Segmentation gives an answer for every pixel, so after shrinking, a network has to enlarge again. A transposed convolution zero-upsamples to twice the size, then fills the gaps with a kernel, which decides which neighbours fill each gap and in what proportion, and can be learnt.
分可能是负数，直接除以总和会出错。exp 把任何数变成正数。: Scores can be negative, so dividing by their sum goes wrong. exp turns any number positive.
分拣机正式上线：零件的位置、深浅都不一样，有的带噪点。最后几组是「新零件」，不参: The sorter goes live: parts sit in different places, at different strengths, some with noise. The last few sets are "new parts" that take no part in training and are only checked.
分拣机要把零件分成三类：X、O 和 +。网络先给每类打一个分，S1、S2、S3: The sorting machine has to put parts into three classes: X, O and +. The network first gives each class a score: S1, S2 and S3 correspond to X, O and +. Scores may be positive or negative. Turn the three scores into three probabilities, each between 0 and 1, adding up to 1, with a higher score getting a higher probability. The expected output uses e^score ÷ the sum of the three e^score.
分拣机要辨认 X、O、+ 三种零件。相机拍一张，网络先给每一类打一个分，再判断它: The sorting machine needs to recognise X, O and + parts. From a camera image, the network first gives each class a score and then decides which kind it is.
分类器判断图像属于哪一类时，通常先为每个类别输出一个分数。分数可以是负数，也不一: A classifier usually gives each possible class a score. Scores can be negative and do not necessarily sum to 1.
分类器的分数，是每一格的亮度乘它的权重，全部加起来。输出每一格给分数加了多少。: The classifier's score is every cell's brightness times its weight, all added up. Output how much each cell adds to the score.
分类器答对了，不等于它看对了地方：训练集里车总在路上，只认路也能全对。这种<b>: A classifier that answers right has not necessarily looked in the right place: in a training set where cars always stand on roads, recognising the road alone gets everything right. Such a shortcut is only found by checking where the model looks.
切成 P×P 图块；每块按 softmax(q·k/√d) 对所有块的 v 加权: Cuts the image into P×P patches; each patch takes the average of every patch's v, weighted by softmax(q·k/√d). With only Q wired, K and V use it too
切换 Q、交换 K 或 V，比较权重和输出的变化。然后将 Q 设为 X、K 保持: Change Q and swap K or V to compare the weights and output. Then set Q to X, keep K in its original arrangement, swap V, and select the more prominent pattern in the output.
别把图边当纸边: The image edge is not the paper edge
别的频率在平均里都抵消了，只剩频率 5 那道波振幅的一半：cos 自己乘自己，平: The other frequencies all cancel in the average, leaving half the amplitude of the frequency-5 wave: a cos times itself averages ½, so the reading takes a factor of 2.
到现在为止，元件的输出都和输入一样大。真正的卷积网络里，图往往一层层变小：一张照: So far every part's output has been as big as its input. In a real convolutional network the picture usually shrinks layer by layer: a photo has millions of pixels, and only after shrinking can the later layers keep up.
到目前为止，输出的每一格只看输入里同一位置的那一格。这一章换个思路：算一格时，也: So far, each output cell has looked only at the cell in the same position in the input. This chapter changes that: when computing a cell, also look at the neighbours around it.
到这里为止，两台相机都摆得很正，同一点总在同一行，只要左右找。真实的相机很难摆得: So far the two cameras have been set up perfectly straight, so the same point was always on the same row and you only had to search left and right. Real cameras are hard to align that well; turn one slightly and the same point moves to a different row.
到这里为止，看的都是一块表面。真实照片里，表面本来的颜色和照到的光混在一起：白墙: So far you have looked at a single surface. In a real photo, a surface's own colour and the light falling on it are mixed together: a white wall in shadow looks grey, and dark floor tiles in sunlight can look very bright.
前三关各管一件事：先模糊再取样、糊多少、在小图上做事更便宜。: Each of the last three levels settled one thing: blur before sampling, how much to blur, and working on small pictures being cheaper.
前几章的网络越往后图越小：池化、隔点取样一层层把 16×16 缩成几个数，最后回: The networks of earlier chapters make the picture smaller and smaller: pooling and downsampling shrink 16×16 to a few numbers that answer "what is this?". But to ask "what is every pixel?", the answer has to be as big as the original.
前几章的训练都靠标签：每张图配一个人写的答案。可现实里绝大多数照片没有标签，给上: Training in earlier chapters relied on labels: every image came with an answer written by a person. But in the real world almost no photos have labels, and labelling millions of images one by one is slow and expensive. Can a model still learn without answers?
前几章，元件的参数都是你亲手定的：模糊多少、阈值多高。可手机相册认人脸、语音输入: In earlier chapters you set every part's parameters by hand: how much blur, how high a threshold. But the models behind face recognition in your photo app or voice typing have thousands upon thousands of numbers, and nobody can turn them one by one. The machine has to tune itself.
前面一直在看邻居：一个像素和旁边的像素差多少。这一章换个角度，把一张图看成许多道: So far we have looked at neighbours: how much a pixel differs from the ones beside it. This chapter takes another view and sees a picture as many waves added together. It starts with the simplest thing: one wave.
前面每一关都解决了这里的一个麻烦。: Each of the last few levels dealt with one of the troubles here.
前面用重建误差训练编码器和解码器。对抗训练换了一个训练信号：判别器尝试区分真样本: Earlier, reconstruction error trained the encoder and decoder. Adversarial training uses a different signal: a discriminator tries to tell real and generated samples apart, and the generator improves its output using that judgement.
前面练过的几步，接起来。: The steps you have practised, joined up.
办法之一是<b>提前停止</b>：在验证误差最低时停下。办法之二是<b>正则化<: One fix is early stopping: stop where the validation error is lowest. Another is regularisation: put a cost on large weights (L2), so the model will not bend the curve sharply just to hit a few points.
办法是先平滑、再求导：噪声被压下去，真正的边留下来。<b>Sobel 算子</b: The fix is to smooth first and then differentiate: the noise is pushed down and the real edge stays. The Sobel operator puts both steps into one 3×3 kernel: it differentiates in one direction and smooths with weights 1, 2, 1 in the other.
加到哪一步，用一个数 ᾱ 表示图还剩多少：1 是原图，0 是纯噪声。: How far it has gone is given by one number, ᾱ, how much of the picture is left: 1 is the original, 0 is pure noise.
加噪是往前走。生成一张图要往回走：从噪声里把图找回来。: Adding noise goes forwards. Generating a picture goes backwards: finding the picture again in the noise.
加宽基线或换长焦能让远处更准，却让近处的视差变大、超出搜索范围，两张图的外观也差: A wider baseline or a longer lens makes far things more precise, but makes the disparity of near things bigger, past the search range, and the two images look more different too. Only the product f·b matters, so you trade off “near things still match” against “far things are precise enough”.
加得太多，边缘旁会出现一道明显的亮边和暗边。锐化并不能找回丢失的信息，只是让已有: Add too much and an obvious bright and dark halo appears beside each edge. Sharpening cannot recover lost information; it only makes the changes already there stand out.
加成灰度图试试：红和绿一样亮时，交界就消失了。那三个通道该怎样处理，才不会丢掉这: Try adding them into a greyscale image: when red and green are equally bright, the border disappears. So how should the three channels be handled so this edge is not lost? For training, you can first subtract 0.5 from each channel to centre the data around zero.
加权和再压一下，就是一个神经元。w1·斜 + w2·弯 + b = 0 是平面上: A weighted sum and then a squash: that is a neuron. w1·diagonal + w2·curved + b = 0 is a straight line in the plane, and the neuron says "yes" on one side and "no" on the other: one neuron is one dividing line. The squash 1 / (1 + e^(−z)) is called the sigmoid.
加起来为 0 的核在平坦处输出 0，只对变化有反应，是在求导。中心大、四周为负的: A kernel that adds up to 0 gives 0 on flat ground and responds only to change: it is a derivative. A large centre with negative surroundings is sharpening. A kernel with a single 1 is a shift: read as cross-correlation, the image moves the opposite way from where the 1 sits off-centre.
匹配、RANSAC 选内点、解单应、变形贴图：这条流水线就是 AR 书封面、全景: Match, choose inliers with RANSAC, solve the homography, warp and paste: this pipeline is the core of AR book covers, panorama stitching and document-scanning apps, and you have built every step of it yourself.
十二层和六层一样好训：每一块一开始都原样通过，训练只需让少数几块学出那一点改动，: Twelve layers train as easily as six: every block starts out passing its input straight through, training only has to teach a few of them the small change, and the gradient reaches every layer along the shortcuts. This is how ResNet stacks networks to more than a hundred layers.
十章下来，你的电路能找边、认字母、量距离、框出东西。可一个分类器说「这是车」的时: Ten chapters on, your circuits find edges, read letters, measure distance and box things in. But when a classifier says "this is a car", how do you know it said so looking at the car? Every car in the training photos stood on a road, and recognising the road alone would sort them all correctly.
单应矩阵 H 有 8 个自由度，每对点给 2 个方程，所以至少要 4 对点，游戏: The homography H has 8 degrees of freedom and each pair of points gives 2 equations, so it needs at least 4 pairs; the game solved H from your pairs with DLT. Three pairs only fix an affine map (6 degrees of freedom), which keeps lines parallel and cannot fit a book seen in perspective. In a real pipeline the pairs come from candidates that passed the ratio test, and RANSAC picks them by repeatedly drawing 4 pairs and counting inliers.
卷积、互相关与冲激响应: Convolution, cross-correlation and the impulse response
卷积一次处理局部区域；注意力可以让一个图块汇总来自其他图块的信息。本关先观察 Q: Convolution processes a local region at a time; attention lets a patch combine information from other patches. First explore Q, K and V, then build an attention circuit, and finally train simplified transformations that produce Q, K and V.
卷积只看身边一小圈，线索在图的另一头时，要叠很多层才够得着。<b>自注意力</b: A convolution only looks at a small ring around itself, so when the clue is at the far side of the image it takes many layers to reach it. Self-attention lets every position compare itself with every other in one step: the image is cut into patches, each called a token, and each scores every patch by how alike they are, then takes an average weighted by those scores.

Output side = ⌊(N + 2p − k) / s⌋ + 1, where N is the input side, k the window size, p the padding width and s the stride, how many cells it moves each time. With a stride above 1 it skips stops and the image shrinks.

But change the lamp and the spectrum an object reflects changes too, so two cloths that match in daylight may stop matching.

可随机抽样这一步没法求导：每次重抽，训练分不清结果变好是因为改了 μ、σ 还是运: But the random sampling step cannot be differentiated: with a fresh draw each time, training cannot tell whether a better result came from changing μ and σ or from luck. Reparameterisation writes it as z = μ + σ·ε: all the randomness comes from the input ε, z is just a multiply and an add of μ and σ, and the gradient is perfectly clear.
台上从左到右是一支箭头、一块开孔的板和一块屏幕。Z 是箭头到孔板的距离，f 是孔: On the bench, from left to right, are an arrow, a board with a hole in it and a screen. A small extra picture shows the image on the screen as seen from the front.

台上的编码器把每个视图变成一个方向，画成圆上的一个点；同一张图的两个视图连着线，: The encoder on the bench turns each view into a direction, drawn as a point on a circle; the two views of the same image are joined by a line and called a pair of partners. In the quiz, each view has to pick out its own partner from all the points.

同一个东西拍两次，总会差一点：手一抖，它就往旁边偏了一两个像素。可它还是那个东西: Photograph the same thing twice and the shots always differ a little: your hand shakes and it moves a pixel or two to the side. But it is still the same thing, and what it is recognised as should not change.
同一个位置常放好几个锚框，大小不同。: Several anchors of different sizes often sit at the same position.
同一个场景换了灯，像素数值会差很远，该给的答案却一样。设计特征时先问：哪些变化不: Light the same scene differently and the pixel values can differ a lot, yet the right answer stays the same. When designing a feature, first ask: which changes should not change the answer? Making the answer immune to those changes is called invariance.
同一个想法换一个方向。横着平均抹平左右的毛刺，竖着平均抹平上下的。: The same idea in another direction. Averaging across smooths out spikes from side to side; averaging down smooths them from top to bottom.
同一个检测器，在原图上找小的，在缩小的图上找大的，再把结果放大回来合在一起：这就: The same detector finds small things on the original and large things on a shrunken copy, and the results are enlarged back and merged: this is multi-scale detection on an image pyramid. FPN does the same thing inside the network.
同一个物体在不同灯光下拍了几次：有的整体变亮，有的灯暗了一半。每次都要标出同一组: The same object was photographed several times under different lighting: in some shots it is brighter overall, in others the light is half as strong. Each time, mark the same set of edges: output 1 at pixels whose gradient magnitude is more than half that of the steepest spot in the picture.
同一处放了大中小三个锚框，排成一行。同一组修正作用到每一个上，输出三个框。: Three anchors, small, medium and large, sit at the same place in a row. The same corrections apply to each; output the three boxes.
同一套修正，在小锚框上挪得少，在大锚框上挪得多：修正量是相对的。检测器在每个位置: The same corrections move a small anchor a little and a large one a lot: the corrections are relative. A detector places anchors of several sizes and aspect ratios at every position, regressing and scoring them all together.
同一样东西在左右两张图里错开的距离，叫<b>视差</b>。近的东西错得多，远的错: The distance by which the same thing is offset between the left and right images is its disparity. Near things are offset more and far things less, so the larger the disparity, the nearer the object.
同一组图块可以经过不同的可学习变换生成 Q、K、V；每个变换在图块之间共享。本关: The same patches can pass through different learnable transformations to produce Q, K and V, with each transformation shared across patches. This level simplifies the projections to three scalars, adjusted by training against the output error. Real models usually use matrix projections; different parameter combinations can produce the same attention result.

同样的三张照片。这次输出漆色本身：每一点的反射率，和表面朝哪边无关。: The same three photos. This time output the paint itself: the reflectance at every point, whichever way the surface faces.
同样的三盏灯。金属板本该是平的（允许轻微弯曲），磕出的凹坑和划痕都会让表面倾斜。: The same three lamps. A sheet should be flat (a slight bend is allowed); dents and scratches make the surface tilt. Mark where it tilts too much: where the slope (the length of the normal's horizontal part ÷ nz) is above 0.3. Uneven paint must not raise an alarm.
同样的抽样，只是中心换了。中心能不能由 c 算出来？: The same sampling, only with a different centre. Can the centre be worked out from c?
同样的照射下，反射率低的表面返回的光更少；亮度同时取决于照射和反射率。: Under the same illumination, a lower-reflectance surface returns less light. Brightness depends on both illumination and reflectance.

和<level-ref to=\"2-7\"></level-ref>里一样：硬: Just as in <level-ref to="2-7"></level-ref>: a hard disk cuts sharply, which is the same as a convolution with a kernel that has negative lobes, so rings of light and dark ripple out on both sides of an edge (ringing). A Gaussian mask falls off smoothly; its kernel is still a Gaussian, with no ripples. The expected image is in fact a spatial Gaussian blur with σ = 1, which matches a mask width of R = N/(2πσ) = 32/(2π) ≈ 5. Convolution in space equals multiplication in the frequency domain: this is the convolution theorem.

响应图一过门槛，留下的是一片一片：一个角附近有好几格都很强。可一个角只该是一个点: Above a threshold a response map leaves patches: several cells near one corner are all strong. But a corner should be a single point.
响应图过了门槛是一片一片的，一个角、一只狗附近好几格都很强。<b>非极大值抑制<: Above a threshold a response map comes in patches: several cells round one corner or one dog are all strong. Non-maximum suppression keeps only the cell no smaller than everything around it: work out the largest value in the 3×3 round each cell, then check whether the cell equals it.

在亮背景上做 3×3 平均，边缘不能发黑。: Take a 3×3 average on a bright background without the border going dark.
在偏黄的灯下拍照，白纸会发黄，整张照片都带着灯的颜色。人眼会自动纠正，相机得靠「: Photographed under a yellowish lamp, white paper looks yellow and the whole picture takes on the lamp's colour. Your eyes correct for it automatically; a camera needs "white balance".
在关卡里，顶栏的「关卡」按钮打开一份关卡列表，可以直接换关，不必回地图。: Inside a level, the “Levels” button in the top bar opens a list of levels, so you can switch levels without going back to the map.
在数字图里，反相就是把每格的数换掉：0 变 1，1 变 0，0.3 变 0.7。: In a digital image, inverting means replacing the number in every cell: 0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0, 0.3 becomes 0.7. The photo is still the same photo, just with light and dark swapped.
在暗背景上看不出问题，换成亮背景，毛病就露出来了。拍一张天空再模糊，照片四周多出: On a dark background you cannot see the problem; switch to a bright one and it shows. Blur a photo of the sky and a dark ring appears round the edges, like a frame that was never there.
在本关的白光模型里，光照强弱会让 R、G、B 按相同比例变化。辨认颜色时，要看各: In this level's neutral-light model, changing illumination scales R, G and B together. Identifying colour calls for comparing the channels relative to one another, rather than relying on the brightness of one channel alone. Such a description of colour is called chromaticity. When the light's colour changes or the signal is near black, this relationship alone may not be reliable.
在每个像素都算出箭头长度，画成一张越陡越亮的图，就是<b>边缘强度图</b>。它: Work out the arrow’s length at every pixel and draw it as an image, brighter where steeper, and you have an edge strength map. It does not depend on which way an edge runs: horizontal, vertical and diagonal edges are equally bright. Set a threshold on it, and the pixels above it count as edges.
在空间里用一个核做卷积，等于在频域里把每个频率乘上一个增益，这个增益就是核的频谱: Convolving with a kernel in space is the same as multiplying each frequency by a gain in the frequency domain, where the gain is the kernel’s spectrum. This is the convolution theorem: convolution in space is multiplication in frequency.
在计算机里，一张图像是一张数字表：画面切成许多小方格，叫<b>像素</b>，每格: Inside a computer, an image is a table of numbers: the picture is cut into many small squares called pixels, and each records a brightness. In this game 0 is black, 1 is white, and the values in between are shades of grey.
在这个游戏里，平移和各个滤波元件的「边界」设置都可以在「补 0」和「复制边缘」之: In this game, the “Border” setting of Shift and of every filter can choose between “Pad with 0” and “Replicate edge”.
在这个白光模型里，光照把同一个物体的三个通道按相同比例改变，因此可以比较通道之间: In this neutral-light model, illumination scales all three channels of the same object together, so their proportions can be compared. Next, apply the idea to a whole image.
地图上每一章是一条走线，关卡是线上的焊点，旁边的小图标说明这一关是搭电路还是机关: On the map each chapter is a trace and its levels are pads along it; a small icon beside each says whether it is a circuit or a bench. Each chapter follows one or two lectures of the course, and under its title is the question the chapter sets out to answer.
地板本来就在前面，算进来机器人就永远停着；所以只看可能有障碍的区域。真实的避障还: The floor is always in front, so counting it would keep the robot stopped for ever; only the region where obstacles can be is checked. Real obstacle avoidance also uses the camera's height and angle to work out how high above the floor each point is.
地板没有纹理，算出来的距离在那几行乱跳。机器人只关心地面以上、离得很近的东西。: The floor has no texture, so the distances worked out on those rows jump about. The robot only cares about things above the floor that are very close.
坡度有两个分量：Sobel x 量往右走亮度变多少（gx），Sobel y 量往: A slope has two components: Sobel x measures how much the brightness changes going right (gx), and Sobel y going down (gy). Together they make an arrow; at every pixel, output how long that arrow is: √(gx² + gy²). Whether an edge is horizontal, vertical or diagonal, the steeper it is, the brighter.
坡度有两个分量：往右走亮度变多少（gx），往下走变多少（gy），两个合起来是一个: A slope has two components: how much the brightness changes going right (gx), and going down (gy). Together they make an arrow called the gradient. Sobel x measures gx at every pixel, and Sobel y measures gy.
声音里也有同样的事：钢琴和小提琴弹同一个音，听起来却不同，因为里面混着的高低不同: Sound works the same way: a piano and a violin playing the same note sound different, because the waves of different pitch mixed in them come in different proportions.
处理最边上的像素时，有的邻居落在图外。图外没有数据，只能自己补上一些值，补什么直: When processing the pixels at the very edge, some neighbours fall outside the image. There is no data out there, so values have to be filled in, and what is filled in directly decides the result all round the border.
外点越多，一轮抽中两个内点的机会越小。δ 只和噪声有关：太小漏掉真内点，太大把外: The more outliers, the smaller the chance that a round draws two inliers. δ depends only on the noise: too small misses true inliers, too large counts outliers in as well.
多给生成器一个条件输入，它就按要求画：这叫条件生成。「画一只猫」「画成水彩风格」: Give the generator one more input, a condition, and it draws what is asked for: this is called conditional generation. Text prompts like "draw a cat" or "in watercolour" are just more elaborate conditions.
多通道卷积同时利用各通道及其邻域的信息。颜色发生变化而整体明暗不变时，合并成一张: Multichannel convolution uses each channel and its neighbourhood together. A colour boundary can disappear when channels are combined into one greyscale image; keeping their relationships makes such boundaries detectable.
大一点的高斯模糊把噪点和细笔画都糊成一片浅灰，几乎没有坡度；纸边是大块明暗的交界: A larger Gaussian blur turns the grain and the thin strokes into a faint grey with almost no slope, while a paper edge, where large areas of light and dark meet, is still a slope after blurring. To look for things of a certain size, blur to that size first: this idea of "scale" will keep coming back. A scanning app finding the four sides of a page starts with exactly this pipeline: blur away the noise and the text, take gradients without inventing edges at the border, then threshold. The edges found are later fitted with four straight lines, so a page photographed at an angle can be straightened.
大多数关卡要你搭一个电路。「输入」元件装着关卡给的数据，「输出」元件是你交出去的: Most levels ask you to build a circuit. The “Input” part holds the data the level gives you and the “Output” part is the result you hand in; each part also says whether it carries an image, a waveform or a number. In between you place parts and wire them together.
大框套小框: A big box round a small one
大的模糊很贵。缩小一半以后，图上的一格相当于原来的两格。: A big blur is expensive. After halving, one pixel of the picture stands for two of the original.
天和沙，一条平线: Sky and sand, a level line
好在两台相机的相对位置可以事先标定，记成一个 3×3 的矩阵 F，叫基础矩阵。有: Fortunately the relative position of the two cameras can be calibrated in advance and recorded as a 3×3 matrix F, the fundamental matrix. With it, a point in the left image cannot turn up just anywhere in the right one.
好处在计算量：k×k 的核直接算要 k² 次乘加，拆开只要 2k 次。3×3 时: The gain is in cost: a k×k kernel takes k² multiply-adds done directly, but only 2k when split. For 3×3 that is 9 down to 6, and the bigger the kernel, the more you save. Gaussian kernels split this way too.
始终输出同一个数。与图相加或相乘时，这个数作用于每一格: Always outputs the same number. Added to or multiplied with a picture, it applies to every cell
孔开大，像更亮，可同一点的光会在屏上铺成一个斑，像也更糊。镜头就是为了打破这个两: A bigger hole makes the image brighter, but light from one point spreads into a spot on the screen, so the image also gets blurrier. A lens exists to break this trade-off: open a big hole to let in more light, then bring the light back together to a point.
字母 F 贴左边: Letter F on the left edge
学习率是每一步迈多大。太小要走很多步；太大会怎样？看误差曲线。: The learning rate is how big each step is. Too small takes many steps; what happens if it is too big? Watch the error curve.
