它可以在空间里用模糊核做，也可以在频域里做：变换到频谱，乘一个以中心为圆心的掩膜: It can be done in space with a blur kernel, or in the frequency domain: transform to the spectrum, multiply by a mask centred on the middle, and transform back. The mask’s radius decides how many frequencies are kept: the smaller the radius, the blurrier the image.
它把图像往哪个方向挪了一格？: Which way does it move the image by one pixel?
它认的是车还是路: Does it see the car or the road?
实心点是训练用的 10 个样本（带噪声），空心点是没给模型看过的新样本。拖动「训: The filled dots are the 10 training samples (with noise); the hollow dots are new samples the model has never been shown. Drag "Steps trained" and watch how the curve changes and how the two error lines below move. Stop at the step where the error on new samples is lowest.
实际流水线里，点对来自通过距离比检验的候选，再由 RANSAC 反复抽 4 对、: In a real pipeline the pairs come from candidates that passed the ratio test, and RANSAC picks them by repeatedly drawing 4 pairs and counting inliers. Panorama stitching and augmented reality both work this way.
实际视觉模型通常从同一组图块特征，通过不同的可学习变换生成 Q、K、V。最后一段: Vision models usually generate Q, K and V from the same patch features using different learnable transformations. The final task trains a simplified example.
对每个可能的 d，把右图挪一挪再和左图比。单个像素比不准时，看看它周围。: For each possible d, shift the right image and compare it with the left one. When single pixels do not compare reliably, look at what is around them.
对每个频率都这样量一遍，就是<b>傅里叶变换</b>。它把一张图从「每个位置多亮: Measuring every frequency this way is the Fourier transform. It turns an image from “how bright each position is” into “how strong the wave at each frequency is”, and transforming back loses nothing.
将上一段的响应接到阈值元件，把阈值设为 0.22，再接到输出。: Connect the response to a threshold set to 0.22, then connect it to the output.
将可学习常数分别与图块相乘；同一个 K 常数和 V 常数都要接到两个图块。用 Q: Multiply patches by learnable constants; connect the same K constant and the same V constant to both patches. Compute weights from Q and K, then combine V with those weights. Training updates the three constants against the test targets.
小模糊、减半，再小模糊、减半：每一层都只做便宜的事，越往下越便宜。这样一层层缩小: A small blur and a halving, then a small blur and a halving again: each level does only cheap work, and each is cheaper than the last. A picture shrunk level by level like this is an image pyramid; thumbnails and multi-scale feature detection rely on it.
少数关卡带限制，比如计算量不能超过某个数，或者最多用几个节点。限制写在评分下面，: A few levels set a limit, such as a maximum cost or a maximum number of parts. The limit is shown under the score, and until it is met, passing every test does not complete the level.
尺寸翻倍：每个像素放在 2×2 的左上角，其余三格补 0: Doubles the size: each pixel goes in the top left of a 2×2 block, the other three are 0
局部变化强度在直边和角点附近都可能很大，因此单靠它无法区分直边和角点。接下来用: Local change can be strong at both edges and corners, so it cannot distinguish them alone. Next, the Harris response accounts for the relationship between the two directions.
层与层之间插一个非线性的<b>激活函数</b>，网络才能画出弯曲的分界。最常用的: Put a nonlinear activation function between the layers, and the network can draw curved boundaries. The most common is ReLU: negatives become 0 and positives pass unchanged, written max(0, x).
展开以后，x₀ 前面的系数是 √(a1·a2)，两份噪声合起来正好是方差 1 −: Expand it and the coefficient of x₀ is √(a1·a2), while the two noises together are exactly one noise of variance 1 − a1·a2: adding noise twice is the same thing as adding it once with ᾱ = a1·a2. That is why any step of diffusion can be reached in one jump.
工厂的流水线上，相机给每个零件拍一张照，和合格零件的照片比一比，挑出有缺陷的。这: On a factory line, a camera photographs every part and compares it with a photo of a good one, picking out the faulty ones. The last three levels of this chapter take place at such an inspection station.
左右两台相机拍同一个场景。输出每个像素的视差 d（0 … 3）：右图里同一个点比: Two cameras, left and right, photograph the same scene. Output each pixel's disparity d (0 … 3): how many pixels further left the same point is in the right image.
左右图逐行匹配，输出视差，窗口可选: Matches the left and right images row by row and outputs disparity; window size selectable
左图、右图 → 每格的视差: Left image, right image → disparity at each pixel
左图的一个点，在右图里只可能落在一条线上：这条线就是极线 l′ = F·p。匹配: A point in the left image can only land on one line in the right image: the epipolar line l′ = F·p. Searching only along it shrinks the search from a whole image to a line; when the two cameras are parallel the epipolar lines are exactly the rows, which is why the search so far stayed within one row.
左图的点 p = (x, y, 1)。输出它在右图的极线 l′ = F·p，三个: A point in the left image is p = (x, y, 1). Output its epipolar line in the right image, l′ = F·p, three numbers. F is given column by column.
左图里不同的点，在右图里有不同的极线。把它们都画出来，会发现一件事：它们都交于同: Different points in the left image have different epipolar lines in the right image. Draw them all and you notice something: they all pass through one point.
差分会把噪声一起放大。在求差之前，能不能先让噪声安静下来？: Taking a difference amplifies the noise too. Before you take the difference, can you quieten the noise first?
已知把封面搬到照片里的单应 H。把清楚的封面贴到照片里书的位置上：封面落到的地方: The homography H that carries the cover into the photo is given. Paste the crisp cover over the book in the photo: where the cover lands it is the cover, everywhere else still the photo.
布是什么颜色，要看它把每个波长的光反射回来多少，这也是一条曲线。照到布上的光 ×: What colour a cloth is depends on how much light it reflects at each wavelength, which is another curve. The light falling on the cloth × the cloth's reflectance is the spectrum that enters the camera.
常见的失败是<b>模式坍塌</b>：真实数据有好几堆，生成器画出的样本却只覆盖其: A common failure is mode collapse: the real data has several clusters, but the generator’s samples cover only one of them.
平均、差分这些运算其实是同一种：每格输出是它周围一小块的加权和。把权重排成一个小: Averaging and differencing are really the same operation: each output cell is a weighted sum of the small block around it. Lay the weights out in a small square and you have a kernel. Change the weights and you change the effect.
平均会把孤零零的亮点摊开，把忽亮忽暗的毛刺抹平。同一组权重在每个位置都一样用，图: Averaging spreads a lone bright dot out and smooths away flickering specks. The same weights are used at every position, so wherever a pattern moves, its result moves with it.
平移一格时，最边上那一列的数要从图外取。图外没有数据，平移元件一直补 0，也就是: When you shift by one pixel, the numbers for the outermost column have to come from outside the image. There is no data out there, so the Shift part has always padded with 0, which is black. But what a camera captures does not suddenly turn black at the image border: that column is fake.
平移元件每次只把图挪一格。可要挪的，常常不止一格。: The shift part only ever moves the picture by one pixel. But things often need to move further than that.
平移的「边界」设置多了「循环」：挪出去的从另一头回来。: Shift's "Border" setting now has "Wrap round": what moves out comes back in at the other end.
开场时你是刚上电的探测器 V-0：传感器把世界变成一格格数字，可你还读不懂它们。: You start as Probe V-0, just powered on: your sensor turns the world into a grid of numbers that you cannot read yet. Your job is to learn, step by step, to read them.
当初加的噪声 ε: The noise ε that was added
形状只在「匹配」里出现：每张图单看都只是杂点。对应点只需在同一行里找，视差越大，: The shape only appears through matching: each image on its own is just speckle. Corresponding points only need to be searched for along the same row, and the larger the disparity, the nearer the object.
彩色图是三张图叠在一起：红、绿、蓝各一张，叫三个<b>通道</b>。卷积网络每一: A colour image is three images stacked together, one each for red, green and blue, called three channels. Each layer of a convolutional network usually outputs many channels too, one per filter.
彩色照片每个像素有三个数：R、G、B。可现实里的光不止三种，而是像彩虹那样一整条: Each pixel of a colour photo has three numbers: R, G and B. But real light is not three kinds; it is a whole band like a rainbow, from violet to red, called a spectrum.
很多关还有<b>隐藏测试</b>：每次运行都一起检查，但只告诉你有几组没过，通关: Many levels also have hidden tests: they are checked on every run, but you only learn how many failed, and they are shown once you pass. If every visible test passes but a hidden one fails, your circuit may only happen to work on those particular pictures.
很多时候要找的是一条线：车道线、纸张的边、楼房的轮廓。边缘检测给的只是一堆零散的: Often what you are looking for is a line: a lane marking, the edge of a sheet of paper, the outline of a building. Edge detection only gives a scatter of loose points, mixed with noise and unrelated points. How do you pick out straight lines from that?
很多问题要的答案只有「是」或「否」：这一格是不是路面？这里有没有人？深浅不一的灰: Many questions want a yes or a no: is this cell road? Is anyone here? Shades of grey have to become 0s and 1s.
怎样用邻居算出新图: How do neighbours make a new image?
所以<b>抗混叠</b>必须在采样之前：先低通去掉高于奈奎斯特频率的部分，再采样: So anti-aliasing has to happen before sampling: low-pass away everything above the Nyquist frequency first, then sample. Taking photos and scanning both face the same problem.
所以一个点只要还在同一块里挪动，结果就不变，网络因此能容忍一点点平移。代价是丢掉: So as long as a point moves within the same block, the result does not change, which lets a network tolerate small shifts. The price is losing the exact position inside the block.
所以照片里的边缘只说明「这里亮度变了」，变的可能是颜色，也可能只是光：一面纯色墙: So an edge in a photo only says “the brightness changes here”; what changed may be the colour, or just the light. A shadow on a plain wall has a hard edge too. Splitting a photo into its colour and its lighting is called intrinsic image decomposition.
所以要留一些模型从没见过的样本，专门拿来检查。台上的实心点是训练样本，空心点是新: So you keep back some samples the model has never seen, just for checking. On the bench the filled dots are training samples and the hollow dots are new samples. Every sample carries a little random deviation (noise); the true pattern is a smooth curve.
所有图块用同一个查询（全 1）去问，分数就只看每块的总和，大家都看向同一块。Vi: When every patch asks with the same query (all ones), the score depends only on each patch's total, and they all look at the same patch. ViT puts an extra learnable [CLS] patch in front of the others; its query is trained to ask on behalf of the whole picture, and only its output is read to classify.
手写数字识别、拍照认花、相册按人脸分组，问的都是「这是什么」。这类问题叫分类，是: Reading handwritten digits, identifying a flower from a photo, grouping an album by face: they all ask "what is this?". This kind of problem is called classification, the most common task in vision. This level does the smallest one: just two classes, X or O.
手机上是一块竖着的电路板：输入在最上面，输出在最下面，中间是两列格位。点底部托盘: On a phone it is a tall circuit board: the inputs at the top, the outputs at the bottom and two columns of slots in between. Tap a part in the tray at the bottom to drop it into a free slot, tap two dots to wire them, and tap a wired input to unplug it; hold a block to move it to another slot, or drag it back onto the tray to remove it. Tap a block to open its panel, with its description and settings.
手机夜景、老照片的扫描件里，常有一层细密的噪点。颗粒越细，变化越快，在频谱上就离: Night shots on a phone and scans of old photos often have a layer of fine noise. The finer the grain, the faster it changes, and the farther from the centre it sits in the spectrum. Large shapes in the image change slowly and sit near the centre.
手机斜着拍了桌上的书。匹配器给出了封面和照片之间的点对，其中有几对是桌面花纹造成: A phone photographed the book on the desk at an angle. The matcher has given pairs of points between the cover and the photo, and a few are wrong matches caused by the desk pattern. Paste the crisp cover back over the book in the photo.
手机的底栏有「撤销」、测试详情、「清空」（要点两次）和「运行测试」。两种布局改的: The phone’s bottom bar has “Undo”, the test details, “Clear” (tap twice) and “Run tests”. Both layouts edit the same circuit.
手机的电路板上，元件一多，线就会交错成一团。板子右上角的接线开关在三种显示之间轮: On the phone’s circuit board, wires soon tangle once there are a few parts. The wire switch at the top right of the board cycles through three displays: “All wires”, “No input wires” (the wires leaving the input parts are not drawn) and “No wires”.
手里的元件：<part-ref to=\"part:lrnConv\"></pa: The parts to hand: <part-ref to="part:lrnConv"></part-ref> is a learnable 3×3 kernel that starts from very small random numbers; <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> turns a whole picture into one number; "Dense" and <part-ref to="sigmoid"></part-ref> are what you built earlier.
托盘里有训练好的编码器和解码器：编码器把一个斑点变成两个数，解码器把两个数画成斑: The tray holds the trained encoder and decoder: the encoder turns a blob into two numbers, and the decoder draws two numbers as a blob.
托盘里的 ReLU 让负数变 0、正数不变。: The ReLU in the tray turns negatives into 0 and leaves positives as they are.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"attention\"></part-re: The <part-ref to="attention"></part-ref> is back in the tray. This level's mask is drawn by 4×4 patch: 1 on the patches with the car. Your task: output what fraction of the class token's attention falls on the car.

The <part-ref to="attention"></part-ref> in the tray cuts the 16×16 image into 16 patches of 4×4, and every patch asks every patch. The "q scale" parameter scales up all the scores: the larger it is, the more each patch looks only at the few most alike.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"embed\"></part-ref>把一: The <part-ref to="embed"></part-ref> in the tray turns a picture into a set of features, and different versions of the same picture get features close to each other.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"homography\"></part-r: The <part-ref to="homography"></part-ref> in the tray: pairs go in and the 9 numbers of H come out. This level does not need it yet: H is given.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"hough\"></part-ref>：亮: The <part-ref to="hough"></part-ref> in the tray: bright points go in, and a map of votes over (θ, ρ) comes out.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"lrn-rgb\"></part-ref>: The <part-ref to="lrn-rgb"></part-ref> in the tray spans the R, G and B images with one kernel, its 27 weights trained together.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"iou\"></part-ref>输出两个: The <part-ref to="iou"></part-ref> in the tray outputs the intersection over union of two box masks: the overlap divided by the area they cover together.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"apMeter\"></part-ref>: The <part-ref to="apMeter"></part-ref> in the tray reads right or wrong in score order, the ranks and the number labelled G, and outputs the AP.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"peaks\"></part-ref>在比: The <part-ref to="peaks"></part-ref> in the tray outputs 1 where a cell is no smaller than its 3×3 neighbours and above 0.3, and 0 elsewhere.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"matcher\"></part-ref>: The <part-ref to="matcher"></part-ref> in the tray takes three distances and returns the number of the matching candidate.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"cross\"></part-ref>输出: The <part-ref to="cross"></part-ref> in the tray outputs the cross product a × b of two 3-vectors.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"epiline\"></part-ref>: The <part-ref to="epiline"></part-ref> in the tray reads the three columns of F and a point (x, y), and outputs the epipolar line F·p.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"restore\"></part-ref>: The <part-ref to="restore"></part-ref> in the tray recovers x₀ from x_t and the noise ε. But when it is actually needed, nobody tells you what the noise was.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"addNoise\"></part-ref: The <part-ref to="addNoise"></part-ref> in the tray takes x₀ straight to step t: it outputs √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"kmeansStep\"></part-r: The <part-ref to="kmeansStep"></part-ref> in the tray splits the values into two classes at the boundary m and outputs halfway between the two class averages.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"unpool\"></part-ref>把: The <part-ref to="unpool"></part-ref> in the tray puts each pooled value back in the cell it came from before pooling; every other cell is 0.
托盘里的<part-ref to=\"ransac\"></part-ref>，: The <part-ref to="ransac"></part-ref> in the tray has the rounds k and δ to set.
托盘里的「转置卷积」先补零放大一倍，再用一个 3×3 的核走一遍，核可以自己填。: The Transposed convolution in the tray zero-upsamples to twice the size, then runs a 3×3 kernel over it; you fill in the kernel yourself.
托盘里的「重参数化」：μ、σ、ε 进去，出来 μ + σ·ε。: The Reparameterization in the tray: μ, σ and ε go in, μ + σ·ε comes out.
扩散模型给图加噪：x_t = √ᾱ · x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ) · ε。按公: A diffusion model adds noise to a picture: x_t = √ᾱ · x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ) · ε. Output x_t by the formula.
扫地机器人的双目相机（f·b = 3）。输出地面以上每个像素的距离（米），地面那: A robot vacuum's stereo camera (f·b = 3). Output the distance in metres of every pixel above the floor, and 0 on the floor rows.
扫地机器人的双目相机（f·b = 3，地板没有纹理，画面有噪声）。标出地面以上、: A robot vacuum's stereo camera (f·b = 3, a floor with no texture, a noisy picture). Mark the region above the floor, closer than 1.2 m, where it must stop.
扫地机器人装了一对双目相机，要在撞上之前停下来。先要知道前面每个地方有多远。: A robot vacuum has a pair of stereo cameras and must stop before it bumps into things. First it needs to know how far away everything in front is.
扫描 App 拍下一张纸，要先找出纸的四边，才能把它裁下来、拉正。这一章最后三关: A scanning app that photographs a sheet of paper must first find the sheet's four sides before it can crop and straighten it. The last three levels of this chapter build such a scanner.
扫描仪的传感器有噪声。把扫描件变成期望里那样干净、柔和的图。: The scanner's sensor is noisy. Turn the scan into a clean, soft image like the expected one.
扫描仪的最后一关：噪声、字、超出范围的纸，全都会遇到。: The scanner's final level: noise, text and paper running off the scan, all at once.
找到了。比较每只苹果三个通道的相对大小，再试试不同的光强。: Found it. Compare each apple's three channels with one another, then try different light strengths.
找到关键点后要配对：拿左图一个点周围的一小块，到右图里找最像的一块。像不像用距离: Once key points are found they need pairing: take the small patch round a point in the left image and look for the most similar patch in the right one. Similarity is measured as a distance d, smaller meaning more alike; the closest is first place (distance d₁) and the next is second place (d₂).
找物体，常靠照片里明暗突变的地方。阴影也会造出明暗突变。要想的问题：照片里一条明: Finding objects often relies on places where brightness jumps. Shadows make brightness jumps too. Something to think about: is a line between light and dark in a photo always the edge of an object? A phone app removing the shadow from a scanned page runs into exactly this.
找边缘是视觉里最基础的一步。扫描软件靠它找纸张的四边，车道保持系统靠它找车道线。: Finding edges is the most basic step in vision. Scanning apps use it to find the four sides of a sheet of paper, and lane-keeping systems use it to find lane markings.
找边还差一步：定一个门槛，梯度超过它的像素才算边。门槛太低，表面的细纹也算进来；: Finding edges needs one more step: a threshold, so that only pixels whose gradient exceeds it count as edges. Too low, and fine texture counts too; too high, and real edges are missed.
找近邻时你比较过相似度。这次没有候选可比，要自己定一条线。: In nearest neighbour you compared similarities. This time there are no candidates to compare with, so you have to draw the line yourself.
把 32×32 的图缩成 16×16，看起来要和原图一样（只是变小）。: Shrink a 32×32 image to 16×16. It should look like the original, only smaller.
把 32×32 缩成 8×8，看起来要和原图一样，只是小了。: Shrink 32×32 to 8×8. It should look like the original, only smaller.
把 8×8 的图放大成 16×16：每个像素变成 2×2 的一小块，四格都一样。: Enlarge an 8×8 picture to 16×16: every pixel becomes a 2×2 block, all four cells the same.
把一个模板在图上逐位置滑过去打分，再过门槛：这就是滑窗检测。卷积网络做的是同一件: Slide a template over the picture scoring every position, then apply a threshold: this is sliding-window detection. A convolutional network does the same thing, except that the templates are learnt and stacked layer on layer.
把一列数平均成一个数: Averages a row of numbers into a single number
把一条连续的波变成一排点，只保留采到的值。三个小实验，看看采样会把什么弄丢、又会: Turn a continuous wave into a row of points, keeping only the sampled values. Three small experiments show what sampling loses, and what it makes up out of nothing.
把一格周围 3×3 的一块涂黑（亮度变 0），分数会掉一些。在每一格输出：涂黑以: Black out the 3×3 block round a cell (brightness 0) and the score drops a little. At every cell, output how much the score drops when the block centred on it is blacked out.
把两个卷积层串起来，训练它们；比较亮点经过第一层和第二层的图。一个 3×3 层能: Connect two convolution layers in sequence and train them. Compare the bright dot after the first and second layers: how far can one 3×3 layer see, and how far can two?
把两个或三个分数转成总和为 1 的权重。第三输入可留空，此时第三输出为 0。: Turns two or three scores into weights that sum to 1. Leave the third input empty for two scores; its output is then 0.
把亮度严格高于 0.5 的像素标成 1，其余标成 0。对照有窄缝和没有窄缝的两组: Label pixels strictly brighter than 0.5 as 1 and the rest as 0. Compare the examples with and without a narrow gap.
把像素按亮度分成两类：亮于分界 m 的一类，其余一类。算出两类各自的平均亮度，输: Split the pixels into two classes by brightness: those brighter than the boundary m, and the rest. Work out each class's average brightness and output the new boundary halfway between them.
把前面几关接起来：从两台相机的画面，一路算到要停下的区域。: Join the last few levels up: from the two cameras' pictures all the way to the region to stop for.
把加噪的公式倒过来解 x₀。: Solve the noise formula backwards for x₀.
把只有一个亮点的图交给一个核，输出就是核自己的样子，这叫<b>冲激响应</b>。: Give a kernel an image with a single bright dot and the output is the kernel itself: this is the impulse response. So seeing what a bright dot turns into tells you which kernel was used.
把图变到频域，每个频率乘上增益图里对应格子的数，再变回来。增益图和频谱画法一样：: Takes the picture into the frequency domain, multiplies each frequency by the number in the matching cell of the gain picture, and comes back. The gain picture is laid out like a spectrum: its centre is frequency (0, 0)
把图变成 4×4 = 16 个特征，长度为 1：整体变亮、对比度变、挪一两格、加: Turns a picture into 4×4 = 16 features of length 1: brightening, a contrast change, a shift of a pixel or two or a little noise hardly move it
把封面贴回照片，需要一个变换：它告诉封面上的每个点，落到照片的哪里。变换由几对对: Pasting the cover back into the photo needs a transformation: it tells each point on the cover where it lands in the photo. The transformation is computed from a few pairs of corresponding points; choose the pairs well and the cover lands accurately.
把所有可调的数看成位置、损失看成地形，训练就是下山。梯度指向上坡最陡的方向，每一: Treat all the adjustable numbers as a position and the loss as a landscape, and training is walking downhill. The gradient points up the steepest slope, and each step moves “learning rate × gradient” the opposite way: this is gradient descent.
把指针停在图上，可以读出每一格的数值和期望值。输出是一个数时，期望、允许范围和你: Hover over a picture to read the value in each cell and the value expected there. When the output is a single number, the expected value, the allowed range and your reading are drawn on one scale; when it is a single row, it is drawn as a curve, with an allowed band round the expected curve.
把掩膜往四个方向各挪一格加起来，再加上自己，只有四面都被围住的格子能数到 5。用: Shift the mask one pixel in each of the four directions, add them up and add the cell itself: only a cell surrounded on all four sides counts to 5. A threshold keeps this "inside", and taking it away from the mask leaves the outer ring. Counting neighbours and then thresholding has a name: erosion.
把放大回来的粗结果和原尺寸的细结果合起来：粗的一路挡住噪点，细的一路留下细节。这: Combine the coarse result enlarged back with the fine result at full size: the coarse path keeps out the grain, the fine path keeps the detail. This line straight from encoder to decoder is called a skip connection, and U-Net has one at every level.
把整张图压成一行 k 个数（权重靠训练）: Squeezes the whole image into a row of k numbers (weights come from training)
把整张图往右挪两格，再往下挪两格。: Move the whole image two pixels right and two pixels down.
把核压过整张图，每到一处算一次加权和，就得到滤波的结果。只有正中间是 1 的核原: Pass the kernel over the whole image, computing a weighted sum at each spot, and you have the filtered result. A kernel with just a 1 in the centre leaves the image unchanged; behind many photo-editor filters there is often just a kernel.
把检测结果按分数排好，第 k 名的精确率 = 前 k 名里对的个数 ÷ k；<b: Sort the detections by score: the precision at rank k = the number right in the top k ÷ k, and AP is the precisions at the right ones, added up and divided by the number labelled: the area under the precision–recall curve. The average AP over the classes is mAP.
把每一格的梯度幅值分给它最接近的方向：横向分量更大时，往右变亮算「→」，往左算「: Give each cell's gradient magnitude to the direction it is closest to: when the across part is larger, brightening to the right counts as "→" and to the left as "←"; when the down part is larger, brightening downwards counts as "↓" and upwards as "↑". The four outputs are the magnitude summed per direction, divided by the number of cells.
把池化后的每个值放回池化前它所在的那一格，其余格子为 0。: Puts each pooled value back in the cell it came from before pooling; every other cell is 0.
把混合图像写成式子看看。: Write the hybrid image out as a formula.
把线藏起来，电路并没有变。每个接好的输入口旁有个小标签，写着它读的是哪个元件；选: Hiding wires does not change the circuit. Each wired input has a small tag beside it naming the part it reads from, and while a dot is picked, the wires of its own part are still drawn.
把细节按一定比例加回原图，边缘两侧的明暗差被拉大，图就显得更锐利，这就是<b>锐: Add the detail back to the original in some proportion and the contrast on either side of each edge is stretched, so the image looks sharper: this is sharpening. The USM (unsharp mask) sharpening in photo editors works this way, and comes from a darkroom trick of printing a blurred negative together with the original.
把至少 12 个卷积层串成一条路，训练它做测试里那种轻微的模糊。: Chain at least 12 conv layers into one path and train it to do the light blur in the tests.
Chain at least 6 conv layers into one path and train it to do a light sharpen: output = image + 0.25 × (image − 3×3 average).
把视差换成距离，靠的是和针孔相机同一个道理：深度 z = f·b / d，f 是: Converting disparity into distance uses the same reasoning as the pinhole camera: depth z = f·b / d, where f is the focal length, b the distance between the two cameras (the baseline) and d the disparity.
把输入接到输出。: Connect the input to the output.
拍出来的照片总带着噪点。一张图压成两个数，再画回来，噪点会怎样？: Photos always come with grain. Squeeze a picture into two numbers and draw it back: what happens to the grain?
拖动画布的空白处可以平移，按住 ⌘/Ctrl 滚动或双指捏合可以缩放，角上的按钮: Drag an empty part of the board to pan, hold ⌘/Ctrl and scroll (or pinch) to zoom, and the corner buttons fit the whole circuit into view.
拖孔板和屏幕，在孔板上换孔。一次只动一样，看像高、模糊、亮度各跟着什么变。: Drag the pinhole plate and the screen, and change the hole in the plate. Move one thing at a time and watch what each of image height, blur and brightness follows.
拼接相邻照片时，需要找到两张图中对应的位置。平坦区域的点和直边上的点都容易与附近: To stitch overlapping photographs, we need corresponding positions in both images. Points in flat areas or along straight edges are easily confused with nearby positions; corners change in several directions and are often easier to find again.
拽不歪的线: A line that will not be dragged
拿到一个不认识的工具，最可靠的办法是试：给它不同的东西，看它还回来什么。研究黑箱: When you are handed a tool you do not know, the most reliable thing to do is try it: give it different things and see what comes back. That is how people study black boxes and debug circuits: experiment first, conclude later.
拿到一条叠好的曲线，怎样知道某个频率的波有多强？把信号和这个频率的 cos、si: Given a curve that is already added up, how do you tell how strong the wave at one frequency is? Multiply the signal point by point by the cos and the sin of that frequency and take the averages, giving two readings a and b. Waves at other frequencies average out to 0; only the one at that frequency remains.
指定画哪边: Draw it on the side asked for
按 H 把图搬到「画布」那么大的一张图上：画布上每一格取原图里 H⁻¹ 指向的那: Carries the picture by H onto a picture the size of the "canvas": each cell of the canvas takes the cell of the picture that H⁻¹ points to (the nearest one), and 0 where that falls outside
按亮度分两堆时，分界就在两个中心正中间。它只看给它的特征：只给亮度，亮度一样的两: Splitting into two by brightness, the boundary sits halfway between the two centres. It only sees the features it is given: with brightness alone, two things of the same brightness cannot be told apart; add position as a feature and you get superpixels (SLIC).
按分界 m 把值分成两类，输出两类平均值的正中间。: Splits the values into two classes at the boundary m and outputs halfway between the two class averages.
按阅读顺序（先左后右，再从上到下），亮块排在暗块前面就整张图输出 1，否则输出: In reading order (left to right, then top to bottom), if the bright patch comes before the dark one, output 1 over the whole image; otherwise output 0. The second input is the number of the patch each pixel is in, 0 … 15.
挡板越大，热图越平滑、越粗：一块挡板盖住的地方多，分到每格的就模糊了。挡板太小，: The bigger the patch, the smoother and coarser the heat map: each patch covers more, so what it finds is smeared over more cells. Too small a patch, though, may never cover the whole part the model recognises. In practice the patch is chosen about the size of the object's parts.
挨在一起的细胞之间只隔一条一像素的暗缝。标出细胞，缝要留着（0）。: Touching cells are separated only by a dark gap one pixel wide. Mark the cells, and keep the gaps (0).
振幅是 2·√(a² + b²)，和波错开多少无关；相位是 atan2(b, a: The amplitude is 2·√(a² + b²), however far the wave is shifted, and the phase is atan2(b, a). With cos alone, a wave shifted by 90° would measure as 0.
损失公式分两项：一项把搭档拉近，一项把同一批里的其他视图推开，第二项可以开关。这: The loss has two terms: one pulls partners together, the other pushes away the other views in the same batch, and the second can be switched on or off. In this level you train the encoder. Before you start, think: with a good encoder, what should the points on the circle look like?
换一个核，同一个转置卷积就从「一格复制四格」变成了平滑放大。在网络里，这个核是学: Change the kernel and the same transposed convolution goes from "copy one cell to four" to smooth enlargement. In a network this kernel is learnt: the decoder learns for itself how best to enlarge.
换一台双目相机，镜头和两台相机的间距都变了。: Switch to a different stereo camera: both the lens and the distance between the two cameras change.
换一块 5×5 的灰色挡板。在每一格输出：挡住以它为中心的 5×5，分数掉多少。: Use a 5×5 grey patch instead. At every cell, output how much the score drops when it covers the 5×5 centred there.
换一张测试图，盯住某个亮点看它去了哪里。: Try another test picture and follow one bright spot to see where it goes.
换一批新零件时，不一定从零开始：可以复用已经训练好的特征提取部分，只训练新的分类: For a new set of parts, we do not always have to start from scratch: we can reuse a trained feature extractor and train only a new classification head. If the old features do not fit well enough, we can unfreeze some layers and train them further; this is fine-tuning. This level still trains on its current task.
换一盏灯再拍一张，两圈候选的朝向只在一两处相交；用三盏灯，连反射率也能一起解出来: Change the lamp and take another photo, and the two rings of possible facings cross at only one or two points; with three lamps you can solve for the reflectance as well. This is called photometric stereo.
换了一台双目相机，焦距 f 和基线 b 每组测试都不一样。把视差图换成距离图。: A different stereo camera: the focal length f and the baseline b change from test to test. Turn the disparity map into a distance map.
换了一批字母：X 是「只有一种笔画」（斜多弯少，或弯多斜少），O 是「两种都多，: A new batch of letters: X means "only one kind of stroke" (more diagonal than curved, or the other way round), O means "both kinds a lot, or both a little". Above 0.6 for X, below 0.4 for O.
换灯露馅: A new lamp gives it away
探测器 V-0，视觉芯片已上电。: Probe V-0, vision chip powered on.
探针波和曲线逐点相乘再平均，别的频率互相抵消，只留下同一频率那道波振幅的一半，乘: Multiply a probe wave with the curve point by point and average: the other frequencies cancel, leaving half the amplitude of the wave at the probe's frequency, and twice that is its amplitude. Change the probe's frequency to measure another wave.
探针还量得到一部分。: The probe still measures part of it.
接下来几关，一个点、一条线都写成三个数，放在一行里：点 (x, y) 写成 (x: In the next few levels a point and a line are both written as three numbers in a row: the point (x, y) as (x, y, 1), and the line ax + by + c = 0 as (a, b, c). These are called homogeneous coordinates.
接出「右边像素 − 当前像素」，再比较前两组台阶。亮暗对调后，边缘的输出会怎样变: Wire up “right pixel − current pixel,” then compare the first two steps. What happens to the edge response when light and dark swap?
搜视差、换成距离、只留地面以上：每一步都是前面单独练过的，接起来就是一台测距仪。: Search the disparity, convert to distance, keep only what is above the floor: each step was practised on its own earlier, and joined up they make a rangefinder.
搭电路的关卡有两项评分：<b>节点</b>是你放了几个元件，<b>计算量</b>: Circuit levels are scored on two things: parts is how many parts you placed, and cost is how many arithmetic operations it takes to compute one output pixel. Lower cost is better; at equal cost, fewer parts wins.
摄影棚里很少只用一盏灯：主灯之外，还会在另一侧放一盏弱一些的补光，让暗面不至于漆: Studios rarely use a single lamp: besides the key light, a weaker fill light goes on the other side so the dark side is not pitch black.
整张图平移一格；从边界移入的格子补 0: Shifts the whole picture by one pixel; cells shifted in from the border are 0
斑点进去，同一个斑点出来: A blob goes in, the same blob comes out
斑马板：输入和期望: Zone plate: input and expected output
斜着拍一本书，封面在照片里就不再方方正正。把一个平面上的点映到照片里的变换叫<b: Photograph a book at a slant and the cover is no longer a neat rectangle. The transformation that maps the points of a plane into the photo is a homography, written as a 3×3 matrix H with 8 degrees of freedom.
新元件 exp 把每个数 x 换成 e 的 x 次方：x 越大越大，x 是负数时: The new part exp replaces each number x with e to the power x: the bigger x, the bigger it gets; for negative x it approaches 0 but stays positive.
新元件 exp 算 e 的几次方。: The new part exp raises e to a power.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:dg_encode\"></par: The new <part-ref to="part:dg_encode"></part-ref> part squeezes the whole image into a short row of numbers, and the <part-ref to="part:dg_decode"></part-ref> draws an image back from those numbers. The few numbers in the middle are like writing just the address on a letter, with no need to enclose a photo of the whole house.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:fqApply\"></part-: The new part <part-ref to="part:fqApply"></part-ref>: takes a picture into the frequency domain, multiplies each frequency by the number in the matching cell of a gain picture, and comes back. The gain picture is laid out like a spectrum, with frequency (0, 0) at the centre.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:learn3\"></part-r: The new part is <part-ref to="part:learn3"></part-ref>: like the 3×3 kernel, it presses nine weights over the image, but you do not fill in the weights; it tunes them itself to match the tests' expected outputs. <level-ref to="4-2"></level-ref> had one or two knobs; this time there are nine.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:lrnConst\"></part: The new part <part-ref to="part:lrnConst"></part-ref> is a number you do not fill in; multiply the input by it and you have w × input. When a circuit has learnable parts, <wiki-ref to="training"></wiki-ref> appears in the panel: at every step the machine feels which way the error slopes down and nudges the knob that way.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:warp\"></part-ref: The new part <part-ref to="part:warp"></part-ref> carries a picture onto another by H.
新原件<part-ref to=\"part:argmin4\"></part-: The new primitive <part-ref to="part:argmin4"></part-ref> takes four pictures and, cell by cell, outputs the number 0–3 of the one that is smallest.
新原件<part-ref to=\"part:zeroUp\"></part-r: The new primitive <part-ref to="part:zeroUp"></part-ref> doubles the size: each pixel goes in the top left of a 2×2 block, and the other three cells are 0.
新样本误差仍不够低。: The error on new samples is still too high.
新样本误差已接近最低。: The error on new samples is close to its minimum.
新画法<part-ref to=\"spectrum\"></part-ref>: A new way of drawing, <part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>: how strong the wave at each frequency is, with frequency (0, 0) at the centre and higher frequencies further out.
新画法「剖面」：把图上一行的亮度画成一条曲线，在图上拖动就换一行。元件和测试区的: A new way of drawing, "Profile": the brightness along one row of the picture as a curve; drag on the picture to change row. Switch to it with the drawing buttons on a part or in the test area.
新画法「地形」：把亮度当成高度，亮的地方是山，暗的地方是谷。: A new way of drawing, "Terrain": brightness becomes height, so bright places are hills and dark places are valleys.
新画法「坡度」：画出等高线，再在各处画一个箭头，指向变亮最快的方向。: A new way of drawing, "Slope": contour lines, with an arrow at each place pointing where the picture brightens fastest.
方块模糊把一个亮点摊成一块平顶的方墩，有硬边也有角。<part-ref to=\: A box blur spreads a bright dot into a flat-topped square block, with hard edges and corners. A <part-ref to="gauss"></part-ref> weights the centre most and further cells less, like a bell in cross-section, so a bright dot is spread into a smooth little hill.
方块模糊有个毛病：它把一个亮点摊成一块平顶的方墩，有硬边，也有角。镜头失焦拍出的: Box blur has a flaw: it spreads a bright dot into a flat-topped square block, with hard edges and corners. But a point of light shot through an out-of-focus lens is round, fading gradually outwards from the centre.
方块：带噪点的输入和期望: Square: the noisy input and the expected output
方波只用到奇数频率，振幅按 1、1/3、1/5、1/7 递减。边越陡，需要的高频: A square wave uses only odd frequencies, with amplitudes falling as 1, 1/3, 1/5, 1/7. The steeper an edge, the more high frequencies it needs; stop at frequency 7 and a ripple always remains beside the steep edge. Any curve can be split into waves like this: that is the Fourier series. Each sine wave cancels itself out and averages 0, so however they are stacked, the row averages to the middle line.
日光那一组的答案全是 0。两块布的光谱明明不一样，相机为什么分不出来？: The daylight test expects all zeros. The two cloths' spectra are plainly different, so why can the camera not tell them apart?
明暗从哪来已经讲完，这一关转向<b>边</b>：明暗变化很快的地方。要找它，先得: So much for where light and shade come from. This level turns to edges: places where brightness changes fast. To find them, first say how fast the brightness changes at each point.
显微镜下数细胞、量细胞，第一步是标出每个像素是不是细胞。可切片上满是噪点。: To count and measure cells under a microscope, the first step is marking whether every pixel is a cell. But the slide is full of grain.
显微镜下的细胞，噪点很重。标出细胞（1）和背景（0）。: Cells under a microscope, with heavy grain. Mark the cells (1) and the background (0).
暗→亮的边和亮→暗的边都要输出正的强度（输出 = |右边 − 自己|）。: Both dark→light and light→dark edges must give a positive strength (output = |right − self|).
暗房时代的摄影师有个怪招：把一张故意洗模糊的底片和原底片叠在一起印，照片反而更清: Darkroom photographers had an odd trick: print the original negative stacked with a deliberately blurred copy, and the photo comes out clearer. The "USM sharpening" (unsharp mask) in photo editors comes from this technique.
暗箱壁上开一个小孔，景物发出的光只能穿过这一点，在对面的屏上成一个倒立的像。这就: Make a small hole in the wall of a dark box, and light from the scene can only pass through that one point, forming an upside-down image on the screen opposite. This is the pinhole camera, the earliest form of the camera.
更快的波不会消失，而是折回来冒充一道慢波：频率 k 看起来和 M − k 一模一: Faster waves do not vanish: they fold back and pose as a slower wave, so frequency k looks exactly like M − k. This is aliasing, and once sampled the two can never be separated. A spinning wheel that seems to turn backwards on video, and the ripples (moiré) that float over a photo of a screen, are both aliasing.
更自然的补法是照抄：图外缺的那一格，就当它和离它最近的边上像素一样。这叫<b>复: A more natural way to pad is to copy: treat each missing cell outside the image as equal to the nearest pixel on the edge. This is called replicate edge. Photo editors handle the image border this way when they enlarge or blur a photo.
最光滑的波是正弦波（cos 或 sin）。再复杂的图案，也是许多这样的波叠起来的: The smoothest waves are sinusoids (cos or sin). Any pattern, however complex, is many such waves added together.
最后把检查做成一份报告：一张热图给人看，一个数给流水线判断要不要拦下这个模型。: Finally the check becomes a report: a heat map for people to look at, and a number for the pipeline to decide whether to hold the model back.
最后的全连接加 Sigmoid 就是<level-ref to=\"4-5\">: The final dense layer plus sigmoid is the neuron from <level-ref to="4-5"></level-ref>, turning features into a score. The letters move around and vary in strength: how should the parts before it turn the image into such features? Once it is built, press Train.
最大池化留下每个 2×2 块里最大的那个数，却没记下它在块里的哪一格。放大回来时: Max pooling keeps the largest number of each 2×2 block, but does not record which cell of the block it was in. When enlarging back, where should it go?
最小二乘会被每个杂点往外拽一点；RANSAC 只信得到最多支持的那条线，再用它的: Least squares gets pulled a little by every speck; RANSAC trusts only the line with the most support and refits it on its inliers, so however many specks there are they cannot drag it. The number of rounds is set by the share of specks, and δ by how much the points on the line wobble.
最直接的办法是隔一个点留一个：32×32 的图，每行每列只留一半，就成了 16×: The most direct way is to keep every other pixel: keep half of every row and column of a 32×32 picture and it becomes 16×16.
最直接的检测办法：拿一个模板在图上一格一格挪过去，每到一处打个分，看像不像。: The most direct way to detect: move a template over the picture cell by cell, scoring at each place how alike it looks.
最简单的例子是取平均。把一格换成它和邻居的平均，孤零零的亮点会被摊开，忽亮忽暗的: The simplest example is averaging. Replace a cell with the average of itself and its neighbours, and a lone bright dot gets spread out while flickering specks get smoothed away. A phone's night mode uses the same kind of trick to suppress noise.
最近的距离小于第二近的 0.8 倍时，输出最近那个的编号 1–3；否则输出 0。: Outputs the number 1–3 of the nearest when its distance is under 0.8 times the second nearest; otherwise 0.
有一种有名的图：近看是一个人，退到几米外再看，变成了另一个人。它叫<b>混合图像: There is a famous kind of picture: up close it shows one person, but step back a few metres and it becomes someone else. It is called a hybrid image, created by researchers in 2006, and it relies on exactly the frequencies this chapter is about.
有三个输入口，将接入的图逐像素相加；空置的输入口不计入: Has three inputs and adds the pictures wired into them pixel by pixel; an empty input is skipped
有了可学习的元件，电路里有些权重就不再由你来填，而由机器自己调。只要电路里有这种: With learnable parts, some weights in a circuit are no longer filled in by you but tuned by the machine. Whenever a circuit contains such a part, two buttons appear: “Train 1 step” and “Train 10 steps”.
有些核能拆成「一列乘一行」，比如 3×3 平均就是横向三点平均再接纵向三点平均。: Some kernels split into “a column times a row”: a 3×3 average, for example, is a 3-point horizontal average followed by a 3-point vertical one. Then filtering across once and down once gives the same result as using the whole kernel. This is separable filtering.
有些边只有颜色在变，亮度不变，比如一样亮的红和绿挨在一起。色盲检测图就是这样画的: Some edges change only in colour, not in brightness, such as equally bright red and green side by side. Colour-blindness test plates are drawn this way: an eye that only sees light and dark cannot make out the number inside.
有人用一个 3×3 核处理了这些图。把你的核拧成和它一样。: Someone processed these images with a 3×3 kernel. Dial your kernel in until it matches.
有人用一种邻居加权和处理了这些图。用平移、常数和四则运算，搭出同样的处理。: Someone processed these images with a weighted sum of neighbours. Build the same processing out of shifts, constants, multiplications and additions.
有人用这样一组挪法和系数处理了几张图，你只看得到输入和输出。第一组测试只有一个亮: Someone processed a few pictures with such a set of shifts and numbers, and you can only see the inputs and outputs. The first test is a single bright dot.
有时同一张图里既有小物体，也有大物体。除了叠起来看得更远，还可以让几条路同时看不: A single image can contain both small and large objects. Besides stacking layers to see farther, several paths can look at different-sized regions at the same time and combine their results. Inception networks use such multi-scale branches.
有时特征点会整体偏一格。这一关的要求是：偏了一格，缩小后的结果也要和原位时完全一: Sometimes all the feature points are off by one pixel. This level's requirement: off by one pixel, the shrunk result must be exactly the same as in place.
有的元件带设置，比如乘几、门槛多高、往哪个方向挪、九个权重。改一个设置，所有元件: Some parts have settings: what to multiply by, how high a threshold is, which way to shift, nine weights. Change a setting and the results on every part update at once; a part with an input left unwired says it is missing one.
有的关列出几组「新样本」：它们不参加训练，只用来检查，面板里会多画一条它们的误差: Some levels list a few "new samples": they take no part in training and are only checked, and the panel draws an extra error line for them. Some levels let you choose the learning rate yourself: how big each step is.
服务器每天要做成千上万张缩略图，计算量就是电费。这一关开始有预算。: The server makes thousands of thumbnails a day, and the cost is the electricity bill. From this level on there is a budget.
期望图并不比原件更清楚，只是没有颗粒。图边上的纸不能变黑。: The expected image is no sharper than the original, it just has no grain. Paper at the image border must not turn dark.
期望的输出是一种柔和的模糊，没有任何波纹。这次不在图上模糊，而是到频域里去：给每: The expected output is a soft blur with no ripples at all. This time you do not blur on the picture; you go to the frequency domain instead: give each frequency a gain and process the photo with <part-ref to="part:fqApply"></part-ref>. You make the gain picture yourself, from "Frequency radius".
机关台上画着一条真实的波、采到的点，以及只看这些点时它像什么。三个小实验各问一件: The bench draws a real wave, the samples taken from it, and what it looks like if you only see those samples. Three small experiments each ask one thing: can one wave pose as another? How few samples can you get away with and still recognise it? What can you do before sampling?
机器人和汽车上的双目相机也靠视差判断远近。这一关的两张图都是随机噪点，单看哪张都: The stereo cameras on robots and cars also use disparity to judge distance. Both images in this level are random dots, and neither shows any shape on its own; in 1960 the psychologist Julesz used images like these to show that people can see depth without recognising any object.
机器人靠双目相机躲障碍。视差只能按像素算，差一个像素，报出的距离就差一截；视差太: A robot uses stereo cameras to avoid obstacles. Disparity can only be measured in whole pixels, so being off by one pixel puts the reported distance off by a fair amount; and if the disparity is too large, it falls outside the range the camera can search, so no match is found.
机器怎样自己学会: How does a machine learn by itself?
杂点越多，一轮抽中两个线上点的机会越小。: The more specks, the smaller the chance that a round draws two points on the line.
权重全正、和为 1：变软。正负相抵、和为 0：平坦处变 0。只有一个 1：整张图: All weights positive, summing to 1: softer. Positives and negatives cancelling, summing to 0: flat areas become 0. A single 1: the whole image shifts by one pixel.
极点是另一台相机的光心在这张图里的位置：所有极线都从它发出。它垂直于 F 的每一: The epipole is where the other camera's centre appears in this image: every epipolar line comes out of it. It is perpendicular to every column of F, so it is the cross product of two columns: the solution of Fᵀe′ = 0.
极线与基础矩阵: Epipolar lines and the fundamental matrix
查询 Q 与各个键 K 分别比较，得到权重；这些权重用于汇总对应的值 V。先用图: A query Q is compared with each key K to obtain weights, which combine the corresponding values V. First use patches directly to observe these three roles.
标出场景中所有红色区域，包括亮处和阴影里的红色区域。: Mark every red area in the scene, including red areas in both light and shade.
核压过整张图: A kernel passing over the whole image
格子太细，同一条线带噪声的票落不进同一格；太粗，两条相近的线挤进同一个峰。: With cells too fine, one line's noisy votes do not land in the same cell; too coarse, and two nearby lines squeeze into one peak.
检测仪的最后一关。金属板本该是平的，允许它轻微弯曲；磕出的坑和划痕会让表面明显倾: The inspection machine's final level. A sheet should be flat, though a slight bend is allowed; dents and scratches make the surface tilt clearly.
检测出的框和标注的框 IoU 大于 0.5 时输出 1，否则 0。: Output 1 when the IoU of the detected box and the labelled box is above 0.5, otherwise 0.
检测器不是凭空画框：它先在每个位置放几个固定大小的锚框，再估计该把锚框挪多少、拉: A detector does not draw boxes out of nothing: it first places a few anchors of fixed size at every position, then estimates how far to move them and how much to stretch them.
检测器会从多个位置报出候选框。同一物体可能被报多次：先保留高分候选，再看与它重叠: A detector proposes boxes at many locations. Several candidates can report the same object. Keep the high-scoring candidate first, then decide which overlapping lower-scoring candidates should survive.
检测器先放一个锚框，再给出四个修正。框的中心 = 锚框中心 + 修正 × 锚框的: The detector places an anchor box first, then gives four corrections. The box centre = the anchor centre + correction × the anchor's width (or height); the box width = the anchor width × e^tw, and the height likewise.
检测器给出一串框，每个带一个分数。按分数排好，逐个看是对是错，就能给检测器打一个: A detector gives a list of boxes, each with a score. Sort them by score, check each in turn for right or wrong, and the detector can be given an overall mark.
检测器认两类东西，每类各有一张排名表。输出两类 AP 的平均（mAP）。: The detector recognises two kinds of thing, each with its own ranking. Output the average of the two classes' APs (mAP).
检测结果按分数从高到低排好，每一个标了对（1）错（0）。第 k 名的精确率 =: The detections are sorted by score, high to low, each marked right (1) or wrong (0). The precision at rank k = the number right in the top k ÷ k. AP = the precisions at each right rank, added up, ÷ G.
模型可以加深、增加通道，或者看更高分辨率的图；这些选择都可能增加计算量，效果也要: A model can be made deeper, given more channels, or shown higher-resolution images. Each choice can increase computation, and its benefit must be checked on new samples. EfficientNet studies how to adjust depth, width and resolution together within a computing budget.
模板打分、多尺度、非极大值抑制，每个 X 恰好标一次：一台最简单的检测器。把模板: Template scores, several scales, non-maximum suppression, each X marked exactly once: the simplest detector. Replace the template with learnt convolutions and add box regression, and you have a real object-detection network, its results measured with the IoU and AP you built.
模糊把噪声和斑点一起抹开。瓶颈只放得下两个数，噪声要几个数才记得住？: A blur smears the noise and the blob alike. The bottleneck holds only two numbers; how many would it take to remember the noise?
模糊的图只剩中心一团低频，噪声则什么频率都有。游戏里的频谱按对数画，弱的波也看得: A blurred image keeps only a clump of low frequencies in the centre, while noise has every frequency. The game draws spectra on a log scale, so weak waves show up too.
模糊过的曲线只剩低频。从这个角度看，模糊就是把高频调小。: A blurred curve keeps only its low frequencies. Seen this way, blurring means turning the high frequencies down.
横向差分处理亮方块：两侧一正一负: Horizontal difference on a bright square: one side positive, the other negative
正则化的强度 λ 太小拦不住过拟合，太大又让模型连真规律都学不会，叫欠拟合。Dr: If the strength λ is too small it cannot hold off overfitting; too large and the model cannot learn even the true rule, which is called underfitting. Dropout and data augmentation serve the same purpose.
正式上线：灯只剩 80%，零件上既有凹坑（偏暗），也有反光的划痕（偏亮）。两种缺: Going live: the lamp is at 80%, and parts have both dents (darker) and shiny scratches (brighter). Mark both kinds of defect with 1 and everything else with 0.
正确。你得到了<part-ref to=\"shift\"></part-ref: Correct. You now have <part-ref to="shift"></part-ref>: it moves the whole image by one pixel and fills the gap left at the border with 0. Its direction can be set to up, down, left or right.
正确。你得到了<part-ref to=\"threshold\"></part: Correct. You now have <part-ref to="threshold"></part-ref>: cells above the threshold t become 1 and the rest 0, and you choose t. An image of only 0s and 1s is called a mask; it marks out a region of the picture.
正面光下，你已经把表面朝向和反射率结合成亮度。现在灯移到右上方：只看法线的 z: With frontal light, you combined surface orientation and reflectance into brightness. Now the lamp moves to the upper right: the normal’s z component alone is no longer enough, and the full directions matter.
正面光下，法线的 z 分量给出表面朝向光的程度：正对光的地方最亮，倾斜的地方较暗: Under frontal light, the normal’s z component measures how directly the surface faces the light: points facing it are brightest and tilted points are darker.
正面光下，表面朝向决定光照的强弱；但即使朝向相同，白漆和深色漆也不会一样亮。现在: Under frontal light, surface orientation determines illumination; even at the same orientation, white and dark paint do not look equally bright. Now paint the surface with different reflectances.
正面灯的照片是反射率 × nz。另两张各多了一个分量。: The front lamp's photo is reflectance × nz. The other two each bring in one more component.
步幅为 2，输出就隔一个取一个。一般地，输出边长 = ⌊(N + 2p − k): With a stride of 2, the output keeps every other position. In general, output width = ⌊(N + 2p − k) / s⌋ + 1, with N the input width, k the window size, p the padding and s the stride. This layer has only 9 numbers to learn, however big or small the picture, because the same weights are used at every position: this is called weight sharing. See "Parameters" in the score.
残差连接让输入沿捷径通过，并让卷积分支学习调整量：y = x + F(x)。当目: A residual connection passes the input along a shortcut and lets the convolution branch learn an adjustment: y = x + F(x). When the target is close to the input, the network can start near the identity and learn the needed change. The shortcut also provides a direct path for gradients, but does not guarantee that every deep network will train successfully. The sharpening task here is simple and does not require every layer to learn a different feature.
母舰会给你一系列测试。每通过一个，你就多一个可以用的元件。: The mothership will send you a series of tests. Each one you pass gives you a new part to use.
每一格是一个关键点，三张图是它到三个候选的距离。最近的距离 d₁ 小于第二近 d: Each cell is a keypoint, and the three maps are its distances to three candidates. When the nearest distance d₁ is less than 0.8 times the second nearest d₂, output the number of the nearest candidate, 1, 2 or 3; otherwise output 0.
每个 2×2 块取最大值，尺寸减半: Takes the maximum of each 2×2 block, halving the size
每个 2×2 块的最大值被池化成了一格。把它放回块里原来那一格，块里其余三格是: Each 2×2 block's largest value was pooled into one cell. Put it back in the cell of the block it came from, with the other three cells of the block 0.
每个亮点都投票，可一个孤零零的亮点票数分散，成不了峰。: Every bright point votes, but a lone speck spreads its votes thin and makes no peak.
每个像素变成 1 − 自己：亮的变暗，暗的变亮: Every pixel becomes 1 − itself: light turns dark and dark turns light
每个像素各算各的，互不打扰。这叫逐像素运算：它改变亮度，却永远不知道邻居是谁。: Each pixel is worked out on its own, leaving the others alone. This is a per-pixel operation: it changes brightness, but never knows who its neighbours are.
每个像素换成它周围 3×3 九个格子的平均。计算量不能超过 6。: Replace each pixel with the average of the nine cells in the 3×3 block around it. The cost must not exceed 6.
每个像素换成它周围 5×5 共 25 格的平均。计算量不能超过 8。: Replace each pixel with the average of the 25 cells in the 5×5 block around it. The cost must not exceed 8.
每个像素换成它和上下两个邻居的平均。: Replace each pixel with the average of itself and its neighbours above and below.
每个像素换成它和左右两个邻居的平均。: Replace each pixel with the average of itself and its left and right neighbours.
每个元件可以单独换画法；电脑上画布左下角的「全部画成」一次换掉所有图像元件，旁边: Each part can switch its own view; on a desktop, “Draw all as” at the bottom left of the board switches every image part at once, and the button beside it restores the level’s default views. Changing the view does not change the circuit and needs no new test run.
每个元件有一个或几个输入口（比如 a、b，或者左、右），只有一个输出点。线从一块: Every part has one or more input ports (such as a and b, or left and right) and a single output dot. A wire runs from one block’s output dot to another block’s input port: an output can feed many places, but each input port reads from one wire. Wires cannot form a loop, since a block cannot wait for itself to finish.
每个元件都显示它在当前选中的那组测试上算出的结果，所以你可以沿着电路一路看图像怎: Every part shows what it produces on the currently selected test, so you can follow the image as it changes along the circuit.
每个图块都换成全图最亮（各格加起来最大）的那个图块。: Replace every patch with the brightest patch in the picture (the one whose cells add up to the most).
每个注意力只能按一种相似去找。多头注意力并排放几个注意力，各自用自己的 Q、K: Each attention can only look for one kind of likeness. Multi-head attention puts several side by side, each finding one kind of relation with its own Q and K, and then puts their results together. Every layer of a Transformer has several heads.
每个点写成 (x, y, 1)。线一过 p、q，线二过 r、s。输出两条线的交点: Each point is written (x, y, 1). Line 1 passes through p and q, line 2 through r and s. Output where the two lines meet, also as three numbers (no need to make the third one 1).
每个角只输出一个点：Harris 响应乘 2 以后，峰顶输出 1。: Output a single point per corner: after multiplying the Harris response by 2, output 1 at its tops.
每个输出各是一小段算式。: Each output is a short formula of its own.
每个边缘点给所有经过它的直线 (θ, ρ) 各投一票。调分箱大小，让三张图里票数: Each edge point casts one vote for every line (θ, ρ) that passes through it. Adjust the bin size so that in all three images the two peaks with the most votes are exactly the two lines.
每关有几组测试，每组是一份输入和一份期望的输出。你的输出要和期望逐格比对：每格允: Each level has a few tests, and each test is an input with its expected output. Your output is compared with the expected one cell by cell: each cell may be off by a tiny amount (the tolerance), and the size must match too. Some levels let a few cells be wrong.
每关的元件栏只摆出这一关给的元件。地图上的「元件箱」列出游戏里所有元件，已拿到的: Each level’s parts list holds only the parts that level offers. The “Parts” box on the map lists every part in the game, with the ones you have earned lit up and described. When a level asks you to build something by hand, the ready-made version is put away for that level.
每关记下你的最好成绩，地图上已通过的关会显示它。评分一般不影响过关，可以过后再回: Your best score for each level is kept and shown on the map beside the passed level. The score does not usually affect passing, so you can come back later and improve it.
每块板在三盏灯下各拍一张：右灯、下灯和正面灯，方向都在说明里。三张照片里，漆色是: Each sheet is photographed under three lamps: from the right, from below and from the front, with their directions in the brief. The paint is the same in all three photos; only the lamp changes.
每对对应点给 2 个方程，所以至少要 4 对点，常用 DLT 解出 H。<b>仿: Each pair of corresponding points gives 2 equations, so at least 4 pairs are needed, and H is usually solved with DLT. An affine map has only 6 degrees of freedom and is fixed by 3 pairs, but it keeps parallel lines parallel, so it cannot fit a book seen in perspective.
每层只看 3×3，可第二层看的是第一层的输出，等于看到了 5×5；第三层看到 7: Each layer looks at only 3×3, but the second layer looks at the first layer's output, so in effect it sees 5×5; the third sees 7×7. This is the receptive field: stack L layers of 3×3 and the receptive field is (2L+1)×(2L+1). VGG sees large areas by stacking small kernels, and three 3×3 layers have only 27 weights, while a single 7×7 kernel needs 49.
每层都从很小的随机数开始，图每过一层就缩小几十倍。有没有办法让一层的权重哪怕很小: Every layer starts from very small random numbers, so the image shrinks tens of times over at each layer. Is there a way for a layer to keep the image from shrinking away even when its weights are tiny?
每按一次，九个旋钮一起往下坡挪一步（和<level-ref to=\"4-1\": Each press moves all nine knobs one step downhill together (just as in <level-ref to="4-1"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="4-2"></level-ref>, only with more knobs). Watch the loss curve go down.
每条极线都是 F 的列的组合。两条极线交在哪里，你会算。: Every epipolar line is a mix of the columns of F. You know how to find where two lines meet.
每格换成它周围 3×3 九个格子的平均: Each cell becomes the average of the nine cells in the 3×3 block around it
每格换成它和左右两个邻居的平均: Each cell becomes the average of itself and its left and right neighbours
每算一次都重新抽一个随机数: Draws a fresh random number every time it runs
每组测试是一个样本：输入一个亮度，期望一个亮度，规律是 输出 = w × 输入，: Each test is one sample: a brightness in, a brightness expected out, following output = w × input with w unknown. Use a <part-ref to="part:lrnConst"></part-ref> as w and press Train to let the machine find it. Choose a learning rate.
每组测试是一张字母图，已经缩成两个数：斜笔画多少、弯笔画多少。于是一张图就是平面: Each test is a letter picture already reduced to two numbers: how much diagonal stroke and how much curved stroke. So a picture is a point in the plane, and the neuron gives each point a score.
每组测试是一张字母图，已经缩成两个数：斜笔画多少、弯笔画多少。搭一个神经元：两个: Each test is a letter picture already reduced to two numbers: how much diagonal stroke and how much curved stroke. Build a neuron: multiply each number by a learnable weight, add them up and add a learnable bias z, then squash it between 0 and 1 with 1 / (1 + e^(−z)). Train it: above 0.6 for X, below 0.4 for O.
每训练一步，所有可学习的权重都朝着让误差变小的方向挪一点。旁边的损失曲线画出误差: Each training step nudges every learnable weight a little in the direction that makes the error smaller. The loss curve beside the buttons shows how the error changes, on a log scale.
每轮给出一张输入图、一张输出图和四个 3×3 核，请选出产生这张输出图的核。: Each round shows an input, an output and four 3×3 kernels. Pick the kernel that produced the output.
每轮随机抽 2 个点连成直线，数离它不到 δ 的点，k 轮后留下支持最多的一条。: Each round draws 2 random points, joins them into a line and counts the points closer than δ to it; after k rounds the line with the most support is kept. For each of the three outlier ratios, use a k within the budget so that the success rate over 200 trials is ≥ 99%.
每隔一个像素取一个，尺寸减半: Keeps every other pixel, halving the size
比 3×3 邻居都不小、又大于 0.3 的格子输出 1，其余输出 0。: Outputs 1 where a cell is no smaller than its 3×3 neighbours and above 0.3, and 0 elsewhere.
比例接近 1，分类器认的是车；接近 0，它认的是路。训练集里每辆车都停在路上，只: Near 1, the classifier recognises the car; near 0, the road. Every car in the training set stood on a road, so looking at the road alone sorts the training set correctly; a shortcut like that is found this way. A negative fraction means the car's cells are pulling the score down.
比较各通道后选择苹果，再检查。: Compare the channels, choose an apple, and check.
比较时围着每格取一个窗口。大窗口抗噪，却会抹掉细节；小窗口保细节，却怕噪声。没有: Each comparison uses a window round the cell. A large window resists noise but wipes out detail; a small one keeps detail but is vulnerable to noise. No window is best for every image, and methods such as multi-scale and global optimisation try to get both at once.
求坡度去掉了整体加亮（偏置），除以最陡的坡度去掉了整体倍数（增益）。设计特征时先: Taking slopes removes an overall brightening (the offset); dividing by the steepest slope removes an overall scaling (the gain). When you design a feature, first ask: which changes should not change the answer? This is called invariance. Mind the padding outside the image: padding with 0 creates a fake edge at the border that changes with the lighting, so replicate the edge instead.
池化把位置丢掉了一部分，反池化把它找回来：亮点在 2×2 块里的哪一格，信息还在: Pooling throws part of the position away, and unpooling gets it back: which cell of the 2×2 block the dot was in is still in the picture before pooling.
没有人告诉机器哪些是前景、哪些是背景时，它能不能自己把像素分成几堆？: When nobody tells the machine what is foreground and what is background, can it split the pixels into heaps by itself?
没有位置时，把两个图块对调，注意力的输出也只是跟着对调：它看到的是一袋图块，不是: Without position, swap two patches and attention's output just swaps with them: it sees a bag of patches, not a sequence. You added each patch's number times a small amount: this is a positional encoding z̃ᵢ = zᵢ + pᵢ, so every patch carries its own address and order can enter the computation. ViT adds the position to every patch before the first layer.
没有噪声和文字，但纸常常超出扫描范围。输出纸的边：横边和竖边都要，在 x、y 两: No noise and no text, but the paper often runs off the scan. Output the paper's edges, horizontal and vertical: 1 wherever the sum of the squared Sobel responses in x and y is above 0.04. The image border is not a paper edge.
没有对所有图都最好的窗口：大窗口抗噪但抹掉细节，小窗口保细节但怕噪声。很多视觉问: No window is best for every image: a large window resists noise but wipes out detail; a small one keeps detail but is vulnerable to noise. Many vision problems involve this kind of trade-off.
没有标签，只有每张图的两个变形版本。训练编码器，让测验里的每个视图都以 ≥ 50: No labels, only two altered versions of each image. Train the encoder so that every view in the quiz picks out its partner with probability ≥ 50%.
没有纹理的地方，视差搜索什么也配不上。: Where there is no texture, disparity search cannot match anything.
没有讲解，只有元件、测试和一组输入输出。从“把图挪一格”开始，自己搭出模糊、边缘: No lectures: just parts, tests and a set of inputs and outputs. Start from “move the picture one pixel”, build blur, edges, corners and disparity yourself, and finally teach the machine to see.
没有说明书。动手试，看测试图，读数字。: There is no manual. Try things, look at the test pictures, read the numbers.
沿亮点测试追踪三个平均元件的输出。第一块把亮点摊成平顶方块，后两块让响应扩得更宽: Follow the bright-dot test through all three averaging parts. The first spreads the dot into a flat-topped square. The next two spread the response further and give more weight to the centre than to the edges. Repeated neighbourhood averaging approximates Gaussian smoothing. A wider smoothing response attenuates wider details too.
沿用上一段电路，计算 Harris 响应。A、B 是 Gx²、Gy² 的 3×3: Continue the circuit to calculate the Harris response. A and B are the 3×3 averages of Gx² and Gy²; C is the 3×3 average of Gx·Gy. C measures how the directions vary together: a diagonal edge can make A and B large, but C² offsets that case. Output 100 × [AB − C² − 0.05(A + B)²], and compare edges and corners.
沿用上一段电路，让图块先经过可学习的标量变换，再计算注意力。用三个可学习常数分别: Continue from the previous circuit and transform the patches with learnable scalars before attention. Use three learnable constants to produce Q, K and V: transform a into Q, use the same K transformation for a and b, and likewise share the V transformation. Train the parameters to match the targets.
沿用上一段的 Harris 响应电路，在响应大于 0.22 的位置输出 1，其余: Continue the Harris response circuit: output 1 where the response exceeds 0.22 and 0 elsewhere.
法线在上下方向上的分量。鼓包上下两侧的朝向相反。: The normal's up–down component. The upper and lower sides of the bump face opposite ways.
法线在左右方向上的分量。鼓包两侧的朝向相反，所以图中一边暗、一边亮。: The normal's left–right component. Opposite sides of the bump face opposite ways, so one side of the image is dark and the other light.
法线朝向相机的分量。鼓包顶部和平板正对相机，图中较亮；鼓包斜坡较暗。: The component of the normal toward the camera. The top of the bump and the flat plate face the camera and appear brighter in this image; the slopes appear darker.
波形 A：输入的一行，和期望读出的数: Waveform A: the input row and the expected reading
波：振幅、频率、相位与方向: Waves: amplitude, frequency, phase and direction
注意力先比较查询和键，再用权重汇总值。接下来沿用这块电路，加入可学习参数生成 Q: Attention first compares a query with keys, then combines values using the resulting weights. Next, continue from this circuit and add learnable parameters to produce Q, K and V.
注意力的每一格都要把所有图块加一遍。图块越大，图块越少。: Each cell of attention adds up over every patch. The bigger the patches, the fewer there are.
注意力里，每一格都要把所有图块加一遍。图块切得越小，图块就越多，要算的也越多。: In attention, every cell adds up over all the patches. The smaller the patches, the more of them there are, and the more there is to compute.
测试图是一片灰，里面有一块亮、一块暗。按先左后右、再从上到下的顺序，亮块在前就整: Each test image is grey with one bright patch and one dark patch. Reading left to right, then top to bottom, output 1 everywhere if the bright patch comes first, otherwise 0. The tests come in pairs: the same two patches with their positions swapped.
测试图的一对对角上本是同一个小图案，其中一个被擦掉几格；也有一组什么都没擦。这一: In each test image, two opposite corners hold the same small pattern, but one has had a few pixels erased; one set has nothing erased. This level allows at most 3 nodes. The question is: where else in the image does an erased pixel still show what it looked like?
测试是十六个位置不同的斑点，期望输出和输入一模一样。用的数越少越好，所以要找的是: The tests are sixteen blobs in different positions, and the expected output is identical to the input. The fewer numbers you use the better, so what you are looking for is: what is the smallest number that still works?
测试面板列出每组测试，点一组看它的详情：输入、期望、你的输出，以及一张误差图，标: The test panel lists every test; pick one to see its details: the input, the expected output, your output, and an error map marking which cells are outside the tolerance. A failing test says why, such as how many pixels are outside the tolerance, or that the size is wrong.
涂黑一块，分数丢掉的正是那一块里每一格原来出的分。: Blacking out a block loses exactly what each cell in the block used to add.
滑窗加门槛。门槛要高过噪点能凑出来的分数。: A sliding window and a threshold, high enough that grain cannot add up to it.
滤波是线性的：低通(A) − 低通(B) = 低通(A − B)。先合起来再滤，: Filtering is linear: low-pass(A) − low-pass(B) = low-pass(A − B). Combining first and then filtering gives the same as filtering each and then combining, so one transform is enough. Many things that look as if they need computing twice can be merged into once like this.
滤波是线性的：先合起来再滤，和分别滤完再合起来，结果一样。这让很多看起来要两步的: Filtering is linear: combining and then filtering gives the same result as filtering each and then combining. That lets many things that seem to need two steps be done in one.
灯从正面照来，方向是 (0, 0, 1)。白色表面各点的亮度等于法线与灯方向夹角: The light shines from the front, in direction (0, 0, 1). Each point on the white surface has brightness equal to the cosine of the angle between its normal and the light direction. Draw the brightness image from the given normal components; you do not need to add any parts.
灯光变化大致有两种。整体加亮（每个像素 + b，偏置）只把地形整体抬高，坡度不变: Lighting changes come roughly in two kinds. Brightening everything (+ b on every pixel, an offset) just lifts the whole landscape and leaves the slopes as they were, so the gradient is unchanged by it. A stronger or dimmer lamp (× a on every pixel, a gain) multiplies every slope by a, so a fixed threshold stops working.
灯光是乘上去的：亮度 = 灯 × 表面。乘回 1 ÷ 0.8 = 1.25，就回: Light multiplies: brightness = lamp × surface. Multiplying back by 1 ÷ 0.8 = 1.25 restores the lighting the reference was taken under, and only then is the comparison fair. Adjusting the threshold alone fails: bright areas lose more to the dim lamp than dark areas lose to a dent.
灯暗了 20%，亮的地方和暗的地方，各暗了多少？只调门槛够不够？: With the lamp 20% dimmer, how much do bright areas lose, and how much dark ones? Is adjusting the threshold enough?
灯暗了，实物处处都比标准件暗，可零件并没有问题。质检台不能因此到处报警。: With the lamp dimmer, the part is darker than the reference everywhere, yet nothing is wrong with it. The station must not raise alarms all over because of that.
灯的方向为 (0, 0, 1)。把表面朝向光的程度与反射率结合，画出不同漆色和不: The light direction is (0, 0, 1). Combine how directly the surface faces the light with its reflectance to draw the brightness produced by both paint and orientation.
灯的方向只有 z 分量；两个单位方向夹角的余弦，是对应分量相乘后相加。: The light direction has only a z component. The cosine between two unit directions is the sum of their pairwise component products.
灰色渐变上的蓝条: Blue bar on a grey gradient
点之间发生了什么，采样后谁也不知道。一个周期里至少要有几个点，才认得出这道波？: Once sampled, nobody knows what happened between the points. How many points per cycle, at least, does it take to recognise the wave?
点乘就是逐个相乘再加起来；三个数的平均乘 3 就是它们的和。: A dot product multiplies number by number and adds up; the average of three numbers times 3 is their sum.
点在线上吗: Is the point on the line?
点对每 4 个数一对：(x, y) → (x′, y′)。k = 0 时用全部点: Pairs come four numbers at a time: (x, y) → (x′, y′). With k = 0 it solves from all the pairs (DLT); with k > 0 it runs RANSAC: k rounds each solve H from 4 random pairs and count the pairs it maps within 1.5 pixels, and the largest group is solved again. Outputs the 9 numbers of H
热图给人看，一个数给流水线用：上线前把每个模型在一批照片上跑一遍，比例低的先拦下: The heat map is for people to look at, the number for the pipeline: before release, every model runs over a batch of photos, and the ones with a low fraction are held back. In these photos cars and roads always go together, so a high score does not show the model learnt the right thing; what matters is why it is high.
热图里的车: The car in the heat map
然后在亮底图上做 3×3 平均，输出和输入一样大，边上一圈不能发黑。: Then take a 3×3 average of images on a bright background, with the output the same size as the input and no dark ring round the border.
照片 = 颜色 × 光照。已知其中两个，怎样求第三个？减法行不行，看看阴影里的格: Photo = colour × lighting. If you know two of them, how do you find the third? To see whether subtracting works, look at the squares in the shadow.
照片中的明暗由表面颜色和光照共同决定。在本关的模型里，已知各处光照，就能恢复表面: Brightness in a photograph depends on both surface colour and illumination. In this model, known illumination lets us recover RGB reflectance; where no light reaches the surface, the photo contains no colour information.
照片只留下这三者的乘积：一块地方暗，可能是灯弱了、漆暗了，也可能只是表面转开了。: A photo keeps only the product of the three: a dark patch may mean a weaker lamp, darker paint, or just a surface turned away. From brightness alone you cannot tell which.
照片的明暗从哪来: Where do light and shade come from?
照片的明暗从哪里来？先从一块白色哑光表面开始：灯从相机方向照来，表面不同位置的倾: Where does light and shade in a photograph come from? Start with a white matte surface lit from the camera direction. Its orientation affects how much light reaches each point.
照片里有噪声。只在真正的台阶处输出 1（台阶都是左暗右亮）。: The photo is noisy. Output 1 only at the real step (every step is dark on the left, bright on the right).
照片里每一点的亮度 = 表面本来的颜色（反射率）× 照到那一点的光。第二个输入告: The brightness of each point in a photo = the surface's own colour (its reflectance) × the light reaching that point. The second input tells you how much light each point gets (1 is full light; in shadow it is much less). Remove the shadows and shading and output only the surface's own colour.
照片里混进了细密的噪点。用<part-ref to=\"freq-filter\: Fine noise has crept into the photos. Remove it with <part-ref to="freq-filter"></part-ref>: the output must be as clean and soft as the expected image.
照片里的狗是一团团亮斑，边有点糊。每只狗只输出一个点，在它正中间。: The dogs in the photo are bright patches, a little blurred at the edges. Output a single point for each dog, at its very centre.
照片里，表面本来的颜色和照到的光乘在一起：照片 = 颜色 × 光照。白墙在阴影里: In a photo, a surface’s own colour and the light falling on it are multiplied together: photo = colour × lighting. A white wall in shadow looks grey, and dark floor tiles can look bright in sunshine.
熟练以后，扫一眼核里的数就能猜出它做什么。全是正数、加起来为 1 的核在平滑，权: With practice, a glance at the numbers in a kernel tells you what it does. All positive and adding up to 1 means smoothing, and the more the weight is concentrated in the centre, the closer the result is to the original.
特征匹配与距离比检验: Feature matching and the ratio test
现代检测器在每个位置放几个<b>锚框</b>，再回归四个修正：中心挪 t × 锚: Modern detectors place a few anchors at every position and regress four corrections: the centre moves by t × the anchor's width or height, and the size is multiplied by e^t. Faster R-CNN and YOLO both work like this, and are scored with IoU and mAP.
现在 sin 探针也打开了，台上同时显示两个读数：cos 的 a 和 sin 的: Now the sin probe is on too, and the bench shows both readings: a from cos and b from sin. Which way of combining them equals the wave's amplitude, 0.30, however far it is shifted?
现在最好的图像生成模型叫扩散模型。它的训练从反方向开始：先把一张图一点点加噪，直: The best image generators today are called diffusion models. Their training starts the other way round: noise is added to a picture little by little until only noise is left.
现实里的光是一整条<b>光谱</b>：每种波长各有多少。相机和人眼一样只有三种感: Real light is a whole spectrum: so much of each wavelength. Cameras, like eyes, have only three kinds of light sensor, each sensitive to a band of wavelengths, so the whole spectrum is squeezed into three numbers: R, G and B.
理想的结局是生成器画出的分布和真实数据一样，鉴定员只能瞎猜，准确率回到 50%。: Ideally the generator ends up drawing the same distribution as the real data, so the judge can only guess and its accuracy is back to 50%.
瓶颈里只有两个数，装得下「斑点在哪」，装不下每一格的噪声，所以解码出来是干净的。: The bottleneck holds only two numbers: enough for "where the blob is", not for the noise in every cell, so what is decoded comes out clean. Training with noisy inputs and the original as the target gives a denoising autoencoder, and diffusion models push the idea all the way: denoise from pure noise, little by little, to draw new pictures.
生成器一回合走太远，就会一起冲向鉴定员此刻最相信的那一处。: If the generator moves too far in one round, both pens rush together to the spot the judge trusts most right now.

生成器画出来的东西是随机的。要让它按要求画，得多告诉它一点什么。: What a generator draws is random. To make it draw what is asked for, it has to be told something more.

Networks like VGG are built this way; pooling and larger strides make the receptive field grow faster still.

电脑上是一张工作台：左边是任务、提示和元件栏，中间是画布，右边是测试面板。点元件: On a desktop the screen is a workbench: the task, hint and parts list on the left, the board in the middle and the test panel on the right. Click a part in the list to drop it in a free spot on the board; drag a wire from the dot on the right of a part to another part; select a part or wire and press Delete to remove it.
电路里传的都是一格格数字，但可以换着画法看。一个数画成读数，一行数画成波形；二维: Everything in a circuit is a grid of numbers, but you can draw it in different ways. A single number is drawn as a reading and a single row as a waveform; a 2-D image starts out drawn as pixels, and later levels bring in four more ways: profile, terrain, spectrum and slope.
画出 a 和 b 「中间」的那个斑点：从 a 往 b 走了 t（0 是 a，1: Draw the blob "between" a and b: t of the way from a to b (0 is a, 1 is b).
留下低频、去掉高频的滤波叫<b>低通</b>。低频是大块缓慢的明暗，高频是细纹、: A filter that keeps the low frequencies and removes the high ones is called a low-pass filter. Low frequencies are broad, slow changes in brightness and high ones are fine texture, edges and noise, so a low-pass filter blurs and removes noise.
白平衡利用场景中对颜色的假设，估计并校正光源带来的偏色。本关假设白纸在三个通道中: White balance uses assumptions about scene colours to estimate and correct a light source’s colour cast. Here the white paper is assumed brightest in each channel; this can fail without a white object or under more complicated lighting and surfaces.
白纸本来应该是什么颜色？: What colour should the white paper really be?
监控画面上常给闯入者描一圈边，让人一眼看到它的轮廓，又不挡住它本身。: Security footage often draws an outline round an intruder, so its shape stands out at a glance without hiding it.
目标 · 前两个峰分别匹配 A 和 B: Goal · the top two peaks match A and B
目标 · 同时满足，连续 3 回合: Goals · all at once, 3 rounds in a row
目标是几道波加起来的。调各个频率的振幅，把你的曲线叠到目标上。: The target is a few waves added up. Set the amplitude of each frequency to stack your curve onto the target.
目标检测器用一个类别、一个置信度分数和一个边界框描述每个候选物体。类别回答是什么: An object detector describes each candidate with a class, a confidence score and a bounding box. The class tells you what it is, the score ranks candidates, and the box coordinates give location and size. This level holds the class fixed and compares the predicted box with a labelled box.
盯住两条误差线：训练误差一直往下走，新样本的误差先下降、后上升。上升的时候，模型: Keep your eye on the two error lines: the training error keeps going down, while the error on new samples first falls, then rises. While it rises, what is the model learning?
直接隔点取样，频率高于 8 的细纹会折回来，冒充成原图里没有的粗纹（莫尔纹），这: Downsample directly and fine stripes above frequency 8 fold back, posing as coarse stripes the original never had (moiré). That is aliasing. Suppress those frequencies with a Gaussian blur first, then sample: anti-aliasing must happen before sampling. Cameras and thumbnails both face the same problem.
相册要合并重复的照片：挪了位置、调了颜色、加了噪声的同一张照片输出 1，不同的照: The album wants to merge duplicate photos: output 1 for the same photo, even shifted, recoloured or noisy, and 0 for different photos.
相册要给每张照片做 4×4 的小图标：从 32×32 缩成 4×4，斑马板、布纹: The photo album wants a 4×4 icon for every photo: shrink 32×32 to 4×4 with no moiré on zone plates, fabric or text, and a cost of no more than 19.
相册要给每张照片做缩略图。这一章最后四关，就来搭这样一个缩略图服务：缩小照片，不: A photo album wants a thumbnail for every photo. The last four levels of this chapter build that thumbnail service: shrink photos with no moiré, and do it quickly.
相册里常有同一张照片的好几个版本：裁过的、调过色的、压缩出噪点的。整理相册时要把: An album often holds several versions of the same photo: cropped, recoloured, noisy from compression. Tidying the album means merging them into one, but different photos must not be merged.
相机和人眼一样，只有三种感光元件，各自对一段波长敏感。每种元件对每个波长有多敏感: A camera, like the human eye, has only three kinds of sensor, each sensitive to a range of wavelengths. How sensitive each is at each wavelength, drawn out, is its sensitivity curve.
相机和扫描仪只在一些位置记下亮度，用这些点代表连续的景物，这叫<b>采样</b>: A camera or scanner records brightness only at certain positions and lets those points stand for the continuous scene: this is sampling. With M samples you can only tell apart frequencies below M/2, a limit called the Nyquist frequency.
相机拍下的照片，在电脑里不是一幅画，而是一张数字表：画面切成许多小方格，叫<b>: Inside a computer, a photo is not a picture but a table of numbers: the image is cut into many small squares called pixels, and each one records a brightness. In this game 0 is black, 1 is white, and in between are shades of grey.
相机拍照、扫描仪扫图，都是把连续变化的景物变成一格格的数。这叫<b>采样</b>: A camera taking a photo and a scanner scanning a page both turn a continuously varying scene into a grid of numbers. This is called sampling: recording values at only some positions and letting them stand for the whole curve.
相机按快门时手一抖，照片就糊了一下。每台相机抖的样子都差不多，可没人知道具体是什: If the hand shakes as the shutter clicks, the photo blurs a little. Each camera shakes in much the same way, but nobody knows exactly how.
相机自动对焦时，要一边挪镜头一边判断：现在这张清楚吗？: When a camera focuses itself, it moves the lens and keeps asking: is this shot sharp now?
相机自动对焦时，要给每一张试拍打一个清晰度分。输出这个分：照片的频谱里，离中心超: When a camera focuses itself, it scores every trial shot for sharpness. Output that score: the sum of the spectrum cells more than 6 from the centre, divided by the total number of spectrum cells. "Frequency radius" tells you how far each spectrum cell is from the centre.
相邻差就是离散的<b>导数</b>。它有正负：从暗到亮为正，从亮到暗为负，符号说: The neighbour difference is a discrete derivative. It has a sign: positive from dark to bright, negative from bright to dark, so the sign tells you which way the edge faces. Since the result can be negative, terrain view shows it best: an edge becomes a ridge or a trench.
看一幅画，最先注意到的是轮廓：物体和背景的分界、衣服的褶、文字的笔画。在数字图里: When you look at a picture, the first thing you notice is outlines: where an object meets the background, the folds in clothing, the strokes of letters. In a digital image, what these places have in common is that the brightness changes suddenly over a very short distance. That is an edge.
