看输入和输出，选出是哪个 3×3 核做的（按<part-ref to=\"ker: Look at the input and the output, and pick the 3×3 kernel that made it (read the way the <part-ref to="kernel3"></part-ref> part reads it). Get 8 of 10 rounds right to pass; it gets faster as you go.
真实照片都带着<b>噪声</b>：光线暗时，每格的数会随机偏高或偏低一点。相邻差: Real photos always carry noise: in dim light, each cell’s number comes out randomly a little too high or too low. Neighbour differences are very sensitive to this jitter, so false edges pop up even on flat ground.
真实的两台相机很难摆得正，同一点常跑到别的行。可左图的一个点只确定一条视线，这条: Real cameras are rarely lined up exactly, so the same point often lands on a different row. But a point in the left image fixes only a line of sight, and every possible depth along it projects into the right image onto one straight line, called the <part-ref to="epiline"></part-ref>.
真实的扫描件有三个麻烦：传感器的噪点、纸上的字，还有超出扫描范围的纸。先对付第一: Real scans bring three problems: sensor noise, the text on the paper, and paper that runs off the edge of the scan. First, the noise.
真实的扫描件：有噪声，有字，纸常常超出扫描范围。输出纸张的边，和期望一样。: Real scans: noisy, with text, and the paper often runs off the edge. Output the paper's edges, as in the expected image.
真实的点对来自匹配器，桌面的花纹一格格重复，难免配错几对。: Real pairs come from the matcher, and with a desk pattern that repeats tile after tile, a few are bound to be wrong.
真实的照片有噪点，也有点糊，大小箱子混在一起。: A real photo is grainy and a little blurred, with large and small boxes mixed.
真实的照片都带着<b>噪声</b>：光线暗时，传感器收到的光少，每格的数会随机地: Real photos always carry noise: in dim light the sensor receives little light, and each cell's number comes out randomly a little too high or too low. Zoom into a photo taken at night and the grain you see is noise.
真实的立体相机也要挑这个大小。街景里有大片的墙，也有细细的电线杆和栏杆；光线暗时: Real stereo cameras have to pick this size too. A street scene has large stretches of wall, but also thin power poles and railings; in dim light the photos are full of noise. The same camera has to cope with all of it.
真实相机不会附送光照图，单看亮度也猜不准光照。: A real camera does not come with a lighting map, and brightness alone cannot pin the lighting down.
真实训练常把样本分成小批次：一批样本算一次更新；整个训练集遍历一遍叫一个 epo: Real training often divides samples into mini-batches: one batch contributes to an update; one pass through the training set is an epoch. Batch size and the number of epochs are training choices, not weights learned by the network.
知道了视差，还要换成米。距离、视差、镜头焦距 f、两台相机的间距 b（叫基线）之: Once you know the disparity, you still need to turn it into metres. Distance, disparity, the lens focal length f and the spacing b between the two cameras (called the baseline) are tied by a fixed relationship, and it follows from the same idea as the pinhole camera.
知道当初加的是哪份噪声 ε，把原图 x₀ 还原出来。: Knowing which noise ε was added, get the original picture x₀ back.
矩阵乘一个向量，就是把矩阵的列按向量的数加权相加。: A matrix times a vector is the matrix's columns added up, weighted by the vector's numbers.
票落进 (θ, ρ) 平面上的格子（分箱），这张格子图叫累加器，找线就变成了找峰: The votes fall into cells (bins) on the (θ, ρ) plane, a grid called the accumulator, so finding a line becomes finding a peak. With bins too fine, noise splits one line’s votes into many small peaks; too coarse, and two nearby lines merge into one peak.
票要落进格子里才能数：(θ, ρ) 的平面被切成一格格，这叫分箱。台上右边就是这: Votes can only be counted once they land in cells: the (θ, ρ) plane is cut into a grid, which is called binning. These cells are on the right of the bench; the darker the colour, the more votes, and the marked 1 and 2 are the two peaks with the most votes.
离中心越远，代表变化越快：条纹越密，亮点离中心越远；条纹转 90°，亮点也跟着转: Further from the centre means faster change: the denser the stripes, the further their dots sit from the centre. Turn the stripes by 90° and the dots turn by 90° too, always lined up perpendicular to the stripes. One set of stripes shows up as a pair of dots placed symmetrically about the centre.
离得远或眯起眼时，细小的线条分辨不出来，眼睛只看得到大块的明暗；凑近了，细节最抢: From far away, or when you squint, fine lines can't be made out and your eyes only see large areas of light and dark; up close, the detail stands out most. If an image takes its large light and dark areas from one picture and its detail from another, it looks different near and far.
离焦就是模糊，模糊压低了高频。所以频谱外圈越亮，照片越清楚。手机相机对焦时，一边: Out of focus means blurred, and blurring turns the high frequencies down. So the brighter the outer part of the spectrum, the sharper the photo. A phone camera computes a score like this while it moves the lens, and stops where the score is highest.
离频谱中心 R 以内的频率留下，以外压掉。两种掩膜形状，哪种不起波纹？盯住误差图: Frequencies within R of the spectrum's centre stay, and the rest are pressed down. Of the two mask shapes, which makes no ripples? Watch what appears on both sides of the edges in the error map.
空间里的模糊，等于频域里给每个频率乘一个增益，这叫卷积定理。一刀切的增益变回空间: A blur in space equals multiplying every frequency by a gain in the frequency domain: the convolution theorem. A sharp cut-off gain, turned back into space, is a kernel with negative side lobes, so rings appear beside edges (ringing); a gain that falls smoothly has hardly any. A Gaussian gain turned back into space is still a Gaussian, and that is the blur the expected output used.
窗口、距离换算、感兴趣区域，一个都不能少：这是一台最简单的双目避障系统。真实的扫: Window, distance conversion, region of interest: none can be left out. This is the simplest stereo obstacle-avoidance system; real robot vacuums also use a laser or structured light to fill in where there is no texture.
窗口小，噪声会骗过匹配；窗口大，细东西会被周围的背景淹没。: With a small window, noise fools the matching; with a large one, thin things drown in the surrounding background.
窗口每次挪两格，等于先在每个位置都算一遍，再隔一个留一个。: Moving the window two pixels at a time is the same as computing at every position and then keeping every other one.

算一格输出时，不只看输入里同一位置的那一格，而是取它和周围邻居的加权和，这就是<: When an output cell is computed not just from the input cell in the same place but as a weighted sum of it and its neighbours, that is filtering. If the weights are all positive and add up to 1, it is a kind of average and the image gets blurrier.
箭头的长度 √(gx² + gy²) 说明有多陡，方向是 atan2(gy, g: The arrow’s length √(gx² + gy²) says how steep it is, and its direction is atan2(gy, gx). On an edge the arrow is long and perpendicular to the edge: an edge is where the gradient is large.
箭头的长度怎么从两个分量算出来？想想勾股定理。: How do you get the arrow's length from its two components? Think of Pythagoras.
类别很多时，除了看第一名是否正确（Top-1），还可以看正确类别是否在前五名里（: With many classes, we can check whether the top prediction is correct (top-1) or whether the correct class is among the top five (top-5). If the answer ranks second, top-1 counts it wrong and top-5 counts it right; they answer different questions.
累加只要 4 次「平移再相加」就覆盖了 16 格：每次挪的格数翻倍。AP 是精确: The running total covers 16 cells with only 4 rounds of "shift and add", the shift doubling each time. AP is the area under the precision–recall curve: the earlier the right ones, the higher the score, and missed labels raise the denominator.

纸上的字也有边，而且很多：每一笔都是一条暗线，两侧各有一道边。扫描仪要找的却只是: The text on the paper has edges too, lots of them: every stroke is a dark line with an edge on each side. But the scanner only wants the paper's four sides.

胶片相机的底片上，明暗是反的：天空发黑，白衬衫发暗。冲印时再反一次，才变回正常。: On a film camera's negative, light and dark are reversed: the sky looks black and a white shirt looks dark. Printing reverses them again to bring the picture back to normal. Doctors reading X-rays also often switch between positive and negative.

自注意力里，每个图块都用自己去提问，所以各问各的。: In self-attention every patch asks with itself, so each asks its own question.

要在两张照片里认出同一个点，这个点得好认。平坦处往哪挪看起来都一样；直边上，沿着: To recognise the same point in two photos, the point has to be easy to find again. On flat ground a move in any direction looks the same; on a straight edge, a move along the edge looks the same; only at a corner does a move in any direction change what you see.
要想的问题有两个：屏上的像有多大，由什么决定？孔开大或开小，像会变成什么样？: Two things to think about: what decides how big the image on the screen is? And what happens to the image when the hole is made bigger or smaller?
要想的问题：「原图 − 模糊图」这张差图里，留下的是什么？为什么把它加回原图，图: Something to think about: what is left in the difference image "original − blurred"? Why does adding it back to the original make the image look sharper?

要想的问题：什么样的图案，能让变化一眼就看出来？一张图看不准，就多换几张，看结论: Something to think about: what kind of pattern makes the change obvious at a glance? If one image leaves you unsure, try a few more and check that they agree. Once you pass, this part is yours.
要想的问题：哪张测试图最容易读出它的规则？点一下格子（电脑上把鼠标停在上面），可: Something to think about: which test picture reveals its rule most easily? Tap a cell (or point at it on a computer) to read its original brightness. Once you pass, this part is yours too.

要找红色物体，单看 R 够吗？红苹果在阴影里可能比强光下的浅色苹果有更小的 R。: Is R alone enough to find red objects? A red apple in shade can have a smaller R than a pale apple in bright light. First experiment with two apples, then build a circuit to find red throughout a scene.

要是把每个输出像素都连到每个输入像素（全连接），参数会多得多，而且图一变大就跟着: If every output pixel were connected to every input pixel (fully connected), there would be far more parameters, and they would balloon as the image grows.
要自己调，先得知道「现在调得有多差」。这个分数叫<b>误差</b>：模型的输出离: To tune itself, it first needs to know how badly tuned it is right now. That score is the error: how far the model's outputs are from the samples' correct answers, squared and averaged. The smaller the error, the better.
要让机器自己调参数，先得有一个分数说明「现在调得有多差」。这个分数叫<b>损失<: Before a machine can tune its own parameters, it needs a score for “how bad is it now”. That score is the loss (the error): how far the model’s output is from the right answer, commonly the average of the squared differences.
规律变成 输出 = w × 输入 + b。两个旋钮都要机器自己找。: The rule becomes output = w × input + b. The machine has to find both knobs itself.
视差按像素计，差一个像素，深度就差一截：|Δz| ≈ z²/(f·b)·|Δd|: Disparity is counted in pixels, and one pixel off throws the depth off noticeably: |Δz| ≈ z²/(f·b)·|Δd|, so something twice as far has four times the error.

训练分类器还需要衡量预测有多错。常用的交叉熵关注正确类别的概率：给正确类别的概率: Training a classifier also needs a measure of how wrong a prediction is. Cross-entropy, a common choice, looks at the probability assigned to the correct class: the lower that probability, the larger the loss. The game trainer uses squared error, a different loss.
训练只看得见公开的测试，隐藏测试正好用来检查学到的东西对新图是否也成立。清空电路: Training only sees the visible tests, so the hidden tests check whether what it learned also holds for new pictures. Clearing the circuit starts the weights and the loss curve afresh.
训练好以后，生成就是：抽一个随机的 z，交给解码器。每抽一次就是一张没见过的新图: Once trained, generating is just: draw a random z and hand it to the decoder. Each draw is a new picture never seen before; μ and σ decide roughly where the new pictures fall.
训练好的卷积网络第一层里，常能看到这种对颜色对比敏感的滤波器：红对绿、蓝对黄，和: In the first layer of a trained convolutional network you often find such filters tuned to colour contrast: red against green and blue against yellow, the same two colour oppositions as in the human retina.
训练就是下山：把误差（差的平方的平均）看成地形，w 是你站的位置。每一步沿坡往下: Training is walking downhill: think of the error (the mean of the squared differences) as a landscape, with w as where you stand. Each step moves down the slope by "learning rate × slope". Too small a learning rate takes many steps; too large overshoots the bottom and flies further away each time. A network has millions of knobs, and the principle is exactly the same.
训练就是把参数拧一点，看结果变好还是变坏，再往好的方向调；能算出该往哪拧，叫求导: Training means nudging the parameters a little, seeing whether the result gets better or worse, and adjusting in the better direction; working out which way to nudge is called differentiating. But there is a random sampling step between μ, σ and the image that gets drawn. Can this kind of adjustment still work?
训练时先用当前参数算出结果，和答案比较得到损失，再根据每个参数对损失的影响更新参: Training first computes an output with the current parameters and compares it with the answer to obtain a loss. It then updates each parameter according to its effect on that loss. Here small changes estimate that effect; real neural networks usually use backpropagation to pass the effect of the loss backwards through the layers.
训练误差一直降，新样本上的误差却先降后升：后半段模型在背训练样本里的噪声，这叫<: The training error keeps falling, but the error on new samples falls and then rises: in the second half the model is memorising the noise in its training samples. This is overfitting. That is why part of the data is kept back for checking only: the validation set.
训练误差一直降，新样本（验证集）的误差却先降后升：后半段模型在背噪声，这叫过拟合: The training error keeps falling, but the error on new samples (the validation set) falls and then rises: in the second half the model is memorising noise. This is called overfitting. One fix is early stopping: stop where the validation error is lowest. The other is regularisation: put a cost on large weights (L2), so the model will not bend the curve sharply just to hit a few points. Too small a λ cannot hold off overfitting; too large and the model cannot learn even the true rule (underfitting). When training real networks, part of the data is kept back for validation only, precisely so you can see this falls-then-rises line.
训练越久，模型在训练样本上越准。可我们要的是它在没见过的新样本上也准。一个灵活的: The longer you train, the more accurate the model gets on the training samples. But what we want is for it to be accurate on new samples it has never seen as well. A flexible model trained too long memorises the noise in the samples too.

To measure far things precisely you widen the baseline or use a longer lens, but then the disparity of near things grows past the search range.
距离近于 1.2 米、又在地面以上的像素输出 1，其余 0。: Output 1 for pixels closer than 1.2 m that are above the floor, otherwise 0.
路面上有两条亮的车道线和几个亮点。在 Hough 累加器里只标出这两条线的格子：: The road has two bright lane lines and a few bright specks. Mark only the cells of these two lines in the Hough accumulator: the peaks after multiplying the votes by 1/8.
车和路都看: Looking at the car and the road
轮数来自概率：内点比例为 p、每轮抽 n 个点，要成功率达到 P，需要 k ≥: The number of rounds comes from probability: with an inlier ratio p and n points drawn per round, reaching a success rate P needs k ≥ log(1 − P) / log(1 − pⁿ) rounds. The number of rounds is set by the inlier ratio and δ by the noise; neither can stand in for the other.
较小的那个 = 两个相加，再减去较大的那个。三个数里第二小的，是哪两个较小值里较: The smaller of two = their sum minus the larger. Of three numbers, which is the second smallest: the larger of which two smaller ones?
输入是一块表面每一点的朝向（法线的 x、y、z 三个分量）和它的反射率。灯从右上: The inputs are which way each point of a surface faces (the x, y and z of its normal) and its reflectance. The lamp shines from the upper right, from direction (0.48, −0.36, 0.8) (x to the right, y down, z towards the camera). Draw what the camera sees: brightness = reflectance × cos θ, where θ is the angle between the normal and the lamp direction.
输入是一张彩色照片，可以从 R、G、B 出口分别取出三个通道。只描出红与绿交界处: The input is a colour photo; its R, G and B outputs provide the three channels. Trace only the edges where red meets green; output 0 where things only get brighter or darker, or where only blue changes.
输入是一张彩色街景，可以从 R、G、B 出口分别读取通道。只标出红灯：又亮又红的: The input is a colour street scene; its R, G and B outputs provide the channels. Mark only the red lights: places both bright and red. Red cars in the shade, white street lamps and green lights do not count.
输入是一张彩色风景，从 R、G、B 出口可以分别读取三个通道。只描出蓝与黄交界处: The input is a colour landscape; its R, G and B outputs provide the separate channels. Trace only the edges where blue meets yellow; output 0 where things only get brighter or darker.
输入是一条 32 个点的波形，由几道波和一个平均亮度叠成。读出其中频率 k =: The input is a waveform of 32 points, made of a few waves plus an average brightness. Read off the amplitude A of the wave with frequency k = 3, and output that one number. One of the waveforms has no k = 3 at all.
输入是一条曲线，探针是一道你选频率的波。两条曲线逐点相乘，台上画出乘积和它的平均: The input is a curve and the probe is a wave whose frequency you choose. The two are multiplied point by point, and the bench draws the product and its average. First find the probe whose average is not 0, then read one wave's amplitude out of a mixed curve.
输入是一道频率 3 的波，可以左右错开，探针也是频率 3。先看错开以后探针还量不: The input is a wave of frequency 3 that can be shifted sideways, and the probe is frequency 3 too. First see whether the probe still measures it once shifted, then find a way of reading that does not mind the shift.
输入是一道频率 3、振幅 0.30 的波，探针也是频率 3。转动输入错开的角度，: The input is a wave of frequency 3 and amplitude 0.30, and the probe is frequency 3 too. Turn how far the input is shifted, watch how the probe's reading (average × 2) changes, and make it read 0.
输入是一道频率不知道的波。转动探针的频率，看下面两条曲线逐点相乘的结果和它的平均: The input is a wave of unknown frequency. Turn the probe's frequency and watch the two curves multiplied point by point below, and the product's average.
输入是几道波混在一起，其中频率 5 那道的振幅是 0.30。用探针读出它：读数是: The input is several waves mixed together; the one at frequency 5 has amplitude 0.30. Read it with the probe: the reading is the product's average times a number.
输入是每一点的单位法线和反射率。灯的方向为 (0.48, −0.36, 0.8): The inputs are each point’s unit normal and reflectance. The lamp direction is (0.48, −0.36, 0.8), with x right, y down and z toward the camera. Draw what the camera sees.
输入的斑点带着噪声，期望是干净的斑点。: The blobs come in noisy, and the expected output is the clean blob.
输出 (x_t − √(1 − ᾱ)·ε) / √ᾱ：由 x_t 和噪声 ε 还: Outputs (x_t − √(1 − ᾱ)·ε) / √ᾱ: x₀ recovered from x_t and the noise ε.
输出 = A 的低频 + B 的高频，两处都用半径 3 的高斯掩膜。近看是 B，: Output = the low frequencies of A + the high frequencies of B, both with a Gaussian mask of radius 3. Up close you see B; from afar, A.
输出 a × b：第 i 个数 = a 的第 i+1 个 × b 的第 i+2: Output a × b: number i = a's number i+1 × b's number i+2 − a's number i+2 × b's number i+1, with the count going round to the first again past the end.
输出 √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε：把 x₀ 一步加噪到第 t 步。: Outputs √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε: x₀ noised straight to step t.
输出一个数：是 X 就大于 0.6，是 O 就小于 0.4。字母会挪位置、变深浅: Output one number: above 0.6 for an X, below 0.4 for an O. The letters move around, vary in strength and carry noise.
输出不再只看自己，而是看邻居的加权和。这就是滤波。: The output no longer looks only at its own pixel, but at a weighted sum of its neighbours. This is filtering.
输出两个三维向量的叉积 a × b。: Outputs the cross product a × b of two 3-vectors.
输出两个框掩膜的交并比：重叠面积除以合起来的面积。: Outputs the intersection over union of two box masks: the overlap divided by the area they cover together.
输出是一张视差图：每格填 0 到 3，表示那里的东西在两张图之间错开了几格，少数: The output is a disparity map: each pixel holds 0 to 3, the number of pixels by which the thing there is offset between the two images. A few wrong pixels are fine. The question is: how can you tell that a pixel in the right image is the same spot as this pixel in the left image?
输出的每一格只由输入里同一位置的那一格算出来，各算各的，这叫<b>逐像素运算</: When each output cell is worked out only from the input cell in the same position, each on its own, it is a per-pixel operation. Multiplying by a factor brightens or darkens the whole image in proportion, adding a constant raises or lowers every cell together, and two images can be added, subtracted or multiplied cell by cell.
边上缺一点的 9×9: 9×9 missing a pixel on one edge
边缘图里有一条直线和一堆杂点。画出这条直线（离线不到 0.7 的格子为 1）。: An edge map holds one straight line and a heap of specks. Draw the line (cells closer than 0.7 are 1).
边缘检测给的是一堆零散的点。<b>Hough 变换</b>让每个点为所有穿过它的: Edge detection gives a scatter of points. The Hough transform has each point vote for every line through it: a line is recorded by two numbers, its direction θ and its distance ρ from the centre, with ρ = x·cos θ + y·sin θ. A line that is really there collects many votes.
边越陡，需要的高频越多。方波只用到奇数频率，振幅按 1、1/3、1/5、1/7: The steeper an edge, the more high frequencies it needs. A square wave uses only odd frequencies, with amplitudes falling as 1, 1/3, 1/5, 1/7; leave out the high ones and small ripples appear beside the steep edges.
过关常会解锁新元件，通过窗口里会列出来。弄清楚的黑箱会变成你的<part-ref: Passing a level often unlocks a new part, listed in the passed window. A black box you have figured out becomes your <part-ref to="shift"></part-ref>, and what you build by hand often becomes a ready-made part too, used directly from then on without your having to think about what is inside.
过关时，通过窗口会用几句话点明刚才发生了什么。它提到的概念，大多在这本百科里有词: When you pass, the passed window sums up in a few lines what just happened. Most of the ideas it names have an entry in this encyclopedia.
还是 32×32 缩成 8×8，但计算量不能超过 18。在小图上做事比在大图上便: Again shrink 32×32 to 8×8, but the cost must not exceed 18. Working on a small picture is cheaper than on a big one: on a picture a quarter of the size, the same part costs a quarter as much.
还是放大一倍，这次要平滑：原来的像素原样留下，空出来的格子取左右（或上下）两个原: Twice the size again, this time smoothly: the original pixels stay as they are, an empty cell takes the average of the two original pixels on either side (or above and below), and a corner cell the average of four.
还是混合图像：A 的低频 + B 的高频，两处都用半径 3 的高斯掩膜。这次频域: A hybrid image again: the low frequencies of A + the high frequencies of B, both with a Gaussian mask of radius 3. This time you may use only one frequency-domain part (Frequency low-pass or Multiply in frequency) in all.
还是补全对角，这次图案是 8×8 的，一张图四个。计算量不能超过 10。: Mending across the diagonal again, this time with 8×8 patterns, four to a picture. The cost must not exceed 10.
还有一种台上只放一个黑箱：挑测试图喂进去，比较进去和出来的样子，再回答它做了什么: One kind of bench holds just a black box: pick test pictures to feed in, compare what goes in with what comes out, then say what it did. Experimenting before concluding is the most reliable way to get to know an unfamiliar tool.
还有一种正则化叫 Dropout：训练时随机暂时关掉一些神经元，让网络不要过度依: Another kind of regularisation is dropout: during training, randomly switch off some neurons temporarily so the network does not rely too heavily on a fixed path. Validation and testing do not randomly switch them off. This bench demonstrates early stopping and L2, not dropout.
这一关你要为三种外点比例各选一个 k，再选一个共用的 δ，让成功率都达到 99%: In this level you choose a k for each of the three outlier ratios, plus one shared δ, so that every success rate reaches 99%. The questions are: as outliers increase, how should the number of rounds change? And what should decide δ?
这一关你要做的：IoU 够大就算找对了，输出 1。: Your task in this level: if the IoU is large enough the detection counts as right; output 1.
这一关你要做的：X 输出大于 0.6，O 小于 0.4。要想的问题：一个神经元是: Your task in this level: above 0.6 for X, below 0.4 for O. Something to think about: one neuron is one dividing line; can these points be split by a straight line?
这一关你要做的：c = 0 时在左边那一带画斑点，c = 1 时在右边。: Your task in this level: when c = 0, draw the blob in the region on the left; when c = 1, on the right.
这一关你要做的：一张响应图上有几个鼓包，只在峰顶输出 1。: Your task in this level: a response map has a few bumps; output 1 only at their tops.
这一关你要做的：三张候选里找出和要找的照片是同一张的那一张。: Your task in this level: among three candidates, find the one that is the same photo as the one you are looking for.
这一关你要做的：不管是变亮还是变暗，每条竖边都输出它的强度。先看清第一组的输入和: Your task: for every vertical edge, whether it goes brighter or darker, output its strength. Look carefully at the input and expected output of Set 1 first.
这一关你要做的：两个框画成掩膜，输出它们的交并比，公式在说明里。: Your task in this level: two boxes drawn as masks; output their intersection over union, with the formula in the brief.
这一关你要做的：两个输入，一张彩色照片和一张光照图（每一点照到多少光，1 是满光: Your task: use a colour photo and a lighting map (how much light reaches each point; 1 is full light). The photo’s Image output gives the full colour image; its R, G and B outputs give individual channels. Output the surface’s own colour without shadows or shading.
这一关你要做的：两个输出，热图是灰块遮挡图（3×3）；热图落在车上的比例不到一半: Your task in this level: two outputs; the heat map is the grey 3×3 occlusion map, and the number is 1 if less than half of it lies on the car, 0 otherwise.
这一关你要做的：两张图各有一个图案被擦掉几格，孪生图案在各自图里的别处。两个输出: Your task in this level: each of two pictures has a pattern with a few pixels erased, and its twin is elsewhere in the same picture. The two outputs are the two pictures mended.
这一关你要做的：两张图逐格比较，每格输出较大的那个。要想的问题：a 比 b 大多: Your task in this level: compare two pictures cell by cell and output the larger value in each. Something to think about: how much bigger is a than b? When is that difference positive?
这一关你要做的：两张照片是同一张就输出 1，否则输出 0。: Your task in this level: output 1 if the two photos are the same photo, otherwise 0.
这一关你要做的：两类各有一张排名表，输出两类 AP 的平均。: Your task in this level: each of two classes has its own ranking; output the average of their APs.
这一关你要做的：主灯不变，再加一盏从左边低处照来的补光，强度是主灯的一半。要想的: Your task in this level: keep the key light and add a fill light low on the left at half its strength. Something to think about: on the side facing away from the fill light, how much brightness does the fill light give?
这一关你要做的：从 32×32 缩成 4×4，不出莫尔纹，计算量不超过 19。: Your task in this level: shrink 32×32 to 4×4 with no moiré and a cost of no more than 19.
这一关你要做的：从起始分界出发走三步，再把每个像素分成两类。: Your task in this level: take three steps from the starting boundary, then split every pixel into two classes.
这一关你要做的：修好一张满是噪点的旧照片，再标出字的笔画。: Your task in this level: mend an old photo full of grain, then mark the strokes of the letter.
这一关你要做的：做出 3×3 平均，计算量不超过 6。最直接的搭法会超标，你得找: Your task in this level: make a 3×3 average with a cost of no more than 6. The most direct circuit goes over the limit, so you need to find a cheaper method.
这一关你要做的：做出一层步幅为 2 的卷积，权重由训练找出来。测试图有两种大小。: Your task in this level: make a convolution layer with stride 2, with its weights found by training. The test pictures come in two sizes. Something to think about: when the picture gets bigger, does this layer have more numbers to learn?
这一关你要做的：决定训练到哪一步该停，再试另一种管住模型的办法。要想的问题：训练: Your task: decide at which step training should stop, then try another way of keeping the model in check. Something to think about: as the training error keeps shrinking, does the model keep getting better on new samples too?
这一关你要做的：判断右图的点 q 能不能和左图的点 p 对应。: Your task in this level: decide whether the right point q can correspond to the left point p.
这一关你要做的：加两次噪，输出加完两次的图。: Your task in this level: add noise twice and output the picture after both.
这一关你要做的：去掉照片里的噪点，输出要和期望一样干净、柔和。四组测试是方块、圆: In this level: remove the noise from the photos. The output must be as clean and soft as expected. The four test sets are a square, a disc, a letter and horizontal bars; the error map shows you where you are off.
这一关你要做的：只在每个 X 的正中间输出 1。: Your task in this level: output 1 only at the centre of each X.
这一关你要做的：只在真正的台阶处输出 1，其余输出 0。每组测试的台阶位置不同，: Your task in this level: output 1 only at the real step and 0 everywhere else. Each test has its step in a different place, always dark on the left and bright on the right.
这一关你要做的：只描出红和绿的交界，单纯变亮变暗、或只有蓝色在变的地方都要是 0: Your task: trace only the boundary between red and green. Places that just get brighter or darker, or where only blue changes, must be 0. Something to think about: what can each of the three images see, and what can it not?
这一关你要做的：只描出蓝与黄的交界，只是变亮变暗的地方要是 0。要想的问题：黄色: Your task: trace only the border between blue and yellow; places that just get brighter or darker must be 0. Something to think about: what do yellow and blue each look like in the three images?
这一关你要做的：只标出红灯。要想的问题：「亮」和「红」，各要看哪几个通道？: Your task in this level: mark only the red lights. Something to think about: which channels does "bright" need, and which does "red"?
这一关你要做的：只标出闯入者的外圈，也就是闯入者身上、上下左右至少挨着一格地面的: Your task in this level: mark only the intruder's outer ring, that is, the intruder cells that touch at least one floor cell above, below, left or right. Something to think about: what makes a cell on the ring different from one further in?
这一关你要做的：只用 F 算出这一点，写成 (x, y, 1)。: Your task in this level: work this point out from F alone, written as (x, y, 1).
这一关你要做的：只用这些乘和加，凑出「1 减去输入」。: Your task in this level: using only these multiplications and additions, make "1 minus the input".
这一关你要做的：同一组修正作用到一排锚框上，输出一排框。: Your task in this level: apply the same corrections to a row of anchors and output a row of boxes.
这一关你要做的：同样的三张照片，输出漆色本身，也就是每一点的反射率，和表面朝哪边: Your task in this level: from the same three photos, output the paint itself, the reflectance at every point, whichever way the surface faces.
这一关你要做的：四组测试里，闯入者的位置各不相同。输出要把它圈出来，一格不多，一: Your task in this level: the intruder is in a different place in each of the four tests. Your output must mark it out exactly, not one cell more or less.
这一关你要做的：图案变成了 8×8 的，一张图四个，还是补全对角；计算量有上限。: Your task in this level: the patterns are now 8×8, four to a picture, and it is mending across the diagonal again; the cost has a limit.
这一关你要做的：在台上转动探针的频率，先找出让乘积的平均不为 0 的那一个，再读: Your task in this level: turn the probe's frequency on the bench, first to find the one whose product does not average to 0, then to read one wave's amplitude out of a mixed curve. Something to think about: when does the product lean to one side overall?
这一关你要做的：在操作台上转动旋钮，让你的波和目标重合。每一步只开放一个旋钮。要: Your task in this level: turn the knobs on the bench until your wave lies on the target. Each step opens one knob. Something to think about: what does each knob change about the wave?
这一关你要做的：在每个像素输出梯度箭头有多长。测试里有方块、圆盘、字母 X 和一: Your task in this level: at every pixel, output how long the gradient arrow is. The tests have a square, a disc, a letter X and a corner, with edges facing every way.
这一关你要做的：完成三个实验，每个只有一个可调的量。每次都比一比：从点上看起来的: In this level: complete the three experiments, each with just one thing to adjust. Each time, compare what the samples suggest with the real wave, and see where they differ.
这一关你要做的：实物上的凹坑比标准件暗，在凹坑处输出 1，其余输出 0。: Your task in this level: dents on the part are darker than on the reference. Output 1 on the dents and 0 everywhere else.
这一关你要做的：小 X 标一个点，大 X 标一个 2×2 的小块。: Your task in this level: mark a small X with a point and a large X with a 2×2 block.
这一关你要做的：手里只有看 3×3 的元件，做出看 7×7 的判断。要想的问题：: Your task: using only parts that look at 3×3, make a judgement about 7×7. Something to think about: where can "7×7" come from?
这一关你要做的：手里没有高斯，只有 3×3 平均，却要做出和目标几乎一样的结果。: Your task in this level: you have no Gaussian, only the 3×3 average, yet you must produce almost exactly the target result. In terrain view, the expected output for a bright dot is a smooth little hill.
这一关你要做的：找出哪个候选窗口和关键点的窗口是同一处，输出它的编号。: Your task in this level: find which candidate window shows the same place as the keypoint window, and output its number.
这一关你要做的：把 32×32 的图缩成 16×16，看起来要和原图一样，只是小: In this level: shrink a 32×32 image to 16×16 so that it looks like the original, just one size smaller.
这一关你要做的：把 8×8 的图放大成 16×16，每个像素变成一样的 2×2: Your task in this level: enlarge an 8×8 picture to 16×16, every pixel becoming a 2×2 block of the same value.
这一关你要做的：把你的核拧成和它一样，让三组测试全部通过。: Your task in this level: dial your kernel in until it matches, so that all three tests pass.
这一关你要做的：把带颗粒的扫描件变成期望里那样干净、柔和的图。: Your task in this level: turn the grainy scan into a clean, soft image like the expected one.
这一关你要做的：把整张图往右挪两格、往下挪两格。: Your task in this level: move the whole picture two pixels right and two pixels down.
这一关你要做的：把每一格的梯度幅值分到上下左右四个方向，输出四个方向各自的平均。: Your task in this level: share each cell's gradient magnitude out to the four directions up, down, left and right, and output the average for each.
这一关你要做的：把池化后的值放回它原来的那一格，块里其余格子是 0。池化前的图也: Your task in this level: put each pooled value back in the cell it came from, with the rest of the block 0. The picture before pooling is given too.
这一关你要做的：把清楚的封面贴到照片里书的位置上。: Your task in this level: paste the crisp cover over the book in the photo.
这一关你要做的：把至少 12 个卷积层串成一条路，训练它学会测试里那种轻微的模糊: Your task: chain at least 12 conv layers into one path and train it to learn the light blur in the tests. Every conv layer starts from very small random numbers.
这一关你要做的：把视差图换成距离图，公式在说明里。: Your task in this level: turn the disparity map into a distance map; the formula is in the brief.
这一关你要做的：把输入错开，看探针还量不量得准；再找出一种不管错开多少都读得准的: Your task in this level: shift the input and see whether the probe still measures it, then find a way of reading that is right however far the wave is shifted.
这一关你要做的：按公式搭出锐化。用地形画法看期望，每道台阶的边上都多出了一道凸起: Your task in this level: build the sharpening from the formula. In terrain view, the expected output has an extra ridge and an extra dip beside every step.
这一关你要做的：按说明搭出神经元，训练它分开 X 和 O。要想的问题：只靠这三个: Your task in this level: build the neuron as the brief describes and train it to separate X from O. Something to think about: with only these three learnable numbers, which points can it separate, and which can it not?
这一关你要做的：按说明里的公式算出 AP。: Your task in this level: work out AP by the formula in the brief.
这一关你要做的：按说明里的公式算出 a × b。: Your task in this level: work out a × b by the formula in the brief.
这一关你要做的：按说明里的公式，一步算出加到第 t 步的图。: Your task in this level: by the formula in the brief, work out in one step the picture after noise is added up to step t.
这一关你要做的：按说明里的公式，由锚框和四个修正算出框。: Your task in this level: by the formula in the brief, work out the box from the anchor and the four corrections.
这一关你要做的：按说明里的规则去掉网纹。每张照片的网纹方向和疏密都不一样。: Your task in this level: remove the screen by the rule in the brief. Each photo's screen has a different direction and spacing.
这一关你要做的：按说明里的规则，算出挪一次以后的新分界。: Your task in this level: by the rule in the brief, work out the new boundary after one move.
这一关你要做的：按说明里的规则，给每张照片算一个清晰度分。「频率半径」是一张和频: Your task in this level: score each photo for sharpness by the rule in the brief. "Frequency radius" is a picture the size of the spectrum, each cell holding its distance from the centre. Something to think about: where does the spectrum of a blurred photo get darker?
这一关你要做的：按说明里的规则，输出每个关键点配上的候选编号，不可信的输出 0。: Your task in this level: following the rule in the brief, output the number of the candidate each keypoint matches, and 0 when the match cannot be trusted.
这一关你要做的：挡板换成灰的（0.5），输出每个位置挡住 3×3 以后分数掉多少: Your task in this level: the patch becomes grey (0.5); output how far the score drops with the 3×3 at each place covered. Something to think about: what happens to the score when a cell darker than grey is covered?
这一关你要做的：换成 5×5 的灰色挡板，输出每个位置分数掉多少。: Your task in this level: use a 5×5 grey patch, and output how far the score drops at each place.
这一关你要做的：搭出混合图像，两处都用半径 3 的高斯掩膜。三组测试里，A 是圆: In this level: build the hybrid image, using a Gaussian mask of radius 3 in both places. In the three test sets, A is a large shape such as a disc or a square, and B is fine detail such as a letter or a checkerboard.
这一关你要做的：放大得平滑一些，规则在说明里。: Your task in this level: enlarge more smoothly; the rule is in the brief.
这一关你要做的：标出地面以上、近到要停下的像素。: Your task in this level: mark the pixels above the floor that are close enough to stop for.
这一关你要做的：标出坡度超过 0.3 的地方，漆色深浅不能误报。: Your task in this level: mark where the slope is above 0.3; uneven paint must not raise an alarm.
这一关你要做的：标出细胞（1）和背景（0）。: Your task in this level: mark the cells (1) and the background (0).
这一关你要做的：标出细胞，细胞之间的缝要留着。: Your task in this level: mark the cells, keeping the gaps between them.
这一关你要做的：标出表面朝右倾斜的地方。要想的问题：一张照片里的暗，可能是什么造: Your task in this level: mark where the surface leans to the right. Something to think about: what could make a spot dark in one photo? What relation between two photos has nothing to do with the paint?
这一关你要做的：标出要停下的区域。: Your task in this level: mark the region to stop for.
这一关你要做的：每一格换成它自己和上下两个邻居的平均。: Your task in this level: replace each cell with the average of itself and its neighbours above and below.
这一关你要做的：每一格换成它自己和左右两个邻居的平均。看看下面的期望：方块左右两: Your task in this level: replace each cell with the average of itself and its left and right neighbours. Look at the expected output below: the square's left and right edges gain a band of grey, but its top and bottom edges do not change.
这一关你要做的：每一格输出「右边邻居 − 自己」。结果可以是负数，看灰度不直观，: Your task in this level: for every cell, output "right neighbour − self". The result can be negative, which is hard to read in greyscale; terrain view shows the rises and falls more clearly.
这一关你要做的：每个 X 恰好标一处。: Your task in this level: mark each X exactly once.
这一关你要做的：每个图块都换成全图最亮的那个图块，也就是各格加起来最大的那一块。: Your task in this level: replace every patch with the brightest patch in the picture, the one whose cells add up to the most.
这一关你要做的：每个角只输出一个点。: Your task in this level: output a single point per corner.
这一关你要做的：每只狗只输出一个点。: Your task in this level: output a single point for each dog.
这一关你要做的：每张切片都标出细胞，缝要留着。: Your task in this level: mark the cells on every slide, keeping the gaps.
这一关你要做的：每张彩色照片里都有白纸，它在 R、G、B 通道中都是最亮的。从照: Each colour photo contains white paper, brightest in each R, G and B channel. Take the channels from the photo’s R, G and B outputs, adjust them, and connect them to the matching output ports to make the paper white.
这一关你要做的：每条线给出它上面的两个点，输出两条线的交点。: Your task in this level: each line is given by two points on it; output where the two lines meet.
这一关你要做的：每组测试是一个样本，让机器自己找出那个数。要想的问题：每一步该迈: Your task in this level: each test is one sample; let the machine find the number itself. Something to think about: how big should each step be? What happens if the steps are too small, or too big?
这一关你要做的：每组测试给出焦距 f 和基线 b，把视差图换成距离图。: Your task in this level: each test gives the focal length f and the baseline b; turn the disparity map into a distance map.
这一关你要做的：池化一张亮点图再放大回来，每个亮点要回到原处。: Your task in this level: pool a picture of bright dots and enlarge it back, with every dot returning to its place.
这一关你要做的：灯还是只有 80%，凹坑和划痕都标 1，其余标 0。合格的零件，: Your task in this level: the lamp is still at 80%. Mark both dents and scratches with 1 and everything else with 0. For a good part the output should be all 0.
这一关你要做的：用「频率半径」做出一张增益图，让输出和期望一样柔和，没有波纹。: Your task in this level: make a gain picture from "Frequency radius" so the output is as soft as the expected one, with no ripples.
这一关你要做的：用平移、常数和四则运算，搭出同样的处理。要想的问题：一个亮点经过: Your task in this level: build the same processing out of shifts, constants, multiplications and additions. Something to think about: what does a single bright dot turn into?
这一关你要做的：用输入的 μ、σ 和噪声 ε 抽一个 z，画出它的斑点。: Your task in this level: draw a z from the μ, σ and noise ε in the input, and draw its blob.
这一关你要做的：用这些点对把封面贴回照片。: Your task in this level: paste the cover back onto the photo using these pairs.
这一关你要做的：画出从斑点 a 往斑点 b 走了 t 的那个斑点。: Your task in this level: draw the blob that is t of the way from blob a to blob b.
这一关你要做的：知道当初加的是哪份噪声，把原图还原出来。: Your task in this level: knowing which noise was added, get the original picture back.
这一关你要做的：算出左图一个点在右图对应的那条线 F·p，F 按列给出。: Your task in this level: work out the line F·p in the right image that corresponds to a point in the left image; F is given column by column.
这一关你要做的：算出相机读到的 R、G、B 三个数，分别接到输出的 R、G、B: Calculate the R, G and B readings and connect them to the matching output ports to see the resulting colour pixel. Unconnected colour channels are zero; connect the Image port to output a whole image directly.
这一关你要做的：缩小四倍，看起来要和原图一样，只是小了。要想的问题：缩得更狠，能: Your task in this level: shrink four times so it looks like the original, only smaller. Something to think about: shrinking harder, are the frequencies that can survive higher or lower?
这一关你要做的：让 0.25 变成 0、0.75 变成 1，中间的亮度按比例拉开: Your task in this level: turn 0.25 into 0 and 0.75 into 1, stretching the brightnesses in between in proportion. Something to think about: does it matter whether you multiply or add first?
这一关你要做的：让屏上的像满足台边列出的几项要求。每一项达到与否，台上都会实时标: Your task in this level: make the image on the screen meet the requirements listed beside the bench. The bench shows live whether each one is met.
这一关你要做的：让机器自己找到 w 和 b。要想的问题：两个旋钮时，「往下坡走」: Your task in this level: let the machine find w and b itself. Something to think about: with two knobs, which direction does "walking downhill" mean?
这一关你要做的：训练一个可学习核，学会这台相机的抖。: Your task in this level: train a learnable kernel to learn this camera's shake.
这一关你要做的：读出输入里 k = 3 那道波的振幅，也就是它最亮处比它自己的平: In this level: read off the amplitude of the k = 3 wave in the input, that is, how far its brightest point rises above its own average. Get all five test waveforms right.
这一关你要做的：调各个频率的振幅，先叠出由两道波组成的目标，再叠出一条接近方波的: Your task in this level: set the amplitude of each frequency, first to stack up a target made of two waves, then a curve close to a square wave. Something to think about: can smooth waves make a steep edge?
这一关你要做的：货架上的箱子贴着 X 或 O 的记号，只在 X 的正中间输出 1: Your task in this level: the boxes on the shelf carry X or O marks; output 1 only at the centre of each X.
这一关你要做的：路面上有两条车道线和几个亮点，在累加器里只标出这两条线。: Your task in this level: the road has two lane lines and a few bright specks; mark only these two lines in the accumulator.
这一关你要做的：输入是同一个物体在不同灯光下的照片，有的整体变亮，有的变暗。输出: Your task in this level: the inputs are photos of the same object under different lighting, some brighter overall, some dimmer. Output its edges; all four tests expect exactly the same answer.
这一关你要做的：输入的斑点带着噪声，输出干净的斑点。: Your task in this level: the blobs come in noisy; output clean blobs.
这一关你要做的：输出一个数，X 大于 0.6，O 小于 0.4。要想的问题：X: Your task: output one number, above 0.6 for X and below 0.4 for O. Something to think about: what really is the difference between X and O, and which information should be kept?
这一关你要做的：输出三个概率，正确那一类大于 0.55，另两类小于 0.45。要: Your task in this level: output three probabilities, above 0.55 for the right class and below 0.45 for the other two. Something to think about: which strokes tell the three kinds apart? How many kinds of stroke must the network see?
这一关你要做的：输出地面以上每个像素的距离。: Your task in this level: output the distance of every pixel above the floor.
这一关你要做的：输出灰块遮挡图（3×3）有多大比例落在车上。: Your task in this level: output what fraction of the grey 3×3 occlusion map lies on the car.
这一关你要做的：输出纸张的边，和期望一样。要想的问题：字的笔画和纸边，大小差了多: Your task in this level: output the paper's edges, matching the expected image. Something to think about: how different in size are a stroke of text and a paper edge?
这一关你要做的：输出纸的边。图边不能被当成纸边。: Your task in this level: output the paper's edges. The image border must not count as one.
这一关你要做的：边缘图里有一条直线和一堆杂点，把这条线画出来。: Your task in this level: an edge map holds one straight line and a heap of specks; draw the line.
这一关你要做的：还是 32×32 缩成 8×8，计算量不超过 18。要想的问题：: Your task in this level: again shrink 32×32 to 8×8, with a cost of no more than 18. Something to think about: why is a big blur expensive?
这一关你要做的：还是只标出凹坑。要想的问题：灯暗了 20%，亮的地方和暗的地方，: Your task in this level: again, mark only the dents. Something to think about: with the lamp 20% dimmer, how much darker does a bright area get, and how much a dark one?
这一关你要调分箱的大小，让三组图里票最多的两个峰正好是那两条线。动手前想想：格子: In this level you tune the bin size so that, in all three sets, the two peaks with the most votes are exactly the two lines. Before you start, think: how does the cell size affect the way votes gather together?
这一关先熟悉工作台：「输入」是相机给的图，「输出」是你交出去的图，中间用线连起元: This level gets you used to the workbench: "Input" is the image from the camera, "Output" is the image you hand in, and the parts you wire up in between form a circuit. Each test compares your output with the expected one, cell by cell.
这一关分两个任务。先输出每一格给分数加了多少；再输出：把一格周围 3×3 涂黑，: This level has two tasks. First output how much each cell adds to the score; then output how far the score drops when the 3×3 round a cell is blacked out. Something to think about: blacking out a block loses which cells' contributions?
这一关分两个任务，都没有现成的设置可选，要你自己拼出来。先用平移和四则运算，拼出: This level has two tasks, and neither has a ready-made setting to pick: you build both yourself. First, from Shift and Arithmetic, build a shift right by one pixel whose leftmost column is copied from the original; once built, it becomes an option in the Shift part's "Border" setting.
这一关只给这一个元件，你要定的是窗口。动手前想一想：窗口变大，比较时多得到了什么: This level gives you only this one part; what you decide is the window. Before you start, think: when the window grows, what does the comparison gain, and what does it lose?
这一关多了一个输入：每一格所在图块的编号，按阅读顺序从 0 数到 15。: This level has an extra input: the number of the patch each cell is in, counting 0 to 15 in reading order.
这一关多了一项限制：<b>计算量</b>，数的是每算出一个输出格子要做几次乘法和: This level adds a limit: the cost, which counts how many multiplications and additions it takes to compute one output cell. A phone photo has over ten million pixels and video runs at dozens of frames a second, so saving one operation per cell adds up to a lot.
这一关多给一张车的掩膜：车身和车轮上是 1，别处是 0。你要做的：输出分数里有多: This level adds a mask of the car: 1 on the body and wheels, 0 elsewhere. Your task: output what fraction of the score comes from the car.
这一关把比较的结果直接交给你：每一格是一个关键点，三张图是它到三个候选的距离。最: This level hands you the comparisons directly: each cell is a keypoint, and the three maps are its distances to three candidates. The nearest is not always to be trusted: if the second nearest is almost as near, the pair may be a mistake caused by repeated texture.
这一关新出现的元件是<part-ref to=\"part:globalMax\: New in this level is the part <part-ref to="part:globalMax"></part-ref>: it finds the largest number in its input and outputs a picture filled with that number everywhere.
这一关有两个输入 A 和 B。输出要 A 的大轮廓（低频）加上 B 的细节（高频: This level has two inputs, A and B. The output should be A's broad outline (low frequencies) plus B's detail (high frequencies). You already know how to get A's half; how to get B's half is the puzzle here.
这一关有两个输入：「现场」是现在拍的，「空场」是没人时拍的参照。输出是一张只有: This level has two inputs: "Scene" is taken now, and "Empty scene" is a reference taken when nobody was there. The output is an image of only 0s and 1s, called a mask: 1 marks the cells the intruder covers, and everything else is 0.
这一关有两块布，在日光下相机读到的 R、G、B 一模一样。这一关你要做的：在各种: This level has two cloths whose R, G and B readings are exactly the same in daylight. Your task in this level: under various lamps, output what the camera reads for cloth A minus cloth B. Something to think about: the two cloths' spectra are plainly different, so why can daylight not tell them apart?
这一关没有噪声，也没有字。纸边用 x、y 两个方向的 Sobel 来找：两个响应: This level has no noise and no text. Find the paper's edges with Sobel in both directions: square each response, add them, and output 1 wherever the sum is above 0.04.
这一关的元件就是一个黑箱，看不到它里面怎么算。台上有几张测试图，挑一张喂进去，对: The part in this level is a black box: you cannot see how it works inside. There are a few test images on the bench. Pick one to feed in, compare what goes in with what comes out, then say what the part did.
这一关的元件都很朴素：<part-ref to=\"part:const\"><: The parts in this level are all simple: <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> always outputs the same number; <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> multiply and add two things cell by cell. When a number meets a picture, the number applies to every cell.
这一关的元件：μ、σ 各是两个可训练的数；「采样」每算一次都抽一个新的随机数；<: The parts in this level: μ and σ are each two trainable numbers; "Sample" draws a fresh random number every time it runs; <part-ref to="dg-decoder"></part-ref> turns two numbers into a blob, one controlling left-right and the other up-down.
这一关的照片，亮度都挤在 0.25 到 0.75 之间。修图软件里的「色阶」能把: In this level's photos, every brightness is squeezed between 0.25 and 0.75. The "levels" tool in a photo editor can stretch it back out to 0 … 1.
这一关的电路不处理图像，处理的是一行 32 个点的波形，输出一个数。<part-: This level's circuit does not process an image but a waveform of 32 points, and outputs a single number. <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> turns a row of numbers into one number.
这一关的输入是一片随机噪点，期望是某个没人告诉你的核压过它的结果。你要做的：让输: The input in this level is random noise, and the expected output is what you get by pressing some kernel nobody tells you about over it. Your task: make the output match the expected.
这一关的输入是排好的对错（一行 16 个 0 或 1）、名次 1 到 16，和一: The inputs of this level are the sorted rights and wrongs (a row of sixteen 0s and 1s), the ranks 1 to 16, and how many were labelled in all.
这一关的输入都是波形：一条光谱和三条灵敏度曲线，每条 10 个点，从紫到红。<p: This level's inputs are all waveforms: a spectrum and three sensitivity curves, 10 points each, from violet to red. <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> turns a row of numbers into one number.
这一关给你几对照片：清楚的原图和这台相机拍出来的样子。最后两组是「新照片」：它们: This level gives you a few pairs of photos: the sharp original and what this camera captured. The last two sets are "new photos": they take no part in training and only check whether what was learned works on photos it has never seen. The training panel draws an extra error line for the new samples.
这一关要判断：一个格子周围 7×7 的范围是不是全亮。测试里特意放了小一些的方块: This level asks: is the 7×7 area around a cell entirely bright? The tests deliberately include smaller squares, long bars, and a 7×7 square with one corner missing.
这一关要把封面贴准，平均误差小于 1.5 像素。动手前先看看照片里书的形状：和封: In this level you must paste the cover accurately, with an average error under 1.5 pixels. Before you start, look at the shape of the book in the photo: compared with the cover's original rectangle, what has changed?
这一关要让两堆都画到，鉴定员只能瞎猜，准确率回到一半。动手前想想：两边谁练得多、: In this level both clusters must be drawn, leaving the judge only able to guess, with its accuracy back at one half. Before you start, think: what difference does it make which side trains more, and which moves faster?
这一步只能转 A。: Only A turns in this step.
这一步只能转 c。把你的波（实线）调到和目标（虚线）重合，同时看下面两行像素怎么: Only c turns in this step. Lay your wave (solid) on the target (dashed), and watch how the two rows of pixels below change.
这一步只能转 k。: Only k turns in this step.
这一步只能转 φ。: Only φ turns in this step.
这一章检查一个最简单的分类器：每一格一个权重，分数是每格亮度乘权重的总和。每组测: This chapter examines the simplest classifier: one weight for every cell, its score the sum of every cell's brightness times its weight. Besides the photo, each test sends its weights in, drawn as a picture.
这一章的平均、高斯、差分、锐化，连同把图挪一格的平移，都能写成一个 3×3 核。: This chapter's average, Gaussian, difference and sharpen, along with the shift that moves an image by one pixel, can all be written as a 3×3 kernel. With practice, one look at an image before and after should tell you which kernel was used.
这一章要让机器画出没见过的图。第一步是学会用很少的数描述一张图。一张 16×16: This chapter teaches a machine to draw images it has never seen. The first step is learning to describe an image with very few numbers. A 16×16 image has 256 numbers; if all the images are just the same blob in different places, do you really need 256?
这个游戏里的核元件做的都是互相关。对称的核转 180° 不变，两种读法就没有区别: The kernel parts in this game all do cross-correlation. A symmetric kernel is unchanged by a 180° turn, so for it the two readings are the same.
这个选择记在这台设备的浏览器里，换一关也不变。: The choice is remembered in this browser and stays the same from level to level.
这些照片是在偏黄的灯下拍的，白纸看上去发黄。每张照片里都有一块白纸，而且它在 R: These photos were taken under a yellowish lamp, so white paper looks yellow. Every photo has a patch of white paper in it, the brightest thing in each of R, G and B. Adjust each channel so the paper becomes pure white (1, 1, 1), and every other colour is restored along with it.
这些照片灰蒙蒙的：最暗只有 0.25，最亮只有 0.75。把 0.25 变成 0: These photos are washed out: the darkest is only 0.25 and the brightest only 0.75. Turn 0.25 into 0 and 0.75 into 1, stretching everything in between in proportion.
这叫最大反池化：编码器池化时记下最大值在哪，解码器放大时放回原处，细节就不会被抹: This is max unpooling: the encoder remembers where each maximum was when pooling, and the decoder puts it back there when enlarging, so details are not smeared over the whole block. SegNet works like this.
这台分拣机把局部特征汇总成类别判断：卷积可以找不同的笔画，非线性和池化帮助处理位: This sorting machine combines local features into a class decision: convolutions can find different strokes, nonlinearities and pooling help with changes in position, and the classifier scores each class from the features. Passing on these new parts shows it works beyond the training examples; assessing reliability in practice requires more representative tests.
这台双目相机的焦距 × 基线 f·b = 3。把视差图换成距离图：z = f·b: This stereo camera's focal length × baseline is f·b = 3. Turn the disparity map into a distance map: z = f·b / d (metres).

A probe with only cos measures a wave shifted by 90° as 0. If every operation along the way were linear (no ReLU and no max pooling), all that would be left is "how bright the whole image is", and a faint X is as bright as a strong O.

采 M 个点，只能分辨 M/2 以下的频率（奈奎斯特频率）。更快的波不会消失，而: With M samples you can only tell apart frequencies below M/2 (the Nyquist frequency). So frequencies above M/2 must be removed before sampling: low-pass first, then sample.

Write it as z = μ + σ·ε instead: all the randomness comes from the input ε, z is just a multiply and an add of μ and σ, and the gradient is perfectly clear. This is called reparameterization, and it is how a VAE's encoder is trained.

鉴定员不动、生成器猛练，生成器就把所有样本都放到鉴定员最相信的那一点：两支笔重合: If the judge stands still while the generator trains hard, the generator puts every sample on the one spot the judge trusts most: the two pens merge and draw only one cluster. This is mode collapse; as soon as the judge reacts, they jump together to the other cluster. Let the judge keep up and the generator take small steps, and the pens settle on one cluster each, until the judge's accuracy is back to 50%.
